Keening of the Empty One.lore:
Delfia, the Empty One, let out a vile screech
as the swarms of her enemies closed in on her.
Her sisters, Myropy the Sated, Caelona the
Quiet, and Ophia the Kind were gone and the
silence that had fallen disturbed her. She did
not understand what awaited her as the Silver
ones approached carrying a prison made for
another. It would contain Delfia too, at great cost.
Her surviving sisters would not rest until they
found her - and enacted their revenge.

Dryadic Resurrection.lore:
Hycenea's fury filled the Tree of Life
completely. Molldyer, The Vedha, Laurey,
and Nalatia, each one the absolute of their
domains, fell back in fear. With a thought,
Hycenea sent them tumbling from their perch
on the Tree into the endless darkness below.
They could stay there forever for all she
cared. The seeds were planted for her
Attendants to grow anew. She was free.

In the next, she was gone. The world within
was much like the one he had always known,
the same landscape and the familiar sky,
the only difference was the deafening
silence. Harrakfar traveled the world far
and wide, searching for Hycenea, but soon
realized the truth - he was alone in this
prison reality. From this unyielding loneliness,
madness gave way.

Meshuga.lore:
In one moment, he felt his love nearby.
In the next, she was gone. The world within
was much like the one he had always known,
the same landscape and the familiar sky,
the only difference was the deafening
silence. Harrakfar traveled the world far
and wide, searching for Hycenea, but soon
realized the truth - he was alone in this
prison reality. From this unyielding loneliness,
madness gave way.

lost track of time. No matter how much I write,

my earlier notes have gradually become harder
to decipher. I hope it does not continue to deteriorate."

Cog of The Machine.lore:
The ascendant Emperor, Pelias Silvari, stood
triumphant in the newly excavated citadel
deep below the earth. Central to the cavern,
withered and ancient, was a tree, from which a
silvery aura grew. Reverently he approached
it, hand outstretched, ready to take on the
mantle he believed Uriddan once commanded.
Instead, as soon as his palm touched the bark,
there was a cacophonous noise as the energy
of thousands of Antium citizens cried out
as one. The barrier rejected Pelias' lineage.
The barrier rejected Pelias' empire. Instead,
they all vanished, becoming one with the Machine.

dream of claiming for themselves.

other players in a 12 block radius

The ghost of mistakes past, made corporeal.
The demon summoner and his minions await.

of the Monument is recommended for this boss!

foe. Anyone caught in his area of effect
attacks becomes short work for his minions.

Grants access to Azacor the Dark Summoner.

scouts have taken this tool to enact what she would have

Such a lovely tapestry to paint...

Permafrost Core (Instant).lore:
The song must continue. The Giant wakes.
Completion of the Echoes of Oblivion is required
and end-game gear is recommended for this boss!
Eldrask has devastating attacks and massive
damage. His presence creates a powerful blizzard
that damages those who attempt to flee his battle.
Players: 1-25 (One life per player)
Grants instant access to Eldrask, Last of the Frost Giants.

with the deep. Take heed, for the deep
is not merciful, and may not let go
of those in her grasp.

mmlore: Legends throughout the empire tell
of a great calamity that took place
near what we now know as The Nadir.
A battle most fierce that the earth
itself shook in horror.

granting him vision of far off lands
that held more promise than his own. His
being yearned for them, but for those
tears in reality, he was too mighty to cross.

Magic Mirror.lore:
It forces one to ponder upon the
the nature of their own reflection.
- Right click while holding to be transfered
from the corrupted world to the normal world.
- Left click while holding to reset the
temple to the way you found it.
* Quest Item *

Queen's Dolabra (shovel).lore:
Isadora had done all she had wanted to do.
Eleven years of peace. A strong family.
An Empire worthy of Abeliar. It was time now
to give control to her eldest son. He would
carry on her legacy. Of this she was sure.

He would spend the rest of his life in penance.

Silver Fang of Serceeal-4.lore:
Serceeal, the Silver Beast, volunteered for
the placement of the Loamskattar's prison.
It wasn't clear why he was so eager to seek
his Vigil, but there were whispers that he
could survive the depths of the Void with ease.
It remains to be seen if this was true.

corrupted Soulbinder stand against you.

mmlore: <dark_gray>Ganzir bound the thick cloak tighter around
<dark_gray>his body. The wind was cold and biting. It
<dark_gray>whistled and whispered as it bit into his skin.
<dark_gray>He should be invisible, yet he still felt something

and a lifeless night took of all who lived under him.

Almon's Severed Leg.lore:
It was only when the people of
the empire, whom he had so
greatly loved, were endangered,
that Almon finally began to act.
He quarreled with Pelias for years,
but nothing came of it. Until that final day.
Taking this item outside of the dungeon
will instead drop it in the dungeon.

truly wanted him to do. Sometimes it would
say something strange. It would mention the

mmlore: Ka'Vei'Lok was sealed by invocation of the mighty
Source of All Things, and the construction of the
four holy temples. A conspicuous way of hiding such
a terrible power. The second great discovery of
the veil-obsessed shamans was hidden away much
more subtly, left to simply be forgotten.
The Narsens' decision to erect their capital
on top of the forsaken vault certainly helped.

Sealing Keystone.lore:
Ka'Vei'Lok was sealed by invocation of the mighty
Source of All Things, and the construction of the
four holy temples. A conspicuous way of hiding such
a terrible power. The second great discovery of
the veil-obsessed shamans was hidden away much
more subtly, left to simply be forgotten.
The Narsens' decision to erect their capital
on top of the forsaken vault certainly helped.

The Blind Eye, however, sees the forgotten
even clearer than the remembered.

Alcyoneus-6.lore:
Once Phyrrys was Inverted, those still within
were changed. Their cores went dark.
Energy was pulled in, slowly at first, but soon
they became a deep tear in space. Hundreds
of tiny black holes, begging to collapse.
Phyrrys' secrets must remain sealed.

Mysterious Note.lore:
Rich elites of Chillwind, let this be a warning to you.
No longer will you walk all over us.
You sit there in comfort, surrounded by your
vast fortunes stolen from hard-working citizens.
And us? We're ignored, left to live in squalor.
We refuse to abide by this any longer.
The rooster crows at midnight.

covered in blood. The cup,
surrounded by fangs, is akin
to a hungering, open mouth.
Taking this item outside of the dungeon
will instead drop it in the dungeon.

Replica Crimson Wool.lore:
Daarken plucked the wool from the limp corpse
of the former Emperor, whose crimes had
at last been paid for - the razing of his
mighty empire. Once Crimson's pair was
found, Daarken would leave this mess to the
Giants. For now, a new resting place would
be necessary. The Monument must be reformed
in that primordial jungle of spirits...
Perhaps he would rest there too...

the wool, he saw a vision of a world

of Void long since frayed from the Veil.

mmlore: Vaessini and Orasomn. Crimson and Teal.
Tied together through more than time and
memories. Without Vaessini's surrender,
the Architect could never have overseen
Orasomn's capture. Without Orasomn's
freedom, Vaessini could never have found
his Home again. Now one will hold the other
in eternal vigil.

mmlore: Iota scoured her data banks, seeking
the source of the corruption that
had taken her mind and freedom from
her. It seemed to have left no trace,
until she noticed a small, seemingly
negligible blip of energy within her.
It whispered in an inaudible tone, the
words incomprehensible. But... it was
almost as if she could make out the
repeated use of "Neo"...

Corrupted Remnant.lore:
Iota scoured her data banks, seeking
the source of the corruption that
had taken her mind and freedom from
her. It seemed to have left no trace,
until she noticed a small, seemingly
negligible blip of energy within her.
It whispered in an inaudible tone, the
words incomprehensible. But... it was
almost as if she could make out the
repeated use of "Neo"...

Sketched Bag of Hoarding.lore:
The Pot of Proportions is deceptive in dimension;
Compact in appearance, but with enchanted extension!
Your toys and your trinkets remain in the mixture;
No damage is done to their talent or texture!
Right Click while in inventory to spot in the pot.
But carry coins on the cursor, and they join the lot.
Press  to store all the gold that you hold.

Silver Knight Nessi, the Forgetender, engineered

those who must remain behind.

Blue-Colored Thread.lore:
An incident like with Teal could not be
allowed to occur again. Clearly, Calder
thought, there are things unknown to
the scribes of history. Secrets within
secrets that have been scrubbed
from the world's eye. The imprisoned
ones are more than proof of this.
But he must persist regardless, as
nothing can truly be indestructible.
Whatever method it may take to rid the
world of them, he will find it.

Kaul had been hiding from his people,

his blessings, Kaul woke. Ta'Ferna
would burn for this sin.

Piece of Hate.lore:
As the stranger progressed through
the temple, reaching its inner most
depths, Varcosa's soul could feel the
shackles that had long binded him fall
away. Had it been done? Had someone
truly claimed The Corsair, tearing it
from the anchor that gave it dominion
here? The time had come for him to
leave. He must scour the Veil and find
his crew. They needed their captain.

its sickly blight across all it touched. Eventually,
a visitor arrived. With a surge of power
and a shard in hand, he gained a new title.
Alric, Lord of the Chilled Winds and
first of the Stargazers.

An enchanted broom owned by the

will instead drop it in the dungeon.

A Journey's End.name: A Journey's End
A Journey's End.nbt: {pages:['{"text":"Seven years...\\n\\nSeven long years had passed since we first landed on this wretched island. Seven years since we first felt the calling of the voice that called from below.\\n\\nVarcosa set up our base of operations, and from there,"}','{"text":"we dug... and dug... and dug...\\n\\nWe ventured ever downwards, closer towards a treasure that taunted us from beneath the ground.\\n\\nAnd when we finally broke through the bedrock, what we found was... nothing."}','{"text":"A large cavern stood firm beneath the earth, long since cut off from the rest of world. It bore flora and aquatic life that was otherworldly to us.\\n\\nAnd yet.. the reality set in that we had spent all this time digging, only for\\n"}','{"text":"our greed to lead us into this cavern of hopelessness.\\n\\nIt was in this moment that Varcosa\'s mind seemed to break under the strain of the situation. His body crumpled to the ground as he engulfed himself in a horrible laughter. "}','{"text":"The cave seemed to shake under the weight of his hysteria, before a bright light shone from deep within.\\n\\nAs it dissipated, we were suddenly filled with wonder, and yet utter confusion, at what now stood before us.\\n"}','{"text":"A great temple sat firmly within the cave\'s walls, its radiance illuminating the entire cavern. At its entrance, there stood a woman clad in black.\\n\\nHer skin was a pale green, and in her grip she held a mighty staff that emitted its own faint glow."}','{"text":"The woman lifted her hand outward towards Varcosa, and extended her fingers in a beckoning gesture.\\n\\nWithout any sense of hesitation, Varcosa rose from the ground, and walked towards the illusory temple."}','{"text":"As he reached its entrance, the woman took him by the hand and spoke to him in a soft tone that gently echoed through the cavern.\\n\\n\\"As my term draws to a close, yours may begin.\\""}','{"text":"The two walked inside the temple, and its large doors shut behind them.\\n\\nThat was the last time I ever saw Varcosa, though sometimes, in the dead of night, I can faintly hear his voice traveling up from beneath the earth..."}'],Monumenta:{MMName:"<!italic><!underlined><!bold><gold>A Journey's End"},title:"b",author:"Salazar",plain:{display:{Name:"A Journey's End"}},display:{Name:'{"bold":false,"italic":false,"underlined":false,"color":"gold","text":"A Journey\'s End"}'},resolved:1b}

mmlore: <!italic><!underlined><!strikethrough><!bold><!obfuscated><light_purple>* Quest Item *
A Miraculous Breakthrough.nbt: {pages:['{"extra":[{"text":"Adventurers are probably the most impertinent creatures to walk this planet, and yet I find myself grateful that this one exists. I had almost fully given up on this blasted machine, as trial after trial ended in failure."},{"text":"\\n"},{"text":"\\n"},{"text":"She has been in"}],"text":""}','{"extra":[{"text":"stasis for about a year now, thanks to that wondrous contraption. I must give Him credit, a spatial confinement chamber, able to autonomously move through the ether, seems like an idea far too insane to ever work. The damn thing even ended up under"}],"text":""}','{"extra":[{"text":"Sierhaven, and yet none of the foolish inhabitants even noticed. That artifact of his is something truly special."},{"text":"\\n"},{"text":"\\n"},{"text":"As for the specimen, she seems to have regained a large fraction of her memory thanks to that adventurer\\u0027s meddling."}],"text":""}','{"extra":[{"text":"Unfortunately, it is not enough. She has yet to remember far back enough for us to extract the information we need. This leaves me in quite a fickle situation."},{"text":"\\n"},{"text":"\\n"},{"text":"I can either wait this out, and see if her memory has actually been fully recovered,"},{"text":"\\n"}],"text":""}','{"extra":[{"text":"or I can push further. Both options seem to have their downsides. If I wait, I risk this not being permanent, and her mind once again resetting to its previous state. That said, if I continue to push her mind, I could shatter her memory entirely, leaving"}],"text":""}','{"extra":[{"text":"her as a useless husk."},{"text":"\\n"},{"text":"\\n"},{"text":"All this in mind, I seem to have no option but to continue forward. I can\\u0027t risk losing the information when she is so close to giving us what we need. He will be unyieldingly furious if I were to allow her to relapse, and I am already"}],"text":""}','{"extra":[{"text":"walking on thin ice, having taken as long as I have."},{"text":"\\n"},{"text":"\\n"},{"text":"I need more power, though. This machine has drained this area of its natural supply of magical resources to a point that it is no longer usable. I have been informed of some abandoned ruins"}],"text":""}','{"extra":[{"text":"to the east of the Axtan Monastery that are abundant in magical energy. With any luck, this will provide me with the power and privacy I need to continue my work."},{"text":"\\n"},{"text":"\\n"},{"text":"This will be my final endeavor for this project. I either"}],"text":""}','{"extra":[{"text":"succeed here, or I face His judgement."}],"text":""}'],generation:0,Enchantments:[{lvl:1s,id:"minecraft:power"}],Monumenta:{MMLore:["<!italic><!underlined><!strikethrough><!bold><!obfuscated><light_purple>* Quest Item *","#Q24I03"]},HideFlags:1,title:"§6A Miraculous Breakthrough",author:"Virius",plain:{display:{Lore:["* Quest Item *","#Q24I03"]}},display:{Lore:['{"italic":false,"color":"dark_gray","extra":[{"bold":false,"italic":false,"underlined":false,"strikethrough":false,"obfuscated":false,"color":"light_purple","text":"* Quest Item *"}],"text":""}','{"italic":false,"color":"dark_gray","extra":["#Q24I03"],"text":""}']},resolved:1b}

Aleph Null, Vol. 1.name: Aleph Null, Vol. 1
Aleph Null, Vol. 1.nbt: {pages:['["Before they arrived,\\nit was a night much like\\nany other.\\n\\nThe children were\\nscurried to bed, and\\nthe streets of the\\ntypically busy capital\\ncalmed as the noise\\ndied down to a\\ndeafening silence. In\\nthis moment of\\nserenity, no one could\\nhave possibly"]','["guessed this night\\nwould be the last of\\nits kind.\\n\\nIt was then that the\\nrumbling began. The\\nearth below us shook\\nviolently, as if the\\nweight of a thousand\\nmountains was\\ncrumbling down upon\\nus. But its rhythm... It\\nstruck immediate fear\\nwithin the minds of all"]','["that heard it, not for\\nits volume, but for its\\nlack of chaos.\\n\\nStep by step, they\\nstrode forward\\ntowards us. We far\\noutnumbered them, a\\nfact that would soon\\nprove to be a source\\nof false hope and\\narrogance.\\n\\nIt would not take long"]','["for us to realize that\\ntheir strength each\\nequaled that of a\\nhundred men. No, it\\nwas likely even more\\nthan that. And a few\\nof them... They wielded\\npower far beyond\\nanything we ever\\ncould have imagined\\nfeasible.\\n\\nWhat little hope we had\\nfaded upon witnessing"]','["the devastation they\\nwrought with such\\nease. After a defeat\\nso immeasurably\\nthorough, we placed\\nour final, desperate\\nprayers in the\\ncapabilities of the\\nEmperor.\\n\\nEven he, though, was\\ncut down swiftly. It\\nwas then that the\\ninvaders, a squadron"]','["of knights clad in\\nsilver armor, made a\\ndecision that would\\ncome to shock and\\nconfuse us.\\n\\nThey gathered up\\nthose of us from the\\ncapital who had\\nsurvived the city\'s\\nrazing, numbering only\\nabout one hundred.\\nThey told us they\\nwere going to take us"]','["on a journey.\\n\\nOne that would give us\\n\\"greater purpose\\"..."]'],Enchantments:[{lvl:1s,id:"minecraft:power"}],Monumenta:{MMName:"<!italic><!underlined><!bold><gold>Aleph Null, Vol. 1",MMLore:["<light_purple>* Quest Item *","#Q156I01"]},HideFlags:1,title:"b",author:"Unknown",plain:{display:{Name:"Aleph Null, Vol. 1",Lore:["* Quest Item *","#Q156I01"]}},display:{Name:'{"bold":false,"italic":false,"underlined":false,"color":"gold","text":"Aleph Null, Vol. 1"}',Lore:['{"italic":false,"color":"dark_gray","extra":[{"color":"light_purple","text":"* Quest Item *"}],"text":""}','{"italic":false,"color":"dark_gray","extra":["#Q156I01"],"text":""}']}}

mmlore: <light_purple>* Quest Item *
Aleph Null, Vol. 2.name: Aleph Null, Vol. 2
Aleph Null, Vol. 2.nbt: {pages:['{"text":"A year passed as we were shepherded around the remnants of the empire by the knights, collecting stragglers who remained across the various states to add to our numbers.\\n\\nAll the while, we were kept at the brink of extermination - ","color":"black"}','{"text":"being fed just enough to survive and forced to walk until our bodies collapsed from exhaustion.\\n\\nWe longed for the release of death, but were forced to remain alive.","color":"black"}','{"text":"It was not until we had visited the tattered remains of every state that we were informed of our final destination.\\n\\nDeep below the waves, the knights had set their sights on a structure that laid on the ocean\\u2019s floor."}','{"text":"We were all vaguely aware of the existence of the Seamounts, large dome-like constructions that the Emperor used as a form of safeguarding the empire\\u2019s most valuable possessions and secrets. ","color":"black"}','{"text":"What they wanted from down there was beyond my ability to guess, and the answers we would come to understand were equally as confounding.\\n\\nWe arrived by boat to the location in the ocean where the Seamount resided right below us, and it"}','{"text":"was here that most of the knights took their leave.\\n\\nOnly one remained to herd us towards the ocean\\u2019s floor, a woman by the name of Irrus.","color":"black"}'],Enchantments:[{lvl:1s,id:"minecraft:power"}],Monumenta:{MMName:"<!italic><!underlined><!bold><gold>Aleph Null, Vol. 2",MMLore:["<light_purple>* Quest Item *","#Q156I02"]},HideFlags:1,title:"Book",author:"Unknown",plain:{display:{Name:"Aleph Null, Vol. 2",Lore:["* Quest Item *","#Q156I02"]}},display:{Name:'{"bold":false,"italic":false,"underlined":false,"color":"gold","text":"Aleph Null, Vol. 2"}',Lore:['{"italic":false,"color":"dark_gray","extra":[{"color":"light_purple","text":"* Quest Item *"}],"text":""}','{"italic":false,"color":"dark_gray","extra":["#Q156I02"],"text":""}']}}

mmlore: <light_purple>* Quest Item *
Aleph Null, Vol. 3.name: Aleph Null, Vol. 3
Aleph Null, Vol. 3.nbt: {pages:['{"text":"It was easy at this moment to contemplate the idea of our group overpowering her, breaking free of the shackles that had bound us since our homes were destroyed and lives ruined.\\n\\nHowever, we dared not defy her, for she had in her possession something that made","color":"black"}','{"text":"her an indomitable force - a strange artifact so powerful that it is said to have been capable of shattering realities at a moment\\u2019s notice.\\n\\nUsing this power, she transported us from the ocean\\u2019s surface, down to the depths where the Seamount resided, and it wasn\\u2019t"}','{"text":"long until we discovered the truth of what was hiding down here.\\n\\nSealed away, deep below the Seamount\\u2019s surface structure, laid two great vaults once belonging to the Emperor."}','{"text":"Here, Irrus gave us her final proclamation.\\n\\nShe ordered us to begin building, to create a new home for ourselves here below the waves.\\n\\nIt was an odd request, given everything they had placed us through, and she knew it would ","color":"black"}','{"text":"take a long period of time to see to completion.\\n\\nAs such, she removed herself from us for the duration of this task, sealing herself and the artifact she carried within the vault known as Zeta."}','{"text":"It was there that she would remain, unmoving, for five whole years.\\n\\nI remain unable to comprehend how someone could survive that long without food or water, but the day of our completion, she exited the vault the same as the day she entered."}'],Enchantments:[{lvl:1s,id:"minecraft:power"}],Monumenta:{MMName:"<!italic><!underlined><!bold><gold>Aleph Null, Vol. 3",MMLore:["<light_purple>* Quest Item *","#Q156I03"]},HideFlags:1,title:"Book",author:"Unknown",plain:{display:{Name:"Aleph Null, Vol. 3",Lore:["* Quest Item *","#Q156I03"]}},display:{Name:'{"bold":false,"italic":false,"underlined":false,"color":"gold","text":"Aleph Null, Vol. 3"}',Lore:['{"italic":false,"color":"dark_gray","extra":[{"color":"light_purple","text":"* Quest Item *"}],"text":""}','{"italic":false,"color":"dark_gray","extra":["#Q156I03"],"text":""}']}}

But through that, you have proven yourself worthy in His eyes.\\""}'],Enchantments:[{lvl:1s,id:"minecraft:power"}],Monumenta:{MMName:"<!italic><!underlined><!bold><gold>Aleph Null, Vol. 4",MMLore:["<light_purple>* Quest Item *","#Q156I04"]},HideFlags:1,title:"Book",author:"Unknown",plain:{display:{Name:"Aleph Null, Vol. 4",Lore:["* Quest Item *","#Q156I04"]}},display:{Name:'{"bold":false,"italic":false,"underlined":false,"color":"gold","text":"Aleph Null, Vol. 4"}',Lore:['{"italic":false,"color":"dark_gray","extra":[{"color":"light_purple","text":"* Quest Item *"}],"text":""}','{"italic":false,"color":"dark_gray","extra":["#Q156I04"],"text":""}']}}

Aleph Null, Vol. 7.nbt: {pages:['{"text":"With her parting words, we witnessed her activate the artifact that she had sealed away with her, its black texture glowing as it resonated power."}','{"text":"In the space before her, a large door manifested from nothing... though actually seeing it was a challenge, as light mostly phased right through."}','{"text":"It opened before her, and an otherworldly incandescence casted out through its frame.\\n\\nIrrus, the final knight we would ever encounter, stepped through the door into whatever world sat beyond.\\n "}','{"text":"She would never return back to us, and while we would never learn of who this Architect she spoke of was, we were sure the memory of her words would haunt us, and our descendants, forever."}','{"text":"But it was our hope that we could forget."}'],Enchantments:[{lvl:1s,id:"minecraft:power"}],Monumenta:{MMName:"<!italic><!underlined><!bold><gold>Aleph Null, Vol. 7",MMLore:["<light_purple>* Quest Item *","#Q156I07"]},HideFlags:1,title:"Book",author:"Unknown",plain:{display:{Name:"Aleph Null, Vol. 7",Lore:["* Quest Item *","#Q156I07"]}},display:{Name:'{"bold":false,"italic":false,"underlined":false,"color":"gold","text":"Aleph Null, Vol. 7"}',Lore:['{"italic":false,"color":"dark_gray","extra":[{"color":"light_purple","text":"* Quest Item *"}],"text":""}','{"italic":false,"color":"dark_gray","extra":["#Q156I07"],"text":""}']}}

Amaryllis.nbt: {pages:['{"extra":[{"text":"Amaryllis is a bulbous plant with a large, fragrant, pink-red flower that blooms in the early spring.\\n\\nThey symbolize\\n\\""},{"color":"dark_blue","text":"Determination and Beauty"},{"color":"black","text":"\\"."}],"text":""}','{"text":"Ingesting any part of the plant will cause stomach pain, kidney failure, vomiting, and loss of appetite."}'],Enchantments:[{lvl:1s,id:"minecraft:power"}],Monumenta:{MMName:"<!italic><!underlined><!strikethrough><!bold><!obfuscated><gold>Amaryllis",MMLore:["<!italic><!underlined><!strikethrough><!bold><!obfuscated><light_purple>* Quest Item *","#Q133I04"]},HideFlags:1,title:"§6Amaryllis",author:"Anazus",plain:{display:{Name:"Amaryllis",Lore:["* Quest Item *","#Q133I04"]}},display:{Name:'{"bold":false,"italic":false,"underlined":false,"strikethrough":false,"obfuscated":false,"color":"gold","text":"Amaryllis"}',Lore:['{"italic":false,"color":"dark_gray","extra":[{"bold":false,"italic":false,"underlined":false,"strikethrough":false,"obfuscated":false,"color":"light_purple","text":"* Quest Item *"}],"text":""}','{"italic":false,"color":"dark_gray","extra":["#Q133I04"],"text":""}']},resolved:1b}

An Unwelcomed Journey.name: An Unwelcomed Journey
An Unwelcomed Journey.nbt: {pages:['{"text":"An intruding man walked into the village today, clearly lost among the swamp. Before reducing him to mere potion stock, I inquired upon him the current year of this land\'s calendar.\\n\\nHe claimed it to be 115, which would mean that we have crossed"}','{"text":"the 40 year mark since first arriving in this land.\\n\\nOr... was our arrival near the 65th year, making it closer to 50? It has been many moons since time has registered as normal to me."}','{"text":"I can\'t help but think back upon our arrival here, following our unexpected departure from the Ring.\\n\\nThe time of the Mother\'s awakening was approaching us. We needed all the strength available to us in order to ensure that she was freed. "}','{"text":"Her left hand, Sycorax, and her right hand, Hedera, had been away for unthinkable lengths of time, and we decided best that they should be called home.\\n\\nWe gathered into a ritual circle, and our group\'s leader, Diantha, used the "}','{"text":"power of her mighty staff, The Wolf\'s Eye, to pierce into the darkness of the realms that lie beyond our own, searching for any trace of Hedera or Sycorax.\\n\\nBut... something went wrong. Soon, we all began to feel the"}','{"text":"sensation of falling, warping through space and time as we spiraled through the cracks between realities.\\n\\nBefore we knew it, we found ourselves in this land, inside a small cave surrounded by bloodflowered mire."}','{"text":"Any attempts at escaping back seemed futile. Something about this place... it blocked our magic from working to its full extent. Something powerful resided here, and it did not welcome us.\\n\\nEven Diantha struggled to muster"}','{"text":"any meaningful results, though it seemed her staff still put her at a significant advantage over the rest of us.\\n\\nEventually, after what felt like ages of wondering aimlessly, a strange man found us in the swamp. He was a native of this land,"}','{"text":"and offered us a way home in exchange for our cooperation.\\n\\nDiantha, willing to make the sacrifice for us, accepted the man\'s offer and left us to serve his needs.\\n\\nFor reasons we never found out, it seems this deal never came"}','{"text":"to fruition, and it has been many years since I felt Diantha\'s life force fade away.\\n\\nOne day, we will find a way to return to our home, and when we do, She shall be free."}'],Monumenta:{MMName:"<!italic><!underlined><!strikethrough><!bold><!obfuscated><gold>An Unwelcomed Journey"},title:"b",author:"Lilium",plain:{display:{Name:"An Unwelcomed Journey"}},display:{Name:'{"bold":false,"italic":false,"underlined":false,"strikethrough":false,"obfuscated":false,"color":"gold","text":"An Unwelcomed Journey"}'},resolved:1b}

Another Disc.nbt: {pages:['{"text":"The city section this shift was extremely small, and my outpost was nowhere inside of it. Instead, I found yet another disc shrine, this time a room coated in vines."}','{"text":"There\\u0027s still no sign of another city within the halls, so I might as well consider my main outpost good and gone, and try setting up a new one. Awalterskong.nbt: {pages:['{"text":"Hello,\\nThis is Fangride, from the Monumenta Development team. Obviously this book is not part of the game canon, but this quest has something really important behind it that I felt was worth writing about a bit. I want to talk a bit about my friend Awalterskong."}','{"text":"In December of 2022, we lost Awalterskong to a brain aneurysm and the following medical complications. It was a sudden and unexpected loss to our community and also to myself and my fellow developers who had known him and loved him. This quest you just finished playing was a project"}','{"text":"Walter had been working on for awhile before his passing. Releasing this was only possible thanks to the incredible work of many developers on TM, including Crondis, Nicknon, Qoo, Nover, and many more. I was able to pick up his (thankfully detailed) notes he left behind as well as pick"}','{"text":"the brains of our friend and occasional developer, Stan, and finally release this quest in Walter\'s memory. While this isn\'t the end to this storyline, this quest was Walter\'s last project he started and I\'m so happy we\'re able to allow you to experience his final work."}','{"text":"I want to thank you for playing it and in doing so, help me and others memorialize Walter and all the amazing work he did for this game and beyond. He was someone Crondis and I knew for nearly a decade and was a close friend. His loss was a massive blow and we knew we had"}','{"text":"to help finish what he had been unable to complete. We hope this lived up to his dreams and expectations and we hope you enjoyed your time with it.\\nHe was a special person with incredible talent, a sharp wit, and a huge heart. He is missed to this day. Rest in peace buddy. This is for you."}'],Enchantments:[{lvl:1s,id:"minecraft:power"}],Monumenta:{},HideFlags:1,title:"Awalterskong",author:"Fangride"}

mmlore: <!italic><!underlined><!strikethrough><!bold><!obfuscated><light_purple>* Quest Item *
Battered Journal.nbt: {pages:['{"extra":[{"text":"Should have known Nyr wasn\'t safe either. I finally return from my journey, trying to enjoy the comfort of being around other human beings once again. Yet, the same thing occurred this time, just as before. Eyes. Everywhere. Staring. Watching my movements."}],"text":""}','{"extra":[{"text":"I must flee even farther, somewhere that His sight can\'t find me. Somewhere I can continue my studies unhindered."},{"text":"\\n"},{"text":"\\n"},{"color":"black","text":"I hear them above my lab, searching for me. If I stay here any longer, I know they will find me, and I will "}],"text":""}','{"extra":[{"text":"cease to be free. Fortunately, I have just enough supplies for a one-way teleport to a place far, far away from here."},{"text":"\\n"},{"text":"\\n"},{"color":"black","text":"Dimitri, if you ever manage to come across this journal, know that I am sorry. Please, if you desire, "}],"text":""}','{"extra":[{"text":"come seek me out. I can\'t specify my location, but I know you will understand."},{"text":"\\n"},{"text":"\\n"},{"italic":true,"color":"black","text":"Where water\'s pour is rare as gold,"},{"text":"\\n"},{"italic":true,"color":"black","text":"And songs of wishes granted told,"},{"text":"\\n"},{"italic":true,"color":"black","text":"Crystallized essence to one shall quiver,"},{"text":"\\n"},{"italic":true,"color":"black","text":"For now I lie within The River."},{"text":"\\n"},{"color":"black","text":" "}],"text":""}'],generation:0,Enchantments:[{lvl:1s,id:"minecraft:power"}],Monumenta:{MMLore:["<!italic><!underlined><!strikethrough><!bold><!obfuscated><light_purple>* Quest Item *","#Q30I03"]},HideFlags:1,title:"Battered Journal",author:"Ignos",plain:{display:{Lore:["* Quest Item *","#Q30I03"]}},display:{Lore:['{"italic":false,"color":"dark_gray","extra":[{"bold":false,"italic":false,"underlined":false,"strikethrough":false,"obfuscated":false,"color":"light_purple","text":"* Quest Item *"}],"text":""}','{"italic":false,"color":"dark_gray","extra":["#Q30I03"],"text":""}']},resolved:1b}

Battered Trade Log.name: Battered Trade Log
Battered Trade Log.nbt: {pages:['{"extra":[{"text":"5 Unx:","underlined":true},{"text":"\\n\\nThe start of another business year. Quite the oddity - seems Ishnir has actually outbid Chillwind for the majority of our supplies this term. Regardless, they\'d better have the supplies to trade in return."}],"text":""}','{"extra":[{"text":"17 Unx:","underlined":true},{"text":"\\n\\nProcess Order (CWD)\\n\\n79 bundles - Wheat\\n92 bundles - Wool\\n114 barrels - Lava\\n\\nWhat a ridiculous amount of lava. Damn ice dwellers..."}],"text":""}','{"extra":[{"text":"39 Unx:","underlined":true},{"text":"\\n\\nProcess Order (ISH)\\n\\n468 bundles - Cane\\n215 barrels - Water\\n79 units - Ender Eyes\\n\\nWait, what..."}],"text":""}','{"extra":[{"text":"6 Fenx:","underlined":true},{"text":"\\n\\nProcess Order (ISH)\\n\\n652 barrels - B Powder\\n221 barrels - Water\\n\\nHow is this a supply order? Whatever, money is money."}],"text":""}','{"extra":[{"text":"33 Fenx:","underlined":true},{"text":"\\n\\nAt last, a trade shipment in from Al Malakut. Took them two months, but at least it\'s here. Will begin unpacking tomorrow morning."}],"text":""}','{"extra":[{"text":"1 Tix:","underlined":true},{"text":"\\n\\nWhat is this mess? All their goods are covered in a white, chalky powder... And do I smell... coal? That\'s not even part of their shipment!\\n\\nAnother order will need to be made. How obnoxious."}],"text":""}','{"extra":[{"text":"25 Tix:","underlined":true},{"text":"\\n\\nReplacement order has come in. At least they were speedy about it this time.\\n\\nAside from a random bone (which I think is a... femur?) the supplies are fine. Still smells awfully like coal though."}],"text":""}','{"text":"\\n\\n\\n\\n\\nSome pages seem to be missing from the middle portion of the book.","italic":true}','{"extra":[{"text":"16 Nex:","underlined":true},{"text":"\\n\\nNew shipment today, but what even is this thing? Looks like a carcass of some kind, though not from any animal I\'ve ever seen.\\n\\nWill need to contact my associate in Ishnir. Their shenanigans this year have gone too far..."}],"text":""}','{"extra":[{"text":"17 Nex:","underlined":true},{"text":"\\n\\nIt... It\'s gone... That thing in the box.... Gone...\\n\\nWho would\'ve stolen such a grotesque thing?...\\n\\nBetween this and Al Malakut\'s lack of communication, I\'m gonna go crazy! "}],"text":""}','{"text":"\\n\\n\\n\\nThe final pages of the log, including its back cover, seem to have had a giant bite taken out of them.","italic":true}'],Monumenta:{MMName:"<!italic>Battered Trade Log"},title:"Battered Trade",author:"Sentoree",plain:{display:{Name:"Battered Trade Log"}},display:{Name:'{"italic":false,"text":"Battered Trade Log"}'},resolved:1b}

Breaking The Seal.name: Breaking The Seal
Breaking The Seal.nbt: {pages:['{"text":"If you have found this message, you are my final hope.§0\\n§0\\n§0A long time ago a chaotic order known as the Alchemist\'s Bastion came into possession of a source of limitless magical potential. I was a part of another organization which managed to"}','{"text":"contain the Bastion within our walls. We were attacked constantly inside and out, but we had a plan to maintain our defence.§0\\n§0\\n§0We were able to contain the Bastion along with ourselves in a pocket out of sync with time itself. The world would move on without us"}','{"text":"on and forget about us. I would be the fool to undo that.§0\\n§0\\n§0I thought that with the pocket in place the Bastion was secure and my friends and I could be free. I was able to slip out of the pocket by myself, but opening a passage for everyone else would require"}','{"text":"more powerful magic.§0\\n§0\\n§0In my travels I encountered the Tlaxans and was in awe of their crystal magic. Surely just one of these would be enough power and focus to open another rift out of the time pocket.§0\\n§0\\n§0I befriended a Tlaxan"}','{"text":"shaman who went on to become a renowned general among their ranks. He respected the knowledge and power I had to share, and I too grew to respect him.§0\\n§0\\n§0After many years I was able to secure a crystal in secret and perfect the spell to revisit the tower,"}','{"text":"but when I attempted to everything went wrong.§0\\n§0\\n§0The rift was unstable and incapable of being held open for more than a single person without letting others loose unintentionally. A dozen or so alchemists were set free which I then had"}','{"text":"to track down before they caused too much havoc. Unfortunately I couldn\'t find them all, so another safeguard had to be put in place.§0\\n§0\\n§0I was able to find an order to protect the time pocket, but if I have learned anything it is that no plan is foolproof."}','{"text":"Until the artifact the alchemists possess is retrieved, they will always be a threat.§0\\n§0\\n§0That is what I need you to do. Cazol.name: Cazol
Cazol.nbt: {pages:['{"text":"Cazol was no Tlaxan. Yet he spoke our tongue and knew our ways. He found those with rebellion in our hearts and spoke the words we needed to hear. The Sons of the Forest would be reborn. Cazol did not want to lead, only to provide what we would need. He found us a home. We chose to call "}','{"text":"it after C\'Telsket, to eternalize his sacrifice. This verdant fortress would be called Ta\'Telsket. A home for those who had none. It was here Cazol would set up an infernal machine. A fragment of a god, he told us, to grant the Sons of the Forest the power they deserved. Soon, the"}','{"text":"colonizers would fall. Our efforts would not be in vain. The dark power Cazol has created in the heart of Ta\'Telsket has granted us immense strength. Chronicles of Hekawt, Vol. 1.name: Chronicles of Hekawt, Vol. 1
Chronicles of Hekawt, Vol. 1.nbt: {pages:['{"text":"Another day, another slight irritation that makes me question the path I have taken in my life.§0\\n§0\\n§0\\"Royal Grand Vizier to the ruler of the Ishnir, Pharaoh Rashem Ka\\", this is the full title given to me."}','{"text":"I wield some of the highest political power in the land, and yet I find myself eternally bored of this life.§0\\n§0\\n§0I am a slave to a complacent man who the people worship as a deity incarnate. Am I not destined for greater things?"}'],generation:0,Monumenta:{MMName:"<!italic><!underlined><!strikethrough><!bold><!obfuscated><gold>Chronicles of Hekawt, Vol. 1"},title:"b",author:"Vizier Hekawt",plain:{display:{Name:"Chronicles of Hekawt, Vol. 1"}},display:{Name:'{"bold":false,"italic":false,"underlined":false,"strikethrough":false,"obfuscated":false,"color":"gold","text":"Chronicles of Hekawt, Vol. 1"}'},resolved:1b}

Chronicles of Hekawt, Vol. 10.name: Chronicles of Hekawt, Vol. 10
Chronicles of Hekawt, Vol. 10.nbt: {pages:['{"text":"\\"Akrhh Almawt\\", a forbidden ritual that binds one\'s soul to another being, and suspends it in perpetual torment.§0\\n§0\\n§0In the early days of the war, it was used to increase the power of a horse one hundred fold."}','{"text":"The horse would be set ablaze by the ritual, its flesh slowly searing from the bone. However, being bound to the user\'s soul, it would begin regenerating that flesh. This cycle of torture forced their bodies into overdrive, and we ruled the battlefield."}','{"text":"However, the practice was draining on the user\'s soul, and caused soldiers to fall far too quickly. As such, the ritual was deemed unfitting for society, and was banned from practice.§0\\n§0\\n§0Soon, the soldiers will be coming to force me out of the city. This "}','{"text":"is my only chance. This is my only option."}'],generation:0,Monumenta:{MMName:"<!italic><!underlined><!strikethrough><!bold><!obfuscated><gold>Chronicles of Hekawt, Vol. 10"},title:"b",author:"Vizier Hekawt",plain:{display:{Name:"Chronicles of Hekawt, Vol. 10"}},display:{Name:'{"bold":false,"italic":false,"underlined":false,"strikethrough":false,"obfuscated":false,"color":"gold","text":"Chronicles of Hekawt, Vol. 10"}'},resolved:1b}

Chronicles of Hekawt, Vol. 11.name: Chronicles of Hekawt, Vol. 11
Chronicles of Hekawt, Vol. 11.nbt: {pages:['{"text":"The ritual responded to me with a blinding flash of light, and I lost consciousness for a fair amount of time. I woke up covered in sand, laying atop a dune in the sun\'s blistering heat.§0\\n§0\\n§0Except... I do not feel that heat anymore."}','{"text":"I am unsure how this occurred, but it seems the artifact did not respond well to the ritual. I can feel its power still, I am still able to draw upon it without contact with it.§0\\n§0\\n§0My form, however, is concerning. I seem to have lost all flesh,"}','{"text":"muscle, and bodily organs. Yet, I still live, a walking skeleton with immense magical capabilities. I believe in the Chillwind, they have myths of such creatures, and call them Liches.§0\\n§0\\n§0But this is not what I wanted. I cannot stay like this. "}','{"text":"This power flowing through me is sensational, but this form is despicable.§0\\n§0\\n§0I will find a way to return my form to its former glory, then I shall finally take my place atop the world. I will finally take the first napkin."}'],generation:0,Monumenta:{MMName:"<!italic><!underlined><!strikethrough><!bold><!obfuscated><gold>Chronicles of Hekawt, Vol. 11"},title:"b",author:"Vizier Hekawt",plain:{display:{Name:"Chronicles of Hekawt, Vol. 11"}},display:{Name:'{"bold":false,"italic":false,"underlined":false,"strikethrough":false,"obfuscated":false,"color":"gold","text":"Chronicles of Hekawt, Vol. 11"}'},resolved:1b}

Chronicles of Hekawt, Vol. 12.name: Chronicles of Hekawt, Vol. 12
Chronicles of Hekawt, Vol. 12.nbt: {pages:['{"text":"How long have I searched? Decades? Centuries? Time doesn\'t really phase me much anymore, everything just seems to pass by in an instant.§0\\n§0\\n§0But after all this time, I believe I may have finally found my answer."}','{"text":"In the desert, there lies an old library, left abandoned, and its original purpose forgotten. It seems to have been created to gather knowledge from all across the world for public consumption.§0\\n§0\\n§0What a fascinating idea, I wonder why it was abandoned."}'],generation:0,Monumenta:{MMName:"<!italic><!underlined><!strikethrough><!bold><!obfuscated><gold>Chronicles of Hekawt, Vol. 12"},title:"b",author:"Vizier Hekawt",plain:{display:{Name:"Chronicles of Hekawt, Vol. 12"}},display:{Name:'{"bold":false,"italic":false,"underlined":false,"strikethrough":false,"obfuscated":false,"color":"gold","text":"Chronicles of Hekawt, Vol. 12"}'},resolved:1b}

Chronicles of Hekawt, Vol. 13.name: Chronicles of Hekawt, Vol. 13
Chronicles of Hekawt, Vol. 13.nbt: {pages:['{"text":"Among the many books and scrolls in this library, I found a document that stood out among the rest, titled \\"The Veil of Reality\\".§0\\n§0\\n§0This book speaks of a great power that lies dormant, locked away in the boundary between this world and the next."}','{"text":"This power would allow its user to control reality itself, and shape it to their liking.§0\\n§0\\n§0Entering the Veil between worlds is unimaginably difficult, but the book speaks of doorways, naturally occurring entrances into the Veil that exist around the world."}','{"text":"As my luck would have it, it even described the location of the doorway that exists within the Isles.§0\\n§0\\n§0This power over reality, it is my key. It will return me to the way I was."}'],generation:0,Monumenta:{MMName:"<!italic><!underlined><!strikethrough><!bold><!obfuscated><gold>Chronicles of Hekawt, Vol. 13"},title:"b",author:"Vizier Hekawt",plain:{display:{Name:"Chronicles of Hekawt, Vol. 13"}},display:{Name:'{"bold":false,"italic":false,"underlined":false,"strikethrough":false,"obfuscated":false,"color":"gold","text":"Chronicles of Hekawt, Vol. 13"}'},resolved:1b}

Chronicles of Hekawt, Vol. 14.name: Chronicles of Hekawt, Vol. 14
Chronicles of Hekawt, Vol. 14.nbt: {pages:['{"text":"This city fascinates me beyond belief. Its rooms twist and contort, and the path backwards is never the same as you remembered it being.§0\\n§0\\n§0I can only hypothesize that it exists in this state due to its long exposure to the power of Reality."}','{"text":"How magnificent, and to think, the entrance to that power lies somewhere within this protean venezia. I am determined in my search to find it.§0\\n§0\\n§0Getting lost in this place would likely be incredibly easy for the weak willed."}'],generation:0,Monumenta:{MMName:"<!italic><!underlined><!strikethrough><!bold><!obfuscated><gold>Chronicles of Hekawt, Vol. 14"},title:"b",author:"Vizier Hekawt",plain:{display:{Name:"Chronicles of Hekawt, Vol. 14"}},display:{Name:'{"bold":false,"italic":false,"underlined":false,"strikethrough":false,"obfuscated":false,"color":"gold","text":"Chronicles of Hekawt, Vol. 14"}'},resolved:1b}

Chronicles of Hekawt, Vol. 2.name: Chronicles of Hekawt, Vol. 2
Chronicles of Hekawt, Vol. 2.nbt: {pages:['{"text":"News today from the southern stretches of the desert, an artifact was discovered buried in the sand. Generally this would be no cause for alarm, but circumstances around it seem strange.§0\\n§0\\n§0All life around the artifact was wiped out - cacti, snakes, "}','{"text":"and even the occasional sand creeper. It\'s as if being in the vicinity of this thing caused these creatures to suddenly lose their will to live.§0\\n§0\\n§0Our soldiers are strong of will, and they seem to be somewhat resistant"}','{"text":"to this effect. I am wary to bring this thing into Al Malakut, but Rashem has already taken an interest in it."}'],generation:0,Monumenta:{MMName:"<!italic><!underlined><!strikethrough><!bold><!obfuscated><gold>Chronicles of Hekawt, Vol. 2"},title:"c",author:"Vizier Hekawt",plain:{display:{Name:"Chronicles of Hekawt, Vol. 2"}},display:{Name:'{"bold":false,"italic":false,"underlined":false,"strikethrough":false,"obfuscated":false,"color":"gold","text":"Chronicles of Hekawt, Vol. 2"}'},resolved:1b}

Chronicles of Hekawt, Vol. 3.name: Chronicles of Hekawt, Vol. 3
Chronicles of Hekawt, Vol. 3.nbt: {pages:['{"text":"I should have known this would be the way things would turn out. \\"A power sent from the deities themselves, a vessel for the power of Cironds, the patron god of the Underworld.\\"§0\\n§0\\n§0If anything, Rashem is good at convincing the masses of"}','{"text":"his beliefs and ideologies. Sometimes I wonder if he truly believes what he preaches.§0\\n§0\\n§0Then again, when you are raised in luxury and told that you contain the blood of gods, why wouldn\'t you?"}'],generation:0,Monumenta:{MMName:"<!italic><!underlined><!strikethrough><!bold><!obfuscated><gold>Chronicles of Hekawt, Vol. 3"},title:"b",author:"Vizier Hekawt",plain:{display:{Name:"Chronicles of Hekawt, Vol. 3"}},display:{Name:'{"bold":false,"italic":false,"underlined":false,"strikethrough":false,"obfuscated":false,"color":"gold","text":"Chronicles of Hekawt, Vol. 3"}'},resolved:1b}

Chronicles of Hekawt, Vol. 4.name: Chronicles of Hekawt, Vol. 4
Chronicles of Hekawt, Vol. 4.nbt: {pages:['{"text":"In my passing glances at the artifact, I believe I understand what is happening, and what the power it is drawing from actually is. It seems this cube, an unsuspecting mass of wool, can control a fundamental certainty of the universe."}','{"text":"The force to which all life eventually succumbs, death.§0\\n§0\\n§0Rashem uses this seemingly absolute power for such trivial uses - crops that are unable to rot, soldiers that, even when killed, continue to rise for their cause."}','{"text":"These are such simple understandings of what this artifact can do. What a waste."}'],generation:0,Monumenta:{MMName:"<!italic><!underlined><!strikethrough><!bold><!obfuscated><gold>Chronicles of Hekawt, Vol. 4"},title:"b",author:"Vizier Hekawt",plain:{display:{Name:"Chronicles of Hekawt, Vol. 4"}},display:{Name:'{"bold":false,"italic":false,"underlined":false,"strikethrough":false,"obfuscated":false,"color":"gold","text":"Chronicles of Hekawt, Vol. 4"}'},resolved:1b}

Chronicles of Hekawt, Vol. 5.name: Chronicles of Hekawt, Vol. 5
Chronicles of Hekawt, Vol. 5.nbt: {pages:['{"text":"An idiom my father once told me:§0\\n§0\\n§0\\"Imagine sitting at a large dining table, which is filled with people in all of its seats. Before anyone has touched the table, to the left and right of every person will be a napkin."}','{"text":"In a sense, both napkins are yours until the first person decides to take one. However, if someone were to claim the napkin to their right, then the person next to them will have no choice but to claim the napkin on their right as well."}','{"text":"This cycle continues, and everyone at the table will take the napkin on their right, simply because that was the decision that the first person made.§0\\n§0\\n§0This is the cycle of politics, everything is uncertain in the world until someone"}','{"text":"decides to take the first napkin."}'],generation:0,Monumenta:{MMName:"<!italic><!underlined><!strikethrough><!bold><!obfuscated><gold>Chronicles of Hekawt, Vol. 5"},title:"b",author:"Vizier Hekawt",plain:{display:{Name:"Chronicles of Hekawt, Vol. 5"}},display:{Name:'{"bold":false,"italic":false,"underlined":false,"strikethrough":false,"obfuscated":false,"color":"gold","text":"Chronicles of Hekawt, Vol. 5"}'},resolved:1b}

Chronicles of Hekawt, Vol. 6.name: Chronicles of Hekawt, Vol. 6
Chronicles of Hekawt, Vol. 6.nbt: {pages:['{"text":"If I were to be discovered, I could easily be tried for high treason, but I cannot sit around any longer and watch this power be wasted. I have begun studying its power without the knowledge or consent of Rashem.§0\\n§0\\n§0I know a greater power yet still lies"}','{"text":"dormant within this artifact, waiting for someone with the capability to unlock it. The power to permanently ward off death, the path to immortality.§0\\n§0\\n§0This is the power I will discover for myself, and with it, I will set the course of"}','{"text":"this empire and its state in the world. I will create a world where my people no longer have to live in fear of death, and leave the suffering for the wretches of Chillwind and Viridia.§0\\n§0\\n§0I will be the one to take the first napkin."}'],generation:0,Monumenta:{MMName:"<!italic><!underlined><!strikethrough><!bold><!obfuscated><gold>Chronicles of Hekawt, Vol. 6"},title:"b",author:"Vizier Hekawt",plain:{display:{Name:"Chronicles of Hekawt, Vol. 6"}},display:{Name:'{"bold":false,"italic":false,"underlined":false,"strikethrough":false,"obfuscated":false,"color":"gold","text":"Chronicles of Hekawt, Vol. 6"}'},resolved:1b}

Chronicles of Hekawt, Vol. 7.name: Chronicles of Hekawt, Vol. 7
Chronicles of Hekawt, Vol. 7.nbt: {pages:['{"text":"Rashem has passed away, and his eldest son, Tehkma Ka, is set to take the throne of pharaoh. §0\\n§0\\n§0I have been around Tehkma since he was a boy, so I am firm that my position is safe, and I will continue to be able to study the artifact."}','{"text":"Speaking of which, Tehkma is set to be named the new \\"Bearer of Cironds\\", as they have adorned. How overly flashy and extravagant.§0\\n§0\\n§0Now it seems I have to write an elegy for Rashem. Even in death, he continues to waste my time."}'],generation:0,Monumenta:{MMName:"<!italic><!underlined><!strikethrough><!bold><!obfuscated><gold>Chronicles of Hekawt, Vol. 7"},title:"v",author:"Vizier Hekawt",plain:{display:{Name:"Chronicles of Hekawt, Vol. 7"}},display:{Name:'{"bold":false,"italic":false,"underlined":false,"strikethrough":false,"obfuscated":false,"color":"gold","text":"Chronicles of Hekawt, Vol. 7"}'},resolved:1b}

Chronicles of Hekawt, Vol. 8.name: Chronicles of Hekawt, Vol. 8
Chronicles of Hekawt, Vol. 8.nbt: {pages:['{"text":"Quite the unexpected development, it seems my strenuous use of the artifact has caused some unanticipated side effects, and the soil has been tainted by its power.§0\\n§0\\n§0Farmers are unable to kill their livestock for long enough to gather"}','{"text":"the meat, and citizens long since deceased have begun walking the streets. I find some humor in the fact that I have not yet had Rashem\'s grimey hands banging on my chamber door.§0\\n§0\\n§0Regardless, these consequences are minor"}','{"text":"in comparison to the research I am accomplishing. Besides, I am not even in the spotlight of blame. The people are calling out Tehkma for his family\'s use of the artifact.§0\\n§0\\n§0I suppose that horrid title of bearer came in handy for me after all."}'],generation:0,Monumenta:{MMName:"<!italic><!underlined><!strikethrough><!bold><!obfuscated><gold>Chronicles of Hekawt, Vol. 8"},title:"b",author:"Vizier Hekawt",plain:{display:{Name:"Chronicles of Hekawt, Vol. 8"}},display:{Name:'{"bold":false,"italic":false,"underlined":false,"strikethrough":false,"obfuscated":false,"color":"gold","text":"Chronicles of Hekawt, Vol. 8"}'},resolved:1b}

Construct Log I.name: Construct Log I
Construct Log I.nbt: {pages:['{"text":"Preparations for the battle for the Loamskattar have been finalized. In the coming days, we shall make our move.\\n\\nOur forces have been split in three. Those on the ground will cut through the overgrowth, striking down any residents"}','{"text":"which attempt to interfere.\\n\\nThe Blackflame riders will offer support from the air, picking off stragglers attempting to escape, and burning through the thick foliage on the outskirts, granting passage to the constructs."}','{"text":"We do not have many constructs, but they have been built specifically for this purpose. \\n\\nI am fortunate enough to have been selected for this position, alongside Axxil and Hazeel. \\n"}','{"text":"Our aim is to disrupt and destroy the island’s foundation, leaving it vulnerable to the cage the Architect has prepared. \\n\\nLord Uriddan will ensnare the manifestation when our work is finished.\\n"}','{"text":"The Architect has made clear that this will be one of the greatest threats our order has faced as a collective thus far. \\n\\nWe will do our best to minimize losses, but I fear they are inevitable.\\n"}','{"text":"Any losses will hurt deeply. But there are some I would fear more than others. Axxil may be safer piloting a construct, but Tuulen will be fighting on the ground...\\n\\nWe will need to convene before the battle.\\n"}','{"text":"One last night together, in the case that luck forsakes us. \\nThat will have to be enough...\\n"}'],Enchantments:[{lvl:1s,id:"minecraft:power"}],Monumenta:{MMName:"<!italic><!underlined><!bold><gold>Construct Log I",MMLore:["A documented account extracted","from the construct's databank."]},HideFlags:1,title:"b",author:"Silver Knight Irrus",plain:{display:{Name:"Construct Log I",Lore:["A documented account extracted","from the construct's databank."]}},display:{Name:'{"bold":false,"italic":false,"underlined":false,"color":"gold","text":"Construct Log I"}',Lore:['{"italic":false,"color":"dark_gray","extra":["A documented account extracted"],"text":""}','{"italic":false,"color":"dark_gray","extra":["from the construct\'s databank."],"text":""}']}}

Construct Log II.name: Construct Log II
Construct Log II.nbt: {pages:['{"text":"The manifestation of Space has been contained. We have succeeded... but at great cost.\\n\\nMany of our order have been lost in the struggle - more than we had hoped. Even Hazeel\'s construct was lost alongside him...\\n \\n"}','{"text":"To think, something so aimless could be so dangerous... The prison will not hold on its own, this much has been made clear.\\n\\nIt requires a warden, a keeper. The Architect has decided that Lord Uriddan would best fit the role. "}','{"text":"Many of us are... uneasy, of the prospect of losing our leader - of what will come of our order in the time after. \\n\\nBut... the Architect has made His will known, and we shall follow it.\\n\\n...without question..."}','{"text":"I have been unsure of my destination in the coming days. \\n\\nTuulen has requested my accompaniment in a journey to the Isles, from which we have received word of the Malefactor\'s capture. \\n"}','{"text":"I am considering her offer, but I am as of yet unsure if I will accept. "}'],Enchantments:[{lvl:1s,id:"minecraft:power"}],Monumenta:{MMName:"<!italic><!underlined><!bold><gold>Construct Log II",MMLore:["A documented account extracted","from the construct's databank."]},HideFlags:1,title:"b",author:"Silver Knight Irrus",plain:{display:{Name:"Construct Log II",Lore:["A documented account extracted","from the construct's databank."]}},display:{Name:'{"bold":false,"italic":false,"underlined":false,"color":"gold","text":"Construct Log II"}',Lore:['{"italic":false,"color":"dark_gray","extra":["A documented account extracted"],"text":""}','{"italic":false,"color":"dark_gray","extra":["from the construct\'s databank."],"text":""}']}}

Construct Log III.name: Construct Log III
Construct Log III.nbt: {pages:['{"text":"Plans have changed. A Knight has been slain, and two prisons stolen as a result.\\n\\nThe Architect is furious, as is Uriddan. All available Knights are to mobilize to the Isles to take part in this war. \\n"}','{"text":"It is strange, to see one of our own felled under such circumstances, and so soon after our previous battle. \\n\\nIt is... a reminder that we are not as invulnerable as we would like to think.\\n"}','{"text":"In addition, the Architect has requested something of me, personally - a mission to carry out in tandem to my participation in the war.\\n\\nI have been entrusted with the Black prison, to relocate it to its proper resting place."}','{"text":"I fear... This is not a journey I will survive.\\n\\nI have been making my peace with this prospect. As Lord Uriddan must ascend to perform his duty, I will as well.. I only regret that I could not have joined Tuulen on that journey. \\n"}','{"text":"I trust she will manage on her own. She will have allies, and she is strong enough. And, yet..."}','{"text":"There is no time for reflection. Not now.\\n\\nWe must travel to the Isles, and do what must be done. I will fulfill my duty, as best as I can. \\n\\nSuch is the Architect\'s will.\\n"}'],Enchantments:[{lvl:1s,id:"minecraft:power"}],Monumenta:{MMName:"<!italic><!underlined><!bold><gold>Construct Log III",MMLore:["A documented account extracted","from the construct's databank."]},HideFlags:1,title:"b",author:"Silver Knight Irrus",plain:{display:{Name:"Construct Log III",Lore:["A documented account extracted","from the construct's databank."]}},display:{Name:'{"bold":false,"italic":false,"underlined":false,"color":"gold","text":"Construct Log III"}',Lore:['{"italic":false,"color":"dark_gray","extra":["A documented account extracted"],"text":""}','{"italic":false,"color":"dark_gray","extra":["from the construct\'s databank."],"text":""}']}}

Corridor Notes.nbt: {pages:['{"text":"It\\u0027s been about 2 weeks since I initially lost contact with my research group. Departure (written_book).nbt: {pages:['{"text":"It\'s been two months since my people betrayed me. Aphelios betrayed me. To even think of it, I granted them the freedom and a place to call home! We shared a vision! Or so I\'ve thought... Yet, he chose to leave us alone and others followed him. I hope they all rot in the afterlife now.\\n "}','{"text":"I left Xanatull five weeks ago along with a few loyal brothers and sisters. We sailed to the remnants of Aphelion Isle. Deep below, I found the Herald of the Skies - Andromeda. And took what\'s rightfully mine. I was granted a vague vision of a place far from my home, but\\nI\'ve yet to know the\\n "}','{"text":"name. Soon, The Stars will tell me. Soon, I\'ll be Eternal.\\n\\nAlas, my time in this precious little Valley coming to an end. I shall depart soon. It may be selfish to leave my people, but I promised them a better future. And I\'ll keep my promise, even if it means to abandon "}','{"text":"them for the time being. \\n\\nThe Stars granted me another vision. This time of a wool of the great power, hidden in the land far beyond this Valley. \\n\\nWith the Shard of Andromeda, I shall \\ncreate a portal beyond these walls."}','{"text":"I will go alone. I must go alone, for The Stars whisper only my name. I can only hope my brothers and sisters will understand me.\\n\\nTheir faith in me and my ideals won\'t be forgotten. May the stars shine bright for them.\\n "}','{"text":"It\'s been a long journey for me and my people, but I must go on. With the power of Inversion, I shall stand among the gods beyond this world. "}'],title:"Departure",author:"Aurora",resolved:1b}

mmlore: <!italic><!underlined><!strikethrough><!bold><!obfuscated><light_purple>* Quest Item *
Diary.name: Diary
Diary.nbt: {pages:['{"text":"It\\u0027s my first day at the Outpost and I already feel overwhelmed. The threat of the Lord felt almost nonexistent in books and reports, but now being so close I am beginning to feel fear. I can sense the other monks feel it too, so at least I\\u0027m not alone."}','{"text":"I\\u0027ve spent most of my time in the study to keep my mind off of the looming threat. It was stupid to volunteer to be stationed here, no matter how important it is. I can\\u0027t believe I let Aesir talk me into this."}','{"text":"The warding rituals failed today so everyone has fortified themselves deep within the Outpost. While the others cower I\\u0027m trying to find a way to counter the Lord\\u0027s denial of our defences. Aesir is trying to rally the others to be proactive as well, but"}','{"text":"I think that the fear is too great within them to best it."}','{"text":"The demons have been set loose on us. We all knew it was coming, we all feared it, and now it is finally happening. It\\u0027s now or never to find a way to beat the Lord."}','{"text":"It\\u0027s a terrible plan, but it\\u0027s all we\\u0027ve got. Aesir believes in it much more than I do, even though I came up with it. Tonight we will lay siege to the mansion. Tonight we will end Lord Azacor once and for all."}'],generation:0,Enchantments:[{lvl:1s,id:"minecraft:power"}],Monumenta:{MMName:"<!italic><gold>Diary",MMLore:["<!italic><!underlined><!strikethrough><!bold><!obfuscated><light_purple>* Quest Item *","#Q45I01"]},HideFlags:1,title:"Diary",author:"Helring",plain:{display:{Name:"Diary",Lore:["* Quest Item *","#Q45I01"]}},display:{Name:'{"italic":false,"color":"gold","text":"Diary"}',Lore:['{"italic":false,"color":"dark_gray","extra":[{"bold":false,"italic":false,"underlined":false,"strikethrough":false,"obfuscated":false,"color":"light_purple","text":"* Quest Item *"}],"text":""}','{"italic":false,"color":"dark_gray","extra":["#Q45I01"],"text":""}']},resolved:1b}

Dive Into Dissonance, Vol. 1.name: Dive Into Dissonance, Vol. 1
Dive Into Dissonance, Vol. 1.nbt: {pages:['{"text":"It seemed like a normal day in the Arboretum. We went about our daily routines, seeking the enlightenment and gifts that Harmony blessed us with.\\n\\nAs I sat on my knees, praying that today be the day I received my gift, I began to hear"}','{"text":"a whisper calling to me. It was... faint, at least at first.\\n\\nIt was a sensation similar to when you re-enact a memory in your mind. A faint memory of someone calling my name.\\n\\nThis is why I did not pay it much mind."}'],Monumenta:{MMName:"<!italic><!underlined><!strikethrough><!bold><!obfuscated><red>Dive Into Dissonance, Vol. 1"},title:"b1",author:"Brother Pekom",plain:{display:{Name:"Dive Into Dissonance, Vol. 1"}},display:{Name:'{"bold":false,"italic":false,"underlined":false,"strikethrough":false,"obfuscated":false,"color":"red","text":"Dive Into Dissonance, Vol. 1"}'},resolved:1b}

Dive Into Dissonance, Vol. 2.name: Dive Into Dissonance, Vol. 2
Dive Into Dissonance, Vol. 2.nbt: {pages:['{"text":"That faint whisper did not take very long to grow louder, however. It soon felt as if someone was always standing behind me, always out of reach of my view.\\n\\nIt taunted me with horrible thoughts. Horrible, abhorrent thoughts that made"}','{"text":"me question my sanity.\\nI needed to uncover its source, lest my mind crumble under the immeasurable strain.\\n\\nI always noticed when it was loudest - it was always when I was near Harmony. It made me question, was this my gift?"}','{"text":"I knew the consequences of touching Harmony before the Father deemed it your time, but I had little other option. I had to resolve this quickly.\\n\\nI reached out, my hand drawing so near to it that I could feel"}','{"text":"its very radiance warming my skin.\\n\\nBut.. before I could make contact, I began to... fall, I suppose is the closest approximation of that feeling.\\n\\nI looked around at the room I stood in. It was... similar to where"}','{"text":"I had been previously, but it was also very different. A horrid mass of living tissue covered the room, and a foul odor filled my lungs.\\n\\nI don\'t know what twisted reality I fell into, but this certainly was not the Arboretum I once knew."}'],Monumenta:{MMName:"<!italic><!underlined><!strikethrough><!bold><!obfuscated><red>Dive Into Dissonance, Vol. 2"},title:"b2",author:"Brother Pekom",plain:{display:{Name:"Dive Into Dissonance, Vol. 2"}},display:{Name:'{"bold":false,"italic":false,"underlined":false,"strikethrough":false,"obfuscated":false,"color":"red","text":"Dive Into Dissonance, Vol. 2"}'},resolved:1b}

Dive Into Dissonance, Vol. 3.name: Dive Into Dissonance, Vol. 3
Dive Into Dissonance, Vol. 3.nbt: {pages:['{"text":"I have to find places to hide at practically any chance I can. The hallways here are littered with monstrous creatures.\\n\\nAbominations of life that also seem to be twisted forms of creatures from my world. I can almost tell what they once may"}','{"text":"have been, before they slipped into this reality.\\n\\nThe most frightening, however, are those that I can make out were once human. It pains me to see them in such a state, having lost all sense of who they once were."}','{"text":"I\'ve attempted making contact on a couple occassions, but it yielded no result other than me being chased through the halls.\\n\\nI wonder... Will I too become one of them given enough time in this place?"}','{"text":"Does this world\'s malevolence corrupt one\'s very soul, given enough time? I hope I can find a way out before that question is answered for me.\\n\\nAs I write this, it occurs to me that I have not heard that horrible voice since entering this realm."}','{"text":"I find it hard to determine if that is a positive sign or not."}'],Monumenta:{MMName:"<!italic><!underlined><!strikethrough><!bold><!obfuscated><red>Dive Into Dissonance, Vol. 3"},title:"b3",author:"Brother Pekom",plain:{display:{Name:"Dive Into Dissonance, Vol. 3"}},display:{Name:'{"bold":false,"italic":false,"underlined":false,"strikethrough":false,"obfuscated":false,"color":"red","text":"Dive Into Dissonance, Vol. 3"}'},resolved:1b}

Dive Into Dissonance, Vol. 4.name: Dive Into Dissonance, Vol. 4
Dive Into Dissonance, Vol. 4.nbt: {pages:['{"text":"Roughly five days have passed since I entered this place. Or at least, I think it\'s been five days... without a sun, it\'s hard to tell time in a world of perpetual darkness.\\n\\nI have made something of a breakthrough though."}','{"text":"I managed to capture one of the creatures that dwell here. This one though... this one is much different than the others.\\n\\nIt does not show any sign of corruption, at least not in the same way. I cannot make out any distinguishable features that indicate"}','{"text":"a counterpart in my reality. This thing... what is it...\\n\\nIt speaks to itself, in some indiscernible language. It\'s almost as if it\'s asking questions, and... receiving answers from itself."}','{"text":"I wonder... this thing, whatever it may be, could it actually be from this place? A native being to this horrible world?\\n\\nThat thought almost terrifies me. It took basically everything I had to restrain it. If it originates from here, then that would imply..."}','{"text":"...there are others.\\n\\nWhat if... it\'s not really speaking to just itself..."}'],Monumenta:{MMName:"<!italic><!underlined><!strikethrough><!bold><!obfuscated><red>Dive Into Dissonance, Vol. 4"},title:"b4",author:"Brother Pekom",plain:{display:{Name:"Dive Into Dissonance, Vol. 4"}},display:{Name:'{"bold":false,"italic":false,"underlined":false,"strikethrough":false,"obfuscated":false,"color":"red","text":"Dive Into Dissonance, Vol. 4"}'},resolved:1b}

Dive Into Dissonance, Vol. 5.name: Dive Into Dissonance, Vol. 5
Dive Into Dissonance, Vol. 5.nbt: {pages:['{"text":"It spoke to me today, or rather... it communicated with me. It placed words in my head, in the same awful way that voice once did, without actually \\"speaking\\".\\n\\nIt told me it was... connected to its brothers, linked through some unseen\\n"}','{"text":"thread that binds them together.\\n\\nThey are born of something much greater. An ancient being that has resided in this world for a length of time that I cannot even begin to comprehend."}','{"text":"They are tasked by this ancient one to wander this endless void, seeking out passages into the larger web of reality.\\n\\nAnd from that web, they search for an entrance into my world. It refused to say why..."}','{"text":"But... they once felt a rumble, a ripple through the realm that caught the attention of that ancient being. It sent them here to investigate, and they found something unbelievable.\\n\\nA perfect copy of the Arboretum, grafted"}','{"text":"into the very fabric of this realm\'s existance by some unseen force.\\n\\nAnd what they found inside..."}'],Monumenta:{MMName:"<!italic><!underlined><!strikethrough><!bold><!obfuscated><red>Dive Into Dissonance, Vol. 5"},title:"b5",author:"Brother Pekom",plain:{display:{Name:"Dive Into Dissonance, Vol. 5"}},display:{Name:'{"bold":false,"italic":false,"underlined":false,"strikethrough":false,"obfuscated":false,"color":"red","text":"Dive Into Dissonance, Vol. 5"}'},resolved:1b}

Dive Into Dissonance, Vol. 6.name: Dive Into Dissonance, Vol. 6
Dive Into Dissonance, Vol. 6.nbt: {pages:['{"text":"I\'m... running out of time...\\n\\nIt seems this world has finally taken its grasp upon my soul...\\n\\nI can feel myself slipping away, as my skin becomes numb and my vision tunnels."}','{"text":"I must... write down one last thing that the creature told me... before it expired its time with me...\\n\\nWhen they arrived in this place, when they found... what was inside...\\n\\nOne of its countless brothers took hold of"}','{"text":"it... It morphed into... something much more than it once was...\\n\\nIt was a monster among monsters... And since it was connected to that... thing...\\n\\nSuch a powerful creature having indirect control of Dissonance..."}','{"text":"It\'s what was speaking to me... It used Dissonance\'s eternal connection to Harmony to... to speak through the rift between worlds...\\n\\nMy people... he speaks to them all now..."}'],Monumenta:{MMName:"<!italic><!underlined><!strikethrough><!bold><!obfuscated><red>Dive Into Dissonance, Vol. 6"},title:"b6",author:"Brother Pekom",plain:{display:{Name:"Dive Into Dissonance, Vol. 6"}},display:{Name:'{"bold":false,"italic":false,"underlined":false,"strikethrough":false,"obfuscated":false,"color":"red","text":"Dive Into Dissonance, Vol. 6"}'},resolved:1b}

Dread Admiral's Notes.name: Dread Admiral's Notes
Dread Admiral's Notes.nbt: {pages:['{"text":"Victory favors the silent. Davey left today. The idiot has been listening to the \\"prophet\\" of the Deep and decided it was his time to \\"sink\\".\\n\\nOf course he\'s going to sink. The moron can\'t swim.\\n\\nBut really, I wish him the best. With him gone,"}','{"text":"I\'m in command of the vessel. This would be properly magnificent if he hadn\'t ANCHORED THE DAMN BOAT.\\n\\nHe\'s lucky he left. I\'d have killed him if he hadn\'t.\\n\\nMind you, I can\'t even just raise the anchor because we were mid-jump and now the"}','{"text":"Black Mist has been left moored in the center of an endless ocean somewhere in the depths of the Veil. Raising the anchor without the proper evasive maneuvers just leaves my crew even worse off than just sitting here anchored.\\n\\nSo for now, we\'ll make"}','{"text":"do where we are, while I work on getting us out of here. It\'s not like we need supplies - we\'re all dead anyway.\\n\\nI hate my job."}'],Monumenta:{MMName:"<!italic><!underlined><!strikethrough><!bold><!obfuscated><white>Dread Admiral's Notes"},title:"Dread Admiral",author:"Dread Admiral Elise",plain:{display:{Name:"Dread Admiral's Notes"}},display:{Name:'{"bold":false,"italic":false,"underlined":false,"strikethrough":false,"obfuscated":false,"color":"white","text":"Dread Admiral\'s Notes"}'},resolved:1b}
