Elegy of My Dearest Friend.name: Elegy of My Dearest Friend
Elegy of My Dearest Friend.nbt: {pages:['{"extra":[{"text":"As I sit here, I find myself at a loss. Why did this happen? Why did it have to happen now? Why was I not there fast enough?"},{"text":"\\n"},{"text":"\\n"},{"text":"The number of questions I could ask myself, that I could ask the gods, is astronomical. Yet, I can\\u0027t see myself"}],"text":""}','{"extra":[{"text":"getting any of the answers I seek. No amount of questioning, no amount of emotional lashing, will allow me to wake up and see her again."},{"text":"\\n"},{"text":"\\n"},{"text":"My best form of outlet, I find, is recalling the time we had together, the time she became my"}],"text":""}','{"extra":[{"text":"associate, the time she became my dearest friend."}],"text":""}','{"extra":[{"text":"A Chance Meeting:"},{"text":"\\n"},{"text":"\\n"},{"text":"Nelfine was born in the Chillwind Tundra, with a thirst for adventure that set in at an early age. She was the youngest member to be accepted, and after many years of experience in the Celsian Isles, she"}],"text":""}','{"extra":[{"text":"was transferred to Highwatch."},{"text":"\\n"},{"text":"\\n"},{"text":"Ironically, I was also chosen to be placed in Highwatch at this time. I had a few more years on her, but the thought never once occurred to me that she was an inferior in any way. Nelfine was quick to learn the"}],"text":""}','{"extra":[{"text":"ropes of the King\\u0027s Valley, and soon our unexpected assignment together blossomed into a long lasting partnership."}],"text":""}','{"extra":[{"text":"Time Changes All:"},{"text":"\\n"},{"text":"\\n"},{"text":"Over the years, our work became more and more strenuous. While there was never a dull moment, the constant influx of demands certainly took its toll on us."},{"text":"\\n"},{"text":"\\n"},{"text":"Often, she would come to me in times of"}],"text":""}','{"extra":[{"text":"great emotional distress, often due to over exhaustion, and pour her heart out. In times like these, I found that she took great comfort in the memories of her homeland. As someone who had never strayed far from the King\\u0027s Valley for long periods of time,"}],"text":""}','{"extra":[{"text":"I was left to wonder how much the distance was getting to her."},{"text":"\\n"},{"text":"\\n"},{"text":"Unfortunately, I got the answer to that question far sooner than I anticipated. She came to me one morning, with tearful eyes, asking to be transferred back to the Tundra. I could"}],"text":""}','{"extra":[{"text":"tell how much it hurt her to ask me for such a favor, knowing that it would mean we would no longer be able to see each other. "},{"text":"\\n"},{"text":"\\n"},{"text":"I did not hesitate, though, and approved her request without question. I knew being here would only make"}],"text":""}','{"extra":[{"text":"it worse for her. However, these many years later, I must wonder, what would have happened had I denied her request? Would she still be here today? Would she hate me for not allowing her to return home? These are questions I am cursed to forever ponder."}],"text":""}','{"extra":[{"text":"Seeing You Once More:"},{"text":"\\n"},{"text":"\\n"},{"text":"Three long years after her departure from Highwatch, I received a parcel one morning, informing me of a meeting set in Farr. The topics of said meeting were left rather vague, but the letter stated who I would be meeting with:"}],"text":""}','{"extra":[{"text":"\\"Head of Intercontinental Intelligence, Nelfine\\"."},{"text":"\\n"},{"text":"\\n"},{"text":"The excitement I felt was like no other. I hardly cared about what the meeting was about anymore, as I would be able to see my friend once more, in my hometown of all places. When the"}],"text":""}','{"extra":[{"text":"specified date came, I was more nervous than I likely should have been, but so many questions were in my head. How had you changed? How had I changed? Did your time back home bring that smile back to your face? Could I, perhaps, return with you?"}],"text":""}','{"extra":[{"text":"Fate, however, chose that these would be more questions that I would be cursed to never receive an answer to. When I arrived in Farr, the smoke had hardly even cleared. An explosion, they told me, caused after a surprise attack on the city. What horrid"}],"text":""}','{"extra":[{"text":"magic had been used to cause such destruction?"},{"text":"\\n"},{"text":"\\n"},{"text":"The death toll was unclear, bodies were found every few hours. Yours however, never was. I searched for you, day and night, for weeks on end. Even as the rubble was"}],"text":""}','{"extra":[{"text":"removed, as the city was cleared up, I continued to look for you. I knew you had to be out there somewhere, but you eluded me."},{"text":"\\n"},{"text":"\\n"},{"text":"After spending months in Farr, I returned to Highwatch. I continued at my position, and"}],"text":""}','{"extra":[{"text":"yet, even after three years, it remains an empty post without my partner."}],"text":""}','{"extra":[{"text":"A Horrid Reminder:"},{"text":"\\n"},{"text":"\\n"},{"text":"It was been many years since I opened up this journal, yet the words still run through my mind as if they are freshly written."},{"text":"\\n"},{"text":"\\n"},{"text":"I received a letter today, marked with her name. It spoke"}],"text":""}','{"extra":[{"text":"nonsense of being trapped in a cell for a few weeks and lost memories. How could someone be so despicable as to prank a man of my age with something like this? It is a cruel reminder of the event which was tormented my existence."}],"text":""}','{"extra":[{"text":"I believe it is my time. I can no longer stay in Highwatch, so I shall announce my immediate retirement tomorrow. I shall return to Farr for the first time in 30 years, and there I shall die. I shall end my saga where it began, and where her story ended."}],"text":""}','{"extra":[{"text":"Then, Nelfine, will we see each other once more? What a fitting end for a tortured soul, for I am cursed with questions that shall never be answered."}],"text":""}'],generation:0,Enchantments:[{lvl:1s,id:"minecraft:power"}],Monumenta:{MMName:"<!italic><gold>Elegy of My Dearest Friend",MMLore:["<!italic><!underlined><!strikethrough><!bold><!obfuscated><light_purple>* Quest Item *","#Q24I01"]},HideFlags:1,title:"Elegy of My Dearest Friend",author:"Arian",plain:{display:{Name:"Elegy of My Dearest Friend",Lore:["* Quest Item *","#Q24I01"]}},display:{Name:'{"italic":false,"color":"gold","text":"Elegy of My Dearest Friend"}',Lore:['{"italic":false,"color":"dark_gray","extra":[{"bold":false,"italic":false,"underlined":false,"strikethrough":false,"obfuscated":false,"color":"light_purple","text":"* Quest Item *"}],"text":""}','{"italic":false,"color":"dark_gray","extra":["#Q24I01"],"text":""}']},resolved:1b}

Elegy of the Pharaoh.name: Elegy of the Pharaoh
Elegy of the Pharaoh.nbt: {pages:['{"text":"Rashem Ka, upon whom Cironds shines and from whom his glory is reflected.§0\\n§0\\n§0Bearer of that which channels his power into this world, protector of the sands.§0\\n§0\\n§0Pharaoh of the desert lands and rightful heir to the glory and "}','{"text":"fertility of Ishnir. §0\\n§0\\n§0Blood of the deity, whom sits on high, through the rebirth that has been and shall forever be.§0\\n§0\\n§0\\n§0In this place, the final reproach for your mortal coil, we lay thy flesh and drain thy"}','{"text":"blood, so that you may now be purified.§0\\n§0\\n§0Through his guidance,§0\\n§0thy soul shall transcend and return to the blood as those have done before you.§0\\n§0\\n§0May thy spirit prosper in this new life, and guide he who follows thy path - Son of the Sun, Blood of the"}','{"text":"Deity, Successor to the Throne of Ishnir, thy one and only child, Tehkma Ka."}'],generation:0,Monumenta:{MMName:"<!italic><!underlined><!strikethrough><!bold><!obfuscated><gold>Elegy of the Pharaoh"},title:"b",author:"Unknown",plain:{display:{Name:"Elegy of the Pharaoh"}},display:{Name:'{"bold":false,"italic":false,"underlined":false,"strikethrough":false,"obfuscated":false,"color":"gold","text":"Elegy of the Pharaoh"}'},resolved:1b}

Eternal Light.nbt: {pages:['{"text":"Once upon the winter\\u0027s snow§0\\n§0\\n§0I graced a sheep\\u0027s eternal glow§0\\n§0\\n§0Its nature flowed from brilliant Light§0\\n§0\\n§0And filled my pathway through the night"}','{"text":"But from that Light my life was chained§0\\n§0\\n§0And through its glow my soul was stained§0\\n§0\\n§0I walked with shame and tears of sorrow§0\\n§0\\n§0Would I still glow come the morrow?"}','{"text":"They soon mistook my burning strife§0\\n§0\\n§0And to my glow dedicate their life§0\\n§0\\n§0A palace of mirrors reflects my name§0\\n§0\\n§0And long I yearned to be the same"}','{"text":"But now I stand before the halls§0\\n§0\\n§0And see now where fate to me calls§0\\n§0\\n§0In this place my soul shall spark§0\\n§0\\n§0For where there\\u0027s light, there must be dark"}'],generation:0,Monumenta:{MMName:"<!italic><!underlined><!strikethrough><!bold><!obfuscated><gold>Eternal Light"},title:"b",author:"Alutana",plain:{display:{Name:"Eternal Light"}},display:{Name:'{"bold":false,"italic":false,"underlined":false,"strikethrough":false,"obfuscated":false,"color":"gold","text":"Eternal Light"}'},resolved:1b}

mmlore: <light_purple>* Quest Item *
Event Horizon (written_book).name: Event Horizon
Event Horizon (written_book).nbt: {pages:['{"text":"Here I stand, hours counting down to the moment my vigil ends.\\n\\nFor years, I have waited for the survivors to construct their new eternal home.\\n\\nSoon, their work will have concluded, and mine will finally begin.","color":"black"}','{"text":"I find myself thinking, in these moments, of what we have done to reach this point.\\n\\nOf the battles we have fought, and of those we have lost.\\n\\nOf the people I have brought to this place."}','{"text":"Perhaps we were too cruel to the people of that empire, unknowing and innocent of the crimes of their emperor.\\n\\nPerhaps this was necessary. Perhaps this was not. It is impossible to say, now. What is done is done."}','{"text":"But in the end, the death of a Knight is a tragedy in and of itself - and when said death is not only done with intent, but in service of the theft of our work?\\n\\nIt can not be forgiven. What happened to his empire was deserved."}','{"text":"Yet, still... I find myself hoping these survivors might find happiness in their new life.\\n\\nThey will be granted a new purpose, one which I believe they are more than capable of fulfilling."}','{"text":"Such is their gift from the Architect - a place to start over.\\n\\nSoon, I must depart.\\n\\nSoon, I will see this world for the very last time. ","color":"black"}','{"text":"I will miss it, of course...\\n\\nBut such is the will of the Architect.\\n\\nAnd it must be done.","color":"black"}'],Enchantments:[{lvl:1s,id:"minecraft:power"}],Monumenta:{MMName:"<!italic><!underlined><!bold><gold>Event Horizon",MMLore:["<light_purple>* Quest Item *","#Q156I09"]},HideFlags:1,title:"Event Horizon",author:"Silver Knight Irrus",plain:{display:{Name:"Event Horizon",Lore:["* Quest Item *","#Q156I09"]}},display:{Name:'{"bold":false,"italic":false,"underlined":false,"color":"gold","text":"Event Horizon"}',Lore:['{"italic":false,"color":"dark_gray","extra":[{"color":"light_purple","text":"* Quest Item *"}],"text":""}','{"italic":false,"color":"dark_gray","extra":["#Q156I09"],"text":""}']}}

Excommunication.name: Excommunication
Excommunication.nbt: {pages:['{"text":"I am unsure how it occurred, but the bringer of gifts, our most sacred treasure, has been shorn in two.\\n\\nSalazar... He has always been a problem child amongst our kin. I had hoped that, when he came to us begging to be allowed back in, that he would have "}','{"text":"changed from his experiences with the outside world.\\n\\nAnd in fact, he had. Just not the way I had hoped. His greed seems to have consumed him, a desire for power that he seemingly once tasted. What happened to you, my child?"}','{"text":"What remains now... something about it disturbs me to my core. What once was a shining, pink symbol of Balance is now a lilac, and only brings about Harmony.\\n\\nI must wonder, does the other exist still? Somewhere beyond my reach?"}','{"text":"That idea makes me uneasy, a rose blade of only Dissonance.\\n\\nI can only hope now that we continue to receive gifts from it.\\n\\nAs for Salazar, his actions cannot go without repercussions. As much as it pains us, the decision was "}','{"text":"made to banish him, the first ever in our history.\\n\\nI hear he sought out the help of pirates, only for the deal to go sour. A man by the name of Varcosa now holds him.\\n\\nAs much as I wish I could continue"}','{"text":"to protect Salazar, it is not my place. That is not my world, and he must face the choices that brought him to this point.\\n\\nI wish him the best, he will need it."}'],generation:0,Enchantments:[{lvl:1s,id:"minecraft:power"}],Monumenta:{MMName:"<!italic><!underlined><!strikethrough><!bold><!obfuscated><gold>Excommunication",MMLore:["<!italic><!underlined><!strikethrough><!bold><!obfuscated><dark_gray>The book is adorned with the symbols","<!italic><!underlined><!strikethrough><!bold><!obfuscated><dark_gray>of the Order of Balance.","<!italic><!underlined><!strikethrough><!bold><!obfuscated><light_purple>* Quest Item *","#Q110I07"]},HideFlags:1,title:"b",author:"Father",plain:{display:{Name:"Excommunication",Lore:["The book is adorned with the symbols","of the Order of Balance.","* Quest Item *","#Q110I07"]}},display:{Name:'{"bold":false,"italic":false,"underlined":false,"strikethrough":false,"obfuscated":false,"color":"gold","text":"Excommunication"}',Lore:['{"italic":false,"color":"dark_gray","extra":[{"bold":false,"italic":false,"underlined":false,"strikethrough":false,"obfuscated":false,"color":"dark_gray","text":"The book is adorned with the symbols"}],"text":""}','{"italic":false,"color":"dark_gray","extra":[{"bold":false,"italic":false,"underlined":false,"strikethrough":false,"obfuscated":false,"color":"dark_gray","text":"of the Order of Balance."}],"text":""}','{"italic":false,"color":"dark_gray","extra":[{"bold":false,"italic":false,"underlined":false,"strikethrough":false,"obfuscated":false,"color":"light_purple","text":"* Quest Item *"}],"text":""}','{"italic":false,"color":"dark_gray","extra":["#Q110I07"],"text":""}']},resolved:1b}

Expedition Log No. 1-6772.name: Expedition Log No. 1-6772
Expedition Log No. 1-6772.nbt: {pages:['{"text":"Today, with little fanfare, the expedition team has been sent to investigate a disturbance Lord Salazar has discovered deep at the bottom of the Ocean. Searching for evidence of a \\"breach\\", they have been tasked to observe and report,"}','{"text":"then to return to Viridis with their findings. Instructions have been hand-delivered to Aternam and his chosen expeditionary partner and they have both agreed to the terms. There will be nothing beyond a search along the bottom of the ocean. They should return"}','{"text":"quickly. They will not get involved in anything they find. Lord Salazar believes whatever he is sensing is too dangerous to get involved.\\n\\nHe just needs this team to collect the knowledge he seeks and return. They must return."}'],plain:{display:{Name:"Expedition Log No. 1-6772"}},Monumenta:{MMName:"<!italic><!underlined><!strikethrough><!bold><!obfuscated><white>Expedition Log No. 1-6772"},display:{Name:'{"bold":false,"italic":false,"underlined":false,"strikethrough":false,"obfuscated":false,"color":"white","text":"Expedition Log No. 1-6772"}'},title:"Expedition Log",author:"Sellemon"}

Failure.nbt: {pages:['{"text":"I do not deserve C\'Zanil\'s forgiveness, but he has given it to me anyway. I suppose he always had a sense that I only joined the Tlaxans and his legion with my own goals in mind, but he trusted me still.\\n\\nWhen I returned from the catastrophe at the tower last night,"}','{"text":"he was waiting for me. He knew of my secret study, he knew of my plan, and he knew he could have never seen me again had I succeeded.\\n\\nA second attempt would be foolish, so I have a new goal in mind."}','{"text":"My incompetence has let fragments of the Bastion loose on the world, which need to be contained. C\'Zanil has permitted me to depart for a time to rectify this, for which I am thankful. I cannot return until my mistake is in safer hands."}'],title:"Failure",author:"Siershen",resolved:1b}

Forgive Me.name: Forgive Me
Forgive Me.nbt: {pages:['{"extra":[{"text":"I have found an amusing little book today. A Jaguar I released into the wilds was carrying it when I recaptured him. Fascinating. I have been written into their \\u0027lore\\u0027 now."},{"text":"\\n"},{"text":"\\n"},{"color":"black","text":"Experiments with the latest round of C\\u0027Shura\\u0027s wool have"}],"text":""}','{"extra":[{"text":"been quite a success. Ever since she was ordered to try and clean up C\\u0027Axtal\\u0027s failure, I have been alone."},{"text":"\\n"},{"text":"\\n"},{"color":"black","text":"The sole shaman."},{"text":"\\n"},{"text":"\\n"},{"color":"black","text":"It is a strange, lonesome feeling. The war still rages, yet my fellow shamans have"}],"text":""}','{"extra":[{"text":"failed so dramatically. C\\u0027Axtal is missing, presumed dead. C\\u0027Shura, the one who started all of this, has been sent to her doom."},{"text":"\\n"},{"text":"\\n"},{"color":"black","text":"Now here I am, failing too. Even with two wools on my side. Quetzal and Ixume should be showering blessings upon me."}],"text":""}','{"extra":[{"text":"Instead I find nothing but complications."},{"text":"\\n"},{"text":"\\n"},{"color":"black","text":"All I wanted to do was use the tribal Lunatics and give them beastial powers, much like C\\u0027Shura did for them. But I wanted to make it permanent. They would not need C\\u0027Shura. They could just"}],"text":""}','{"extra":[{"text":"stride into the battle, bristling with strength."},{"text":"\\n"},{"text":"\\n"},{"color":"black","text":"While it is working, they turn on me. The other Tlaxans are shifting away too. The end is in sight, and I am not so sure we will win this war against the vile assault of the invaders. Our home is"}],"text":""}','{"extra":[{"text":"being ripped from us. After all the sacrifices we have made, I am failing."},{"text":"\\n"},{"text":"\\n"},{"color":"black","text":"Ixume, please. Let me bear your power and infuse these beasts with your strength. I know not what else to do."},{"text":"\\n"},{"text":"\\n"},{"color":"black","text":"**C\\u0027Zanil, the Soulcrusher"}],"text":""}','{"extra":[{"text":"It has been several months."},{"text":"\\n"},{"text":"\\n"},{"color":"black","text":"We have lost."},{"text":"\\n"},{"text":"\\n"},{"color":"black","text":"I have fled the Halls of Wind and Blood, even fled my workshop nearby. I have created the Menagerie below the village the Serpensia beasts have formed."}],"text":""}','{"extra":[{"text":"It\\u0027s hidden within a set of tunnels they never dare enter. This might even be the safest place to store... It... Ixume himself."},{"text":"\\n"},{"text":"\\n"},{"color":"black","text":"We shall see how my experiments go. It may be time to try on creatures beyond just the Lunatics. I do not know."}],"text":""}','{"extra":[{"text":"I worry that I have failed my people. Even with Quetzal and Ixume\\u0027s icons in my grasp, I am not a leader for my people. The deaths I have caused... The toll may have been too great. They don\\u0027t need a Soulcrusher who perverted the role."}],"text":""}','{"extra":[{"text":"I did not crush souls, I created them. Ghosts flood the Halls."},{"text":"\\n"},{"text":"\\n"},{"color":"black","text":"Maybe they can find a new leader. Maybe I should remain here. With my experiments."},{"text":"\\n"},{"text":"\\n"},{"color":"black","text":"I can create better. If I do, perhaps my people will side with me again."}],"text":""}','{"extra":[{"color":"black","text":"I hope, for my sake and for theirs, C\\u0027Axtal and C\\u0027Shura return. Kaul has abandoned us and cursed the Sanctum. I have fled my people\\u0027s anger. They are truly alone."},{"text":"\\n"},{"text":"\\n"},{"color":"black","text":"**C\\u0027Zanil"}],"text":""}','{"extra":[{"text":"Today, I leave the Menagerie. My experiments were successful this time. Too much so."},{"text":"\\n"},{"text":"\\n"},{"color":"black","text":"I have sealed Ixume\\u0027s icon within the Menagerie, but from this moment on, it must be kept secret. The beasts are free. There is nowhere safe"}],"text":""}','{"extra":[{"text":"within those walls any more."},{"text":"\\n"},{"text":"\\n"},{"color":"black","text":"If anyone reads this, do not dare enter the tunnels below the Serpensia Village. Only death waits for you there."},{"text":"\\n"},{"text":"\\n"},{"color":"black","text":"I return to my workshop with my generals."}],"text":""}','{"extra":[{"text":"It is there I shall prepare to die, with them at my side."},{"text":"\\n"},{"text":"\\n"},{"color":"black","text":"Maybe one day my people will forgive me. Foundations.name: Foundations
Foundations.nbt: {pages:['{"text":"None of this would have been possible if not for the bravery and sacrifice of C\'Telsket, the founder of the Sons of the Forest. Following the endless failures of the traitorous shamans, C\'Zanil, C\'Shura, and C\'Axtal, and their numerous crimes, our people lost the war for our"}','{"text":"homelands against the colonizers and were forced to give up what was rightfully ours. Only C\'Telsket had the mindfulness to rebel. The Elders bowed to the colonizer\'s demands. New Shamans were appointed, merely puppets. But not C\'Telsket. He heard the voice of a once-"}','{"text":"forgotten god and began a search that saw him claim his rightful title as Shaman and, once renounced by Tlaxan leadership, form the Sons of the Forest. It was then he began strikes against the colonizers, seeking to free our people from their rule. He would not succeed."}'],Monumenta:{MMName:"<!italic><!underlined><!strikethrough><!bold><!obfuscated><white>Foundations"},title:"Foundations",author:"Tkenar",plain:{display:{Name:"Foundations"}},display:{Name:'{"bold":false,"italic":false,"underlined":false,"strikethrough":false,"obfuscated":false,"color":"white","text":"Foundations"}'},resolved:1b}

Freedom (written_book).nbt: {pages:['{"extra":[{"text":"Selxem told me of the dangers of the Plagueroot Temple, but he failed to tell me how well protected the Velara Fortress is. I\\u0027ve been trying my best to get inside. I need the crystals they create within. Even after years of attempts, I\\u0027ve not been able to"}],"text":""}','{"extra":[{"text":"replicate the magic they\\u0027ve created in here. I hate to do it and break the trust of the Tlaxans, but I need to steal a crystal."},{"text":"\\n"},{"text":"\\n"},{"color":"black","text":"There is no other way I can think of to successfully store the magic of my people\\u0027s tower"}],"text":""}','{"extra":[{"text":"and give them a way out of the bubble of time. If we can get them free of the bubble while leaving the Alchemists trapped with the wool, then I\\u0027ll have finally succeeded in my mission. I see no issue leaving the wool trapped. It\\u0027s safer that way."}],"text":""}','{"extra":[{"text":"I just want to finally free my people. This is all they have asked of me."}],"text":""}'],generation:0,title:"Freedom",author:"Siershen",resolved:1b}

mmlore: <italic><!underlined><!strikethrough><!bold><!obfuscated><aqua>Tutorial Book
General.nbt: {pages:['{"text":"\\"CTM\\" stands for \\"Complete the Monument\\". The objective of Monumenta is to quest for unique colored wool blocks and place them on The Monument at the end of each region."}','{"text":"The five wools to be found here in Region 1 are White, Orange, Magenta, Light Blue, and Yellow."}','{"text":"The wool blocks are the final reward of the \\"wool dungeons\\". These are long, difficult areas that need to be unlocked by exploring and discovering the entrances out in the world of Monumenta. "}','{"text":"Completing each wool dungeon for the first time also gives you a permanent skill point increase for your class upgrades. "}','{"text":"You may reset and change your class at any time for free across the hall in the Academy. This does not cause you to lose the skill points gained from conquering dungeons."}'],generation:0,Enchantments:[{lvl:1s,id:"minecraft:power"}],Monumenta:{MMLore:["<italic><!underlined><!strikethrough><!bold><!obfuscated><aqua>Tutorial Book"]},HideFlags:1,title:"General",author:"Sybil",plain:{display:{Lore:["Tutorial Book"]}},display:{Lore:['{"italic":false,"color":"dark_gray","extra":[{"bold":false,"italic":true,"underlined":false,"strikethrough":false,"obfuscated":false,"color":"aqua","text":"Tutorial Book"}],"text":""}']},resolved:1b}

Harbinger (written_book).name: Harbinger
Harbinger (written_book).nbt: {pages:['{"text":"I\'ve long sensed a disturbance below the waves, but I\'ve never been able to understand what it meant. My mind of course assumed ancient magics, sunken below these waves. I fear that I am wrong, however. I do not think these breaches, as I\'ve begun to call them, are normal."}','{"text":"I fear they are something beyond this world, breaking through...\\n\\nSeeking something..."}'],Monumenta:{MMName:"<!italic><!underlined><!strikethrough><!bold><!obfuscated><gold>Harbinger"},title:"Harbinger",author:"Salazar",plain:{display:{Name:"Harbinger"}},display:{Name:'{"bold":false,"italic":false,"underlined":false,"strikethrough":false,"obfuscated":false,"color":"gold","text":"Harbinger"}'},resolved:1b}

Hello Hero.nbt: {author:"Duchess Emmeline",pages:['["It\'s been a minute.\\nJust know I\'m still\\nwaiting for you. Loose\\nends need to be taken\\ncare of, after all. I\'ll\\nsee you soon, I\'m\\nsure."]'],title:"Hello Hero"}

Hopeless Reflection.name: Hopeless Reflection
Hopeless Reflection.nbt: {pages:['{"text":"Defendat Animabus Nostris.....\\n\\nThis was the spell that we used that day... The spell that ruined our lives....\\n\\nIt is a barrier spell, designed to protect us from the world above..."}','{"text":"Defendat Animabus Nostris.....\\n\\nWhat could have gone wrong.... Why did it have this outcome...\\n\\nSurely there must be something I\'m missing..."}','{"text":"Defendat Animabus Nostris.....\\n\\nIs the spell incorrect somehow? Is there a spelling error, or perhaps we mispoke the pronunciation?\\n\\nIt must be that, right?"}','{"text":"Defendat Animabus Nostris.....\\n\\nWHAT DID WE DO WRONG"}'],Enchantments:[{lvl:1s,id:"minecraft:power"}],Monumenta:{MMName:"<!italic><!underlined><!strikethrough><!bold><!obfuscated><gold>Hopeless Reflection",MMLore:["<!italic><!underlined><!strikethrough><!bold><!obfuscated><dark_gray>Relatively well preserved, considering","<!italic><!underlined><!strikethrough><!bold><!obfuscated><dark_gray>the circumstances."]},HideFlags:1,title:"C",author:"Unknown",plain:{display:{Name:"Hopeless Reflection",Lore:["Relatively well preserved, considering","the circumstances."]}},display:{Name:'{"bold":false,"italic":false,"underlined":false,"strikethrough":false,"obfuscated":false,"color":"gold","text":"Hopeless Reflection"}',Lore:['{"italic":false,"color":"dark_gray","extra":[{"bold":false,"italic":false,"underlined":false,"strikethrough":false,"obfuscated":false,"color":"dark_gray","text":"Relatively well preserved, considering"}],"text":""}','{"italic":false,"color":"dark_gray","extra":[{"bold":false,"italic":false,"underlined":false,"strikethrough":false,"obfuscated":false,"color":"dark_gray","text":"the circumstances."}],"text":""}']},resolved:1b}

Horrible Feeling.name: Horrible Feeling
Horrible Feeling.nbt: {pages:['{"text":"It was, of course, the Sons of the Forest. This we knew. The Outsider Made Conduit saw to their proper end. Still, there is a lurking darkness within. There are still surviving on the power flowing through this place. I\'ve not found any physical evidence yet, but I can feel it. This magic"}','{"text":"seeks to rip apart this reality and substitute it with its own will.\\n\\nI do not think the darkest god is of the same flesh as our gods. I am not even sure it is a god in the same way. Something horrible is happening. I will get to the bottom of it. I must keep my"}','{"text":"mind strong. I must steel my will against this sliver of darkness and remain whole. I must."}'],plain:{display:{Name:"Horrible Feeling"}},Monumenta:{MMName:"<!italic><!underlined><!strikethrough><!bold><!obfuscated><white>Horrible Feeling"},display:{Name:'{"bold":false,"italic":false,"underlined":false,"strikethrough":false,"obfuscated":false,"color":"white","text":"Horrible Feeling"}'},title:"Horrible Feelin",author:"R'Kitxet"}

I Will Do What I Must.name: I Will Do What I Must
I Will Do What I Must.nbt: {pages:['{"text":"It\'s so peaceful gazing out from the tower over the Fractured Tree. There\'s something truly beautiful about looking out over the edge to see near-nothingness. Just the edge of the ocean, the branches of the Tree, and the great bridge, stretching ever on. "}','{"text":"I am going to miss this view. Tomorrow will be the last time I see the beautiful Empire we have built together. Tomorrow, I shall ascend from my position as the Silver Emperor and enter a new role as the Warden of a prisoner so strange and so deadly that it escapes description. What the "}','{"text":"Architect commands, I shall do, but deep down I question if this is truly the correct path to keeping the Architect\'s Ring and the world at large safe. I understand my power and my duty, but I also see the guiding hand I exert on this Empire and fear for its absense. For now, all we can do"}','{"text":"is wait and see the outcome. But I will not see it myself. I will not see the sun. I will not see the moon. I will not see my Knights in their shining armors. I will not see the Blackflame, proud and mighty riders of war. I will not see my citizens and serfs, toiling away for their greater purpose. I will not see"}','{"text":"what happens next.\\n\\nI must leave a legacy behind. It sounds so vain when I write these words, but I know the position I hold. I shall let the people mourn me. I shall task Navvte to construct for me great tombs and place a sacred piece of my armor within its crypt."}','{"text":"This will be my legacy and my afterlife. The Empire will mourn its Silver Emperor. I will mourn my life here.\\n\\nBut the Architect\'s Command must come first, and the Indigo confoundary we have imprisoned must be held. It is unlike any other being of the ley lines. My work is clear."}','{"text":"I will do what I must."}'],Enchantments:[{lvl:1s,id:"minecraft:power"}],Monumenta:{MMName:"<!italic><!underlined><bold><#342768>I Will Do What I Must",Tier:"trophy",Region:"ring"},HideFlags:1,title:"I Will Do What",author:"Silver Emperor Uriddan",plain:{display:{Name:"I Will Do What I Must",Lore:["Architect's Ring : Trophy"]}},display:{Name:'{"bold":true,"italic":false,"underlined":false,"color":"#342768","text":"I Will Do What I Must"}',Lore:['{"italic":false,"color":"dark_gray","extra":[{"italic":false,"color":"#CAFFFD","text":"Trophy"}],"text":"Architect\'s Ring : "}']}}

Insane Ramblings I.name: Insane Ramblings I
Insane Ramblings I.nbt: {pages:['{"text":"I know I saw it. The room around me, it warped.§0\\n§0\\n§0It warped into something else. Something unlike the rest of this city.§0\\n§0\\n§0I was in a tree, I know it. I saw it, wood. Beautiful, beautiful wood."}','{"text":"Wood that reminded me of my time elsewhere.§0\\n§0\\n§0A long time ago. Yes, what lovely memories."}'],generation:0,Monumenta:{MMName:"<!italic><!underlined><!strikethrough><!bold><!obfuscated><gold>Insane Ramblings I"},title:"b",author:"Unknown",plain:{display:{Name:"Insane Ramblings I"}},display:{Name:'{"bold":false,"italic":false,"underlined":false,"strikethrough":false,"obfuscated":false,"color":"gold","text":"Insane Ramblings I"}'},resolved:1b}

Insane Ramblings II.name: Insane Ramblings II
Insane Ramblings II.nbt: {pages:['{"text":"Ha, take that.§0\\n§0\\n§0That\\u0027ll teach you to mess with my food.§0\\n§0\\n§0The next time it moves, I\\u0027ll definitely kill it. It wants me to believe that it is just part of the wall.§0\\n§0\\n§0BUT I SEE YOU! I KNOW YOU MOVE!"}','{"text":"If only we hadn\\u0027t messed up, I wouldn\\u0027t have to go through this.§0\\n§0\\n§0A city shaken and people perturbed§0\\n§0\\n§0Power leaks through a doorway disturbed§0\\n§0\\n§0\\n§0Am I the last one?"}'],generation:0,Monumenta:{MMName:"<!italic><!underlined><!strikethrough><!bold><!obfuscated><gold>Insane Ramblings II"},title:"b",author:"Unknown",plain:{display:{Name:"Insane Ramblings II"}},display:{Name:'{"bold":false,"italic":false,"underlined":false,"strikethrough":false,"obfuscated":false,"color":"gold","text":"Insane Ramblings II"}'},resolved:1b}

Insane Ramblings III.name: Insane Ramblings III
Insane Ramblings III.nbt: {pages:['{"text":"No matter how loud I scream, no one can hear me.§0\\n§0\\n§0Only they can hear me. They listen to everything, they watch my every move.§0\\n§0\\n§0The walls, they shift, and take with them portions of my sanity."}','{"text":"A moment of clarity...§0\\n§0\\n§0I\\u0027m likely going to die in this place. I best lay down, it seems softer here.§0\\n§0\\n§0There was a bell on the floor. I reached out and rang it with all my might.§0\\n§0\\n§0It bit me."}'],generation:0,Monumenta:{MMName:"<!italic><!underlined><!strikethrough><!bold><!obfuscated><gold>Insane Ramblings III"},title:"b",author:"Unknown",plain:{display:{Name:"Insane Ramblings III"}},display:{Name:'{"bold":false,"italic":false,"underlined":false,"strikethrough":false,"obfuscated":false,"color":"gold","text":"Insane Ramblings III"}'},resolved:1b}

Instructions.name: Instructions
Instructions.nbt: {pages:['{"text":"PLEASE read very closely all new staff members, because I am not re-writing this note for the 14th time.§0\\n§0\\n§0Instructions on How to Rig the Slot Machines for our special customers:§0\\n§0\\n"}','{"text":"Your aim is to re-direct the chips flowing out of the emerald output on the top left to the diamond input on the bottom left, by default they flow in to the emerald output. §0\\n§0\\n§0Hit the buttons to re-direct flow. The connections are only so long and will"}','{"text":"only last 4 blocks before they need to flow over the gold hubs to keep going.§0\\n§0\\n§0If you run a connection in to a wall or un-configured space it will destroy the chip.§0\\n§0\\n§0Gold hubs can have multiple connections flow through them."}','{"text":"Most importantly, DO NOT leave the matrix configured like this. Anybody who knows their way around a slot machine could easily make a rigged chip.§0\\n§0\\n§0- Management."}'],generation:0,Monumenta:{MMName:"<!italic><!underlined><!strikethrough><!bold><!obfuscated><white>Instructions"},title:"§fInstructions",author:"Management",plain:{display:{Name:"Instructions"}},display:{Name:'{"bold":false,"italic":false,"underlined":false,"strikethrough":false,"obfuscated":false,"color":"white","text":"Instructions"}'},resolved:1b}

Inversion.name: Inversion
Inversion.nbt: {pages:['{"text":"The invoking of the magical nodes of the Tree of Life isn\'t quite as complex as some researchers seem to believe. While we have given \\"values\\" or \\"power\\" to the ten nodes we have delineated, those nodes have more power than can be described in a single aspect. Through a"}','{"text":"process described as \\"inverting\\" a node, one can pull forth a power that is an opposite or mirror of the description. Take Chasom, the power of Eternity. Chasom is a node invoked at face value to add time. But Chasom can be inverted simply by twisting the magic as you call it, to shorten"}','{"text":"time as well. Perhaps a combatant is slinging a powerful spell at you? Invoke Chasom and invert the power you draw forth, and perhaps you can make the oncoming attack fizzle out before it even strikes. It\'s really quite simple. Each node is a coin, and its powers are two sides. We as"}','{"text":"humans just vastly prefer to look at things positively. Why would one call Midat the power of Weakness when it grants great Strength as well? Why would Tiferet be called Chaos when it offers the Balance man desires? Knowing how to twist nodes to your whim is a core element"}','{"text":"to becoming a more successful mage. Combine the nodes to your own needs, twist the powers and shape them to your will. The ley lines on the Tree are only there to show what powers flow through the world. There is so much more to discover when you do not follow the beaten path."}'],plain:{display:{Name:"Inversion"}},Monumenta:{MMName:"<!italic><!underlined><!strikethrough><!bold><!obfuscated><white>Inversion"},display:{Name:'{"bold":false,"italic":false,"underlined":false,"strikethrough":false,"obfuscated":false,"color":"white","text":"Inversion"}'},title:"Inversion",author:"Spellcrafter DeKalb"}

Iris.name: Iris
Iris.nbt: {pages:['{"extra":[{"text":"Iris is a tall plant with a distinct violet six-petaled flower that blooms in the spring.\\n \\nThey symbolize\\n\\""},{"color":"dark_aqua","text":"Purity and Courage"},{"color":"black","text":"\\"."}],"text":""}','{"text":"Ingesting any part of the plant will cause vomiting, skin irritation, fever, and abdominal pain."}'],Enchantments:[{lvl:1s,id:"minecraft:power"}],Monumenta:{MMName:"<!italic><!underlined><!strikethrough><!bold><!obfuscated><gold>Iris",MMLore:["<!italic><!underlined><!strikethrough><!bold><!obfuscated><light_purple>* Quest Item *","#Q133I05"]},HideFlags:1,title:"§6Iris",author:"Anazus",plain:{display:{Name:"Iris",Lore:["* Quest Item *","#Q133I05"]}},display:{Name:'{"bold":false,"italic":false,"underlined":false,"strikethrough":false,"obfuscated":false,"color":"gold","text":"Iris"}',Lore:['{"italic":false,"color":"dark_gray","extra":[{"bold":false,"italic":false,"underlined":false,"strikethrough":false,"obfuscated":false,"color":"light_purple","text":"* Quest Item *"}],"text":""}','{"italic":false,"color":"dark_gray","extra":["#Q133I05"],"text":""}']},resolved:1b}

mmlore: <light_purple>* Quest Item *
Journal V4.name: Journal V4
Journal V4.nbt: {pages:['{"text":"A new stage of life requires a fresh journal. \\n\\nMy father\'s school is having problems in Ishnir. We have half the students we had last year, and there is no sign of more coming any time soon. Unfortunately, it is no longer profitable to "}','{"text":"have two grandmasters teaching here. Something will have to change.\\n-------------------\\nIt has been decided that I need to move to Chillwind. This will be hard on my family, but there is high demand for swordsage schools in Chillwind. If "}','{"text":"we can get used to the cold we will be better off moving. I worry about taking my son away from his grandfather, but I worry far more about Kalea. Her health has never been the best, and I worry the change might be too much for her. Every precaution will have to"}','{"text":"be taken to ensure her safety.\\n-------------------\\nPreparations have been made for the trip. It will be a long and potentially dangerous journey, and construction on the school is already underway. He is upset to have to leave his grandfather and"}','{"text":"friends, but has taken it as well as can be expected.\\n \\nSurprisingly our doctor thinks the change will do Kalea some good. I can only hope that they are right.\\n-------------------\\nThe ship has been at sea for some time now. "}','{"text":"It has been a mostly uneventful trip. There was some seasickness at the start, but that has stopped by this point. \\n\\nWe are set to arrive soon. It will be my first time in Chillwind and I find myself a bit nervous. Our countries have been"}','{"text":"at an uneasy peace for years. Many stories have been told in Ishnir about the cruelty of Chillwind, and I have no way of knowing how much is true.\\n-------------------\\nOur vessel made landfall in Frostgate earlier today. We got a room at the local"}','{"text":"inn to rest for the night. Tomorrow begins the second, and more dangerous, part of our journey. It is risky to travel with lots of supplies, but I am a swordsage. I must do everything in my power to protect my family.\\n-------------------\\nWe set out from"}','{"text":"Frostgate and crossed a bridge across a frozen lake. It seemed very unstable. I wouldn\'t be surprised if it broke one of these days.\\n\\nWe then went through a tree that was split in the middle. I know not how or why it decided to grow like"}','{"text":"that, but it felt unnatural. \\n\\nA bit further on we saw a cabin in the distance and inquired if we could stay the night. Unfortunately, during the night our \\"generous\\" hosts decided to try to kill us. I must be more vigilant in the future. "}','{"text":"-------------------\\nIn the morning we passed by some ruins and entered a tunnel carved into the walls. \\n\\nOn the other side we saw beautiful giant mushrooms that seemed to be made of crystal in the distance. They glowed with a light I could not"}','{"text":"place. They were oddly mesmerizing. \\n\\nThere was a mining camp along the way that offered us a place to stay. As I slept that night, I could have sworn that I heard whispers ordering me to dig. It was probably just a dream, but it felt real.\\n"}','{"text":"-------------------\\nIt was a warm day today, not that such things have much meaning in Chillwind. We continued on our way past the crystal mushrooms. \\n\\nThere honestly wasn\'t much to see other than a few rundown buildings. Kalea began"}','{"text":"to worry that we would not be able to find a place to spend the night, and she was right to be concerned. \\nWe came by a larger mining operation, but there were no rooms for us to stay in. We were forced to set up camp outside. I will never forget the cold"}','{"text":"that surrounds us, but it is nothing compared to the voices. \\n\\nThe same voice from the night before has returned, louder and more demanding. I now know it wasn\'t a dream. We need to get away from here as quickly as possible."}','{"text":"-------------------\\nUneasy after the events of the night prior we hurried out of the grove and didn\'t stop until it was completely out of sight. \\n\\nExhausted we slept at a cabin we found along the way. The voices had not"}','{"text":"followed us. I can not recall the last time I slept that well. \\n-------------------\\nToday we made it to a series of Hot Springs. We are nearly there, just a bit further to go.\\n\\nCamp was set up at the springs for the night. It should be"}','{"text":"easy to get to the school tomorrow.\\n-------------------\\nSo this is my school. It still doesn\'t feel real somehow. We unpacked and then Kalea and I saw to the construction efforts. It seems they are ahead of schedule.\\n\\nWe will need to begin"}','{"text":"finding students sooner than we had anticipated.\\n-------------------\\nStudents have begun to arrive, and training has started to pick up. I was worried about my son, but he is doing his best to keep his sprits up. He continues to be a strong student, but I"}','{"text":"know he is lonely. Hopefully he makes friends with some of the other students soon. It hurts my heart to see him pretend to be fine when he obviously isn\'t.\\n-------------------\\nKalea\'s health has greatly improved since our arrival in"}','{"text":"Chillwind. These are still early days, but I haven\'t seen her in such good sprits in years. She has taken to running the behind the scenes operations at the school.\\n\\nI don\'t know what I would have done if she hadn\'t been here to organize"}','{"text":"everything. There is just so much that has to be done, and often too few people to do it all.\\n-------------------\\nIt has been some time since I last wrote in this journal. A traveler was found half dead in the snow recently. Our nurse was able to save them,"}','{"text":"but it was close. \\n\\nOnce they recovered they wanted to thank me. I wasn\'t the one to find them, nor the one to save them, but they didn\'t care about semantics.\\n\\nI was presented with some sort of relic. They claimed that it"}','{"text":"was passed down in their family. Its function, if it has one, has been lost to time.\\n\\nI was hesitant to accept something with sentimental value from them, but they insisted. \\nWhat am I going to do with this thing? Is it even safe to have? I"}','{"text":"will have to run some tests.\\n-------------------\\nI have spent a few months trying to figure out the relic at this point. I dare not investigate it too aggressively due to the potentially dangerous nature of magic, but I can tell that it is magical by"}','{"text":"its nature.\\n\\nFrom what I have managed to gather, it isn\'t all that powerful. When energy is channeled into the relic it seems to pull in a certain direction. \\n\\nThere is an incredibly small change in the pull based on the"}','{"text":"position of the relic. It seems to be pointing to something, although I don\'t know if it is to a location or an object. \\n\\nIt is a strange thing indeed. Why would someone need to make a thing like this?\\n-------------------\\nA strange woman"}','{"text":"showed up unannounced today. She wanted to see me about a business proposition.\\n\\nShe offered to join forces with us.  They would help us find students and get supplies. It was a very nice offer, but something was wrong"}','{"text":"with it. The conditions are far too vague.\\n\\nThey sidestepped around what I would have to give them in exchange, insisting that it wasn\'t important. I refuse to enter into an agreement unless I know what to expect."}','{"text":"It isn\'t like I need their help anyway, the school is doing great. We are already having to turn students away, why would we want help bringing more in?\\n-------------------\\nKalea\'s health has begun to decline. The doctors are at a loss. For some reason her body is beginning to"}','{"text":"fail, but they can\'t figure out why.\\n\\nI refuse to give up. I will ask every doctor in the Isles if I have to. She will survive. She has to. I can\'t do this alone.\\n-------------------\\nShe is gone. I can\'t keep denying it. I have to be strong for my"}','{"text":"son. I have to lift my way out of my despair and be an example he can look up to. \\n\\nRest now Kalea, we will find our way without you. \\n-------------------\\nI knew it would be hard without Kalea, but I couldn\'t have begun to imagine just"}','{"text":"how much work there is to do around here. I can\'t keep up with it all on my own, but thankfully I do have some help. \\n\\nMaster Reo and the older students are keeping things from falling apart. We will manage without Kalea, but it will take time."}','{"text":"-------------------\\nHe isn\'t doing well. I can\'t say I\'m surprised, he just lost his mother after all. I don\'t know how to best comfort him. I have never been great at that type of thing.\\n\\nAll I can really do is mourn alongside him.\\n"}','{"text":"-------------------\\nThat strange woman showeD up again today. She repeated her offer. She was cOrrect that I need help at the moment, but there is something about her.\\n\\nShe showed great interest in the relic in my chambers. This iN"}','{"text":"itself isn\'t odd, it is a unique item with an unknOwn purpose, but she seemed to know that I would have iT.\\n\\nHer voice is like honey, but I sense a darkness Blacker than any night in her soul. I don\'t know why she wants the relic, but I can\'t allow hEr"}','{"text":"to get ahold of it.\\n-------------------\\nOur chef is pLanning to leave soon. He has not told me why he wants to leave, but I can see a deep sadness in hIs eyes. There is something he isn\'t telling me, but it isn\'t my place to make him."}','{"text":"If he wants to tEll me I\'ll be there for him.\\n\\nWe have been tightly staffed eVer since Kalea\'s death so it will be important to replace him as soon as possible. Thankfully he will be hEre for a few more weeks. "}','{"text":"It is bad timing since I think I\'m beginning to come down with sometHing.\\n-------------------\\nI dEfinitely am coming down with something. Maybe I have been woRking myself too hard. I might have to take a break untiL I get feeling better.\\n\\n"}','{"text":"I can\'t afford to be sick just yet though.\\n\\nToday Is the day my son finally undergoes the swordsagE trials and I can\'t miss that. He has grown so fast in the last few yearS and I am so proud of him. I better get ready or I\'ll be late."}'],Enchantments:[{lvl:1s,id:"minecraft:power"}],Monumenta:{MMName:"<!italic><!underlined><bold><#ffbf00>Journal V4",MMLore:["<light_purple>* Quest Item *","#Q138I04"]},HideFlags:1,title:"Journal V4",author:"Noren",plain:{display:{Name:"Journal V4",Lore:["* Quest Item *","#Q138I04"]}},display:{Name:'{"bold":true,"italic":false,"underlined":false,"color":"#FFBF00","text":"Journal V4"}',Lore:['{"italic":false,"color":"dark_gray","extra":[{"color":"light_purple","text":"* Quest Item *"}],"text":""}','{"italic":false,"color":"dark_gray","extra":["#Q138I04"],"text":""}']}}

Knowledge and Balance.name: Knowledge and Balance
Knowledge and Balance.nbt: {pages:['{"text":"After months of study, I\'ve finally exhausted the knowledge of the wools that I uncovered in the Valley. I can now bring my focus to those that have appeared in the Isles.\\n\\nThe first I have come across information "}','{"text":"for is Knowledge. While I was slightly late on getting my hands on it, I was able to sneak around the newly uncovered Viridia without being seen.\\n\\nIt\'s funny, I always heard tales of Viridia growing up, but it\'s not at all how I imagined it."}','{"text":"I guess centuries of decay will do that. Regardless, the information I was able to find there was exceptional. It even laid out the next steps on my journey, which lead me to find texts regarding Balance."}','{"text":"Perhaps it is just my mind growing weary of the constant study, but I cannot shake the feeling that the Knowledge and the Balance are somehow linked.\\n\\nRegardless, I mustn\'t slow my pace now."}'],Enchantments:[{lvl:1s,id:"minecraft:power"}],Monumenta:{MMName:"<!italic><!underlined><!strikethrough><!bold><!obfuscated><gold>Knowledge and Balance",MMLore:["<!italic><!underlined><!strikethrough><!bold><!obfuscated><dark_gray>You definitely recognize this handwriting.","<!italic><!underlined><!strikethrough><!bold><!obfuscated><light_purple>* Quest Item *","#Q114I07"]},HideFlags:1,title:"b",author:"Selari",plain:{display:{Name:"Knowledge and Balance",Lore:["You definitely recognize this handwriting.","* Quest Item *","#Q114I07"]}},display:{Name:'{"bold":false,"italic":false,"underlined":false,"strikethrough":false,"obfuscated":false,"color":"gold","text":"Knowledge and Balance"}',Lore:['{"italic":false,"color":"dark_gray","extra":[{"bold":false,"italic":false,"underlined":false,"strikethrough":false,"obfuscated":false,"color":"dark_gray","text":"You definitely recognize this handwriting."}],"text":""}','{"italic":false,"color":"dark_gray","extra":[{"bold":false,"italic":false,"underlined":false,"strikethrough":false,"obfuscated":false,"color":"light_purple","text":"* Quest Item *"}],"text":""}','{"italic":false,"color":"dark_gray","extra":["#Q114I07"],"text":""}']},resolved:1b}

mmlore: <!italic><!underlined><!strikethrough><!bold><!obfuscated><light_purple>* Quest Item *
Kurtis' Journal.nbt: {pages:['{"text":"I was prepared, I had always been prepared. I alone saw the threat of the war. They said it was over, that the Tlaxans had surrendered. Not all soldiers fight with permission from their government. It was foolish to lower our defenses. As a kid,"}','{"text":"I was told stories of the Blackroot War.  These stories focused on the heroes of the empire. They thought they would make me braver and more courageous. Perhaps even inspire me to join the military myself. They were wrong."}','{"text":"I saw nothing but death and destruction in those stories. I wanted nothing more than to escape them. Instead I became enslaved by them. As I heard more and more stories it became harder to escape from them. "}','{"text":"I became convinced that the war wasn\\u0027t truly over, merely postponed. I put all of my money into building a bunker. It became my home and I grew more distant from the people I had grown up with. It was a difficult decision, but they were too blinded by"}','{"text":"their optimism to see the threat. Then the day I had been preparing for came. My defensive wards detected a group gathering in the forest outside of Farr. I rushed back to the city. It was a wasted effort."}','{"text":"They called me crazy. They ignored me. It wasn\\u0027t a look of anger I got, but one of pity. Even my brother stayed behind, but he promised he would get to safety. §0\\n§0\\n§0I escaped back to my bunker and turned on all of my defenses."}','{"text":"They grew closer and closer to the city. Shortly, the sounds of battle began. My bunker spared me from the screams, but I heard enough to let me know my paranoia was justified."}','{"text":"The battle went on for what seemed like ages, but I\\u0027m sure it wasn\\u0027t actually all that long. Right when I thought it would never end I heard the worst sound in my life, an implosion. It wasn\'t just a loud sound, but also one that seemed to suck all sound within itself. "}','{"text":"It was a sound so terrible that I was sure I would die. A sound so loud that the silence that followed it was all the more terrifying.§0\\n§0\\n§0I didn\\u0027t dare to leave my bunker, but I went to peek outside. It was only then that I realized a critical"}','{"text":"flaw in my design. The battle above had been so violent that my way out was blocked by rubble. I had enough supplies to last for several lifetimes, but surely nothing could have survived a battle like that. Who would be left to save me?"}','{"text":"I must have been in there for at least a month. I had been right, but no one believed me. I alone survived and it was all my fault. If only I had been less dramatic in my preparations. If only I hadn\\u0027t become known as a crazy man. "}','{"text":"If only my brother had came back with me. If only I wasn\\u0027t alone in my guilt.§0\\n§0\\n§0Then one day he came into my life. A man walked into my bunker. I rushed to check the door, and found it was still blocked. How he got in is something I may never learn,"}','{"text":"but that isn\\u0027t important now. At first I assumed I was going even more insane, but he was real. He was my savior, here to free me from my suffering.§0\\n§0\\n§0The man didn\\u0027t introduce himself, but had an offer for me. He would free me from my prison."}','{"text":"In return I would work for him and offer up memories for some reason. In a normal situation I would have refused him outright. Even if just trapped I would have refused him, but he offered me a way to forget. To be free of my guilt, I would have done"}','{"text":"just about anything. He gave me time to get my affairs in order. I left a note for Eowen, hopefully he finds the new me if he survived.§0\\n§0\\n§0Pain, always the pain.§0\\n§0\\n§0Where am I? Who am I?§0\\n§0\\n"}','{"text":"Sell my item? To whom? Why? There are people to buy it? Are they in this pain if they don\\u0027t buy things?§0\\n§0\\n§0If I do that will this pain end, or merely pause?§0\\n§0\\n§0Why do I exist? Is this pain what it means to live?"}','{"text":"Eowen, for the first time in who knows how long my mind is clear and I remember you, but I know it will not last. Please do not continue looking for me. It will only lead to you becoming like me. Live your life as if I was dead. "}','{"text":"I was a fool, and this is the fate that I deserve.§0\\n§0\\n§0Please forgive me."}'],generation:0,Enchantments:[{lvl:1s,id:"minecraft:power"}],Monumenta:{MMLore:["<!italic><!underlined><!strikethrough><!bold><!obfuscated><light_purple>* Quest Item *","#Q37I03"]},HideFlags:1,title:"Kurtis' Journal",author:"Kurtis",plain:{display:{Lore:["* Quest Item *","#Q37I03"]}},display:{Lore:['{"italic":false,"color":"dark_gray","extra":[{"bold":false,"italic":false,"underlined":false,"strikethrough":false,"obfuscated":false,"color":"light_purple","text":"* Quest Item *"}],"text":""}','{"italic":false,"color":"dark_gray","extra":["#Q37I03"],"text":""}']},resolved:1b}

Had my research last time not been disrupted, I likely would not be making the vast strides that I am now."}','{"text":"Written in this dusty scroll are also small details on the Aspect of the Elements.§0\\n§0\\n§0During my time in the Valley, I would often hear word of the legendary jungle spirit, Kaul. Mallavis (written_book).name: Mallavis
Mallavis (written_book).nbt: {pages:['{"text":"Time and time again, the whispers of the future have called many to do rash things. Such is the fate of the nature druid Mallavis. As a powerful show of prowess, he created a pair of boots that he claimed would allow him to fully attune to nature. Within a few short weeks, he was "}','{"text":"proven correct when he took root above the city and transformed slowly into a large tree. Its bark fuels the magical travel the empire now relies on."}'],plain:{display:{Name:"Mallavis"}},Monumenta:{MMName:"<!italic><!underlined><!strikethrough><!bold><!obfuscated><gray>Mallavis"},display:{Name:'{"bold":false,"italic":false,"underlined":false,"strikethrough":false,"obfuscated":false,"color":"gray","text":"Mallavis"}'},title:"Mallavis",author:"Yorgus"}

Many More.nbt: {pages:['{"text":"I\'m not sure how safe this place will stay, but I\'ve managed to set up an outpost for my research that the Depths seem to allow me to return to, over and over. I\'m not sure why, but I certainly appreciate it. What I\'ve found down here is nearly unknowable. There are so many ruins down here,"}','{"text":"below the bedrock of the ocean floor. Almost like some previous civilization was covered up. Sorry, no, like several previous civilizations were covered up. There\'s one that seems quite noticeable, which makes me think it was most recent, with ruins of magnificent ivory spires. But"}','{"text":"there are several more present, seemingly decayed far further. The very ground we walk on has a gravelly texture to it and could imply signs of fully eroded buildings, homes, or ancient city streets. What could have covered up these ancient cities? Why? What did they do that"}','{"text":"caused them to fade away, and why were they forgotten in the first place?"}','{"text":"I\'ve found a name. Carved deeply in stone, crumbled and covered by debris, in a language I only half understand, I believe I\'ve discovered the name of one of these ancient locations. \\"Danann\\". The words seem to point to some resting site, but there was an image as well. Many warriors, holding"}','{"text":"thin blades, next to symbols that I interpret as meaning \\"endless\\", battling what can only be described as a Jellyfish attached to something else. I don\'t know what this means, nor what this was meant to show, but whatever the Danann were, they clearly were at war with the"}','{"text":"beyond. I\'m not sure they won."}'],author:"Anjrej",title:"Many More"}

mmlore: <light_purple>* Quest Item *
My 1st Joural.name: My 1st Joural
My 1st Joural.nbt: {pages:['{"text":"I was given a joural like my daddy\'s today. I will write things down like he does.\\n-------------------\\nGrandpa Arlieri wants to start training me. Mommy and Daddy seem nervous, but have agred. Training seems a bit boring, but it is importent to Grandpa so I need to do my"}','{"text":"best.\\n-------------------\\nTraining is tuff. I am the yungest here. Everyone is nice to me. They let me take breaks when I need to. Hopefuly tomorrow will be easier.\\n-------------------\\nTraining is to hard. I am not good enough. I can\'t do this."}','{"text":"-------------------\\nDaddy talked to me today. He says I\'m doing well during training. Better than he did at my age. I need to keep trying.\\n-------------------\\nIt has been a while since I have remembered to write. I am doing much better now. Training is getting "}','{"text":"much easier. Dad and Grandpa seem happy.\\n-------------------\\nDad told me that I\'m one of the best students. I have a long way to go to deserve such praise. I must get stronger.\\n-------------------\\nMom and Dad seem upset. I hope it isn\'t my fault."}','{"text":"-------------------\\nI have to say goodbye to Grandpa and my friends at the school. Why do we have to go to Chillwind, it isn\'t fair.\\n-------------------\\nThis ship is boring. When are we going to get to Chillwind already. It is really hard to train on a "}','{"text":"ship.\\n-------------------\\nWe have arrived in Chillwind. Apparently we still aren\'t where we want to go, why do adults make things take so long.\\n-------------------\\nDad beat up some bad guys today that tried to attack us. Someday I\'ll be able to do that."}','{"text":"-------------------\\nSome miners said we could stay with them for the night. The voices won\'t stop. Why are there voice? Why won\'t they stop? Will they stop if we help them?\\n-------------------\\nIt is so cold. We couldn\'t find a good place to sleep and"}','{"text":"were forced to sleep outside. I have never been so cold, and the voices won\'t stop.\\n-------------------\\nWe left the pretty mushroom place and stayed in a building. The voices have stopped, but we still aren\'t to the school. How much longer will this take?"}','{"text":"-------------------\\nMom said we should make it to the school tomorrow. This trip has been harder than my training, I will be glad to get home.\\n-------------------\\nThe school is empty. Dad says it is because we don\'t have students yet. Hopefully some of"}','{"text":"them are willing to be my friends.\\n-------------------\\nI have been so caught up in my training that I forgot about this journal. Father has managed to attract a lot of students and the school seems to be doing well. Training is hard, and keeps getting more complex,"}','{"text":"but I know I can do it.\\n-------------------\\nFather has spent a lot of time looking at a relic that a traveler gave him recently. I don\'t know what he sees in the thing, it doesn\'t seem to do much.\\n-------------------\\nA nice lady came by the school today to"}','{"text":"talk to father. She played with me for a bit and promised to bring a toy next time.\\n-------------------\\nMother seems really sick. Father is really worried about her. Mother is going to be okay isn\'t she?\\n-------------------\\nFather says Mother is gone. Where did she"}','{"text":"go? I don\'t understand. Apparently she isn\'t coming back and it isn\'t her fault. Who\'s fault is it then?\\n-------------------\\nThe nice lady visited again. She played with me and gave me a toy. I don\'t know why father doesn\'t trust her.\\n"}','{"text":"-------------------\\nAll of my training so far has led up to today. I am to undertake the swordsage trials. I know nothing about them other than that they are said to be incredibly difficult. I hope I am ready."}'],Enchantments:[{lvl:1s,id:"minecraft:power"}],Monumenta:{MMName:"<!italic><!underlined><bold><#ffbf00>My 1st Joural",MMLore:["<light_purple>* Quest Item *","#Q138I05"]},HideFlags:1,title:"My 1st Joural",author:"???",plain:{display:{Name:"My 1st Joural",Lore:["* Quest Item *","#Q138I05"]}},display:{Name:'{"bold":true,"italic":false,"underlined":false,"color":"#FFBF00","text":"My 1st Joural"}',Lore:['{"italic":false,"color":"dark_gray","extra":[{"color":"light_purple","text":"* Quest Item *"}],"text":""}','{"italic":false,"color":"dark_gray","extra":["#Q138I05"],"text":""}']},resolved:1b}

Nelfine's Journal.name: Nelfine's Journal
Nelfine's Journal.nbt: {pages:['{"text":"82 AV- or rather, 807 CCE. I\'ve made my return to the tundra I call home. My time in the King\'s Valley was wonderful, but I couldn\'t bear to be away from home any longer. Nor can I bear being away from Arian... I could see the pain in his eyes when I told him I wanted to return home."}','{"text":"808 CCE\\nI was met this morning with the most spectacular news. I\'m being promoted to Head of Intercontinental Intelligence! Rightfully so, if I do say so myself. King Oliver Obregson himself recommended me for the position- he said my work in the Valley"}','{"text":"analyzing the geopolitics between the Narsens and the native Tlaxan people was unlike anything he had seen by others in my field. However, despite the praise, it still serves to remind me of Arian once more. Perhaps I may use my new position to set up a meeting back in the Valley..."}','{"text":"809 CCE\\nIt\'s been months since my transfer to a new location. They claimed it would be more fitting for my new role, but it appears to be a medium-sized fortress near the coast. For safety, they assured, but I feel this was just a bit excessive. Still, I get my own private study above"}','{"text":"the clanking of boots and swords down below. Bandits would not dare to attempt an attack. They will not even try to go after the caravans that bring us supplies- they\'re content going after those who cannot afford more than a single caravan guard. Although the Chillwind is my home,"}','{"text":"and I do love it so, the greed of the nobles leading to such banditry in the first place does not go beneath my notice. It is a blemish on this otherwise beautiful land. I\'ve heard the town of Nightroost has recently been facing beastly attacks more often, and the Crown spares no help."}','{"text":"810 CCE\\nIt\'s been nearly 2 years, but it\'s happening! A meeting is to be held in the town of Farr to go over the past 3 years of events in the Valley. My sources have told me of a growing conflict between a Tlaxan group known as the Sons of the Forest, and the"}','{"text":"Narsens. To be frank, I\'m not surprised something like this hasn\'t happened earlier. Regardless, Arian is to attend that meeting. I hope he forgives me for leaving like I did. It wasn\'t his fault- the homesickness became\\ntoo much to handle. I will only be gone for a few days, hence I will"}','{"text":"leave this journal here until my return. The ship down at the landing zone is scheduled to leave shortly, so I must be off! I don\'t want to leave Arian waiting.\\n\\nClear as glass,\\nNel"}'],Monumenta:{MMName:"<!italic><!underlined><!bold><white>Nelfine's Journal"},title:"Nelfine's Journal",author:"Nelfine",plain:{display:{Name:"Nelfine's Journal"}},display:{Name:'{"bold":false,"italic":false,"underlined":false,"color":"white","text":"Nelfine\'s Journal"}'},resolved:1b}

But evil was lurking deep down within the depths of the Abbey. Old Journal.name: Old Journal
Old Journal.nbt: {pages:['{"text":"It\\u0027s been many years since I have set foot in my homeland of Ishnir. I never believed I would return, but my research in the Valley being forcefully ended has left me with no choice.§0\\n§0\\n§0That said, all is not totally lost here."}','{"text":"The information I was able to come across in the Valley was scarce, due to the violent past between the Narsens and the Tlaxani.§0\\n§0\\n§0The people here, however, sit upon a massive foundation of knowledge and don\\u0027t even realize it. They focus so heavily"}','{"text":"on their politics and national squabbles, that they ignore information that sits right under their noses, left by those who came before them.§0\\n§0\\n§0Here, I can truly come to understand the nature of the artifacts known as the Wools."}','{"text":"How did these items, physical embodiments of the primoridial powers of the universe, come into existance? More importantly, can this be replicated?§0\\n§0\\n§0I have much to do, but I require a workshop in order to perform my experiments."}','{"text":"I have called in a favor from my old friend, Ghalla. He has agreed to let me build under his store in Alnera.§0\\n§0\\n§0This book is the key to the hidden passage in the shop, unlocked by slotting it into the upper compartment of his furnace."}'],generation:0,Enchantments:[{lvl:1s,id:"minecraft:power"}],Monumenta:{MMName:"<!italic><!underlined><!strikethrough><!bold><!obfuscated><gold>Old Journal",MMLore:["<!italic><!underlined><!strikethrough><!bold><!obfuscated><dark_gray>The name Selari is etched into the spine.","<!italic><!underlined><!strikethrough><!bold><!obfuscated><light_purple>* Quest Item *","#Q114I01"]},HideFlags:1,title:"c",author:"Selari",plain:{display:{Name:"Old Journal",Lore:["The name Selari is etched into the spine.","* Quest Item *","#Q114I01"]}},display:{Name:'{"bold":false,"italic":false,"underlined":false,"strikethrough":false,"obfuscated":false,"color":"gold","text":"Old Journal"}',Lore:['{"italic":false,"color":"dark_gray","extra":[{"bold":false,"italic":false,"underlined":false,"strikethrough":false,"obfuscated":false,"color":"dark_gray","text":"The name Selari is etched into the spine."}],"text":""}','{"italic":false,"color":"dark_gray","extra":[{"bold":false,"italic":false,"underlined":false,"strikethrough":false,"obfuscated":false,"color":"light_purple","text":"* Quest Item *"}],"text":""}','{"italic":false,"color":"dark_gray","extra":["#Q114I01"],"text":""}']},resolved:1b}

Older Magic.name: Older Magic
Older Magic.nbt: {pages:['{"text":"There is an art to resurrecting lost magic, for no magic can ever truly be lost. The powers modern professions make use of are simply advancements of these older powers - and older orders as well. One such order, the Shadowdancers, grasped on to the"}','{"text":"shadows cast by the dawn and used them to slip through the edges of reality. What they were doing in truth was touching the Veil itself and letting it carry them until the last possible moment. As the order began to lose members, not to death, but to sudden vanishings, it is when the magic was called"}','{"text":"into question. Shadowdancers began to reject the use of the Veil for their powers, growing suspicious of such magic that could, at a moment\'s notice, snatch them and never let them go. In time, the order itself vanished and the magics they used were replaced by safer,"}','{"text":"smaller spells to warp the user through space and unleash deadly attacks. But Mistress Hedera needed the power of the Veil. Her research into these ancient powers led us to the Void, and her time with the Void has led us to the Deep God. The Deep God has granted us powers even these"}','{"text":"ancient orders could not have imagined. All it takes are drops of Void, consumed in the proper dosage, and the blessed gaze of our God..."}'],plain:{display:{Name:"Older Magic"}},Monumenta:{MMName:"<!italic><!underlined><!strikethrough><!bold><!obfuscated><white>Older Magic"},display:{Name:'{"bold":false,"italic":false,"underlined":false,"strikethrough":false,"obfuscated":false,"color":"white","text":"Older Magic"}'},title:"Older Magic",author:"Annelise"}

Overboard, Deeper Still.name: Overboard, Deeper Still
Overboard, Deeper Still.nbt: {pages:['{"text":"Tha Cap\'n be gone an\' tha crew be in shambles. Tha Mist ain\'t ready fer this kinda absense, aye. Yet tha Cap\'n swore he gone an\' felt tha call o\' the Corsair an\' so he must be answerin\', lest some other sea dogs loot it fer themself. Davey\'ll step up though. He always be doin\' that"}','{"text":"when Varcosa goes an\' lets tha crew down with \'is wild hunt.\\n\\n---\\n\\nDavey is callin\' for us ta leave tha ship. With Varcosa bein\' all missin\' an\' tha like, I be tempted ta take \'im up on tha call. He says he\'s hearin\' from the God o\' the Deep, an\'"}','{"text":"Rhygfar tha Crazed is backin\' up his word. Now I don\'t be listenin\' to everything ol\' Rhygar is spoutin\', but I know enough \'bout \'im to know that he\'s the mouth piece fer the call o\' tha deep. Davey\'ll be leavin\' the ship behind wit\' a crew o\' the bravest pirates from the Black Mist an\' headin\' ta a breach"}','{"text":"come tha dawn.\\n\\n---\\n\\nI\'m gonna be goin\' wit\' \'im.\\n\\n---\\n\\nDavey\'s eyes \'ave changed colors. He be sayin\' he\'s seeing what She\'s showin\' him. I wanna be seein\' those"}','{"text":"majestic sights. I ain\'t seen anythin\' but the Mist since tha Veil went an\' spat me out, aye. Ratarash (written_book).name: Ratarash
Ratarash (written_book).nbt: {pages:['{"text":"Each denting blow to Ratarash let out a hollow ringing so deep and terrifying the normally roaring crowd sat at the edge of their seats gasping. The mighty gladiator Julios, a crowd favorite, was raining blows with his spear into the defences of the clear underdog, Markuus,"}','{"text":"yet still he, and his shield, stood firm.\\n\\nThen, the moment Julios adjusted his grip, Markuus lept forward and slammed the mighty shield into the gladiator\'s faceplate. With a final, brutal, ring, the champion collapsed, and Markuus stood victorious."}'],plain:{display:{Name:"Ratarash"}},Monumenta:{MMName:"<!italic><!underlined><!strikethrough><!bold><!obfuscated><gray>Ratarash"},display:{Name:'{"bold":false,"italic":false,"underlined":false,"strikethrough":false,"obfuscated":false,"color":"gray","text":"Ratarash"}'},title:"Ratarash",author:"Yorgus"}

Reaching Out into Eternity.name: Reaching Out into Eternity
Reaching Out into Eternity.nbt: {pages:['{"text":"Oh, there are so many more crystals. The shard isn\'t dying. It\'s replicating. It has no interest in fading out now that it\'s been drained and left alone. It\'s sapping the remaining power in this place to grow again, creating these hideous growths in order to expand once more. I\'m starting to"}','{"text":"think that it... it wants to return to the original wool. It won\'t stop trying to spread until it succeeds or someone manages to destroy it.\\n\\nI must not destroy it..."}'],plain:{display:{Name:"Reaching Out into Eternity"}},Monumenta:{MMName:"<!italic><!underlined><!strikethrough><!bold><!obfuscated><white>Reaching Out into Eternity"},display:{Name:'{"bold":false,"italic":false,"underlined":false,"strikethrough":false,"obfuscated":false,"color":"white","text":"Reaching Out into Eternity"}'},title:"Reaching Out",author:"R'Kitxet"}

Remnants of the Sanctum Vol 1.name: Remnants of the Sanctum Vol 1
Remnants of the Sanctum Vol 1.nbt: {pages:['{"extra":[{"text":"The first sign something was wrong was when the sun froze in the sky and my stomach dropped. A flurry of news came in from scouts within hours, as thousands fled Ta\\u0027Ferna. \\"The Soulspeaker was taken!\\" they screamed. Creatures had taken the sanctum"}],"text":""}','{"extra":[{"text":"for their own. The Jungle was no longer with us. The power was gone."},{"text":"\\n"},{"text":"\\n"},{"color":"black","text":"Perhaps this is cruel, but I was not surprised. While I respected C\\u0027Axtal, I did not expect his gambit to work for long. The power he offered"}],"text":""}','{"extra":[{"text":"felt incredible. It had granted speed, strength, and alertness that even the power of Ixume\\u0027s icon could not match. Feeling that power gone, that emptiness in my gut, felt wrong.
