Remnants of the Sanctum Vol 2.name: Remnants of the Sanctum Vol 2
Remnants of the Sanctum Vol 2.nbt: {pages:['{"extra":[{"text":"I had been chosen to go. I should have seen it coming. I rather did. After all, it was I who had earned the honor of my people when I slaughtered the invader-King and sparked this war. Now it would be my task to calm the Jungle itself and save our missing"}],"text":""}','{"extra":[{"text":"people. The council voted, and C\\u0027Zanil stood there smugly as the decision came down. I could have said no. I should have said no. But while we are Shamans, the council was supposed to guide our will toward that of the will of the people. It seems it is"}],"text":""}','{"extra":[{"text":"the people\\u0027s will that I go in search of C\\u0027Axtal. This decision weighed on me. I understood the responsibility, but the fighting was endless. I would have to be prepared for yet another battle. This time though, I would be without Ixume\\u0027s icon."}],"text":""}','{"extra":[{"text":"Try as I might, I could not risk my people losing access to its power. I would have to leave it with Zanil, which turned my stomach."},{"text":"\\n"},{"text":"\\n"},{"color":"black","text":"So be it."}],"text":""}'],generation:0,Monumenta:{MMName:"<!italic><!underlined><!strikethrough><!bold><!obfuscated><white>Remnants of the Sanctum Vol 2"},title:"t",author:"C'Shura",plain:{display:{Name:"Remnants of the Sanctum Vol 2"}},display:{Name:'{"bold":false,"italic":false,"underlined":false,"strikethrough":false,"obfuscated":false,"color":"white","text":"Remnants of the Sanctum Vol 2"}'},resolved:1b}

Remnants of the Sanctum Vol 3.name: Remnants of the Sanctum Vol 3
Remnants of the Sanctum Vol 3.nbt: {pages:['{"extra":[{"text":"This place is ravaged and wild. Vines have burst from the earth, strangling the environment. Light seems to fade within this place, leaving it in an eternal twilight haze. I stepped into the darkened halls, weapons held tight, eyes scanning the dim for"}],"text":""}','{"extra":[{"text":"threats. It took mere moments to begin to spot them. Swollen spiders skittered along the walls. Walking corpses, flowers blooming from their flesh, roamed the shadows, their soft moaning adding a horrible chorus to the thin air. I let out a solitary sigh,"}],"text":""}','{"extra":[{"text":"then waded into battle, cutting down creatures with impunity. As Tlaxan as they may look, they were Tlaxan no more."}],"text":""}','{"extra":[{"text":"Soon I came to the village of Ta\\u0027Ferna itself. I wanted to feel familiar with this place, but so much had changed in the month I had last been here. The village I knew was still there, but it felt changed. Choked by growth and silent."}],"text":""}','{"extra":[{"text":"High above the lake was an island, held aloft by bulging vines, the bottom a mess of roots and crumbling earth. The entire sanctum was choked by this sudden spawning of nature left in Kaul\\u0027s wake. The village feels oddly pristine though, as if preserved"}],"text":""}','{"extra":[{"text":"by something unseen. It disturbed me. I left it behind for now. I do not wish to see more corpses right now, walking or not. I will set out for the island in the sky. Something important calls me there."}],"text":""}'],generation:0,Monumenta:{MMName:"<!italic><!underlined><!strikethrough><!bold><!obfuscated><white>Remnants of the Sanctum Vol 3"},title:"156",author:"C'Shura",plain:{display:{Name:"Remnants of the Sanctum Vol 3"}},display:{Name:'{"bold":false,"italic":false,"underlined":false,"strikethrough":false,"obfuscated":false,"color":"white","text":"Remnants of the Sanctum Vol 3"}'},resolved:1b}

Remnants of the Sanctum Vol 4.name: Remnants of the Sanctum Vol 4
Remnants of the Sanctum Vol 4.nbt: {pages:['{"extra":[{"text":"The voices have begun to whisper to me as I climb. I can feel a growing power before me and I am prepared to make it my own. My purpose. Creatures attack on all sides as I ascend, but the call here is too strong. I must know what it masks. I must."}],"text":""}','{"extra":[{"text":"After several more close encounters with horrors, I reached the summit. The power was before me. It cried out for me. I will oblige its calls. I stepped forward into crumbled ruins on the island and found it."},{"text":"\\n"},{"text":"\\n"},{"color":"black","text":"An axe, thrumming with power - one very"}],"text":""}','{"extra":[{"text":"familiar to me. C\\u0027Axtal\\u0027s Crusher was stuck in the ground. Beyond this, there was no sign of the Soulspeaker. With a heavy heart, I lifted his axe from the ground. Kaul had taken him for his sins."},{"text":"\\n"},{"text":"\\n"},{"color":"black","text":"But within seconds of touching the axe, the whispers"}],"text":""}','{"extra":[{"text":"resumed. The voice. It was clearer now. It sounded like C\\u0027Axtal, calling out. Pleading."},{"text":"\\n"},{"text":"\\n"},{"color":"black","text":"But behind that voice was another. Speaking at the edges of my mind, directly to me."},{"text":"\\n"},{"text":"\\n"},{"color":"black","text":"I had work to do. This place needed to be cleansed."}],"text":""}'],generation:0,Monumenta:{MMName:"<!italic><!underlined><!strikethrough><!bold><!obfuscated><white>Remnants of the Sanctum Vol 4"},title:"122h",author:"C'Shura",plain:{display:{Name:"Remnants of the Sanctum Vol 4"}},display:{Name:'{"bold":false,"italic":false,"underlined":false,"strikethrough":false,"obfuscated":false,"color":"white","text":"Remnants of the Sanctum Vol 4"}'},resolved:1b}

Remnants of the Sanctum Vol 5.nbt: {pages:['{"extra":[{"text":"So many survivors, hidden away. So many to cleanse. Research Log - Ish413.67.name: Research Log - Ish413.67
Research Log - Ish413.67.nbt: {pages:['{"text":"It has been so long that I am not even sure the purpose of my reseach any longer. Has the Empire forgotten us? This began as an investigatory mission into the magma below the earth\'s mantle, but that was before we found the crystals. Taragryn went even deeper into the caves"}','{"text":"we discovered, and I haven\'t heard from her in months. I\'m not sure she\'s ever coming back. I\'m uncertain if I even sleep any more. I\'ve studied the strangest movements of magma. I\'ve seen an inky blackness even deeper below. I was careful at first, but I got curious. It felt"}','{"text":"like silk, smooth and cold. Now I feel cold as well, even as the magma flows slowly below.\\n\\nSometimes I hear whispers. Could it be  Taragryn, calling for help? Could it be Matxe, freeing himself from the cage I was forced to put him in? It even could be"}','{"text":"the Emperor himself, come to visit our humble research station. I\'m sure he\'s curious about our progress.\\n\\nSometimes I\'m curious about our progress as well... each day seems to last an eternity."}'],plain:{display:{Name:"Research Log - Ish413.67"}},Monumenta:{MMName:"<!italic><!underlined><!strikethrough><!bold><!obfuscated><white>Research Log - Ish413.67"},display:{Name:'{"bold":false,"italic":false,"underlined":false,"strikethrough":false,"obfuscated":false,"color":"white","text":"Research Log - Ish413.67"}'},title:"Research Statio",author:"Whellton"}

mmlore: <!italic><!underlined><!strikethrough><!bold><!obfuscated><light_purple>* Quest Item *
Returning to Balance.name: Returning to Balance
Returning to Balance.nbt: {pages:['{"extra":[{"text":"I was supposed to be special, the one to bring peace to the peaceless. And yet, my empire has fallen to ruin."},{"text":"\\n"},{"text":"\\n"},{"color":"black","text":"Unlike my Brothers and Sisters of old, I was given a path. For most, the gifts granted by the Arboretum brought balance, whether"}],"text":""}','{"extra":[{"text":"through internal peace or the passing of a season\\u0027s member."},{"text":"\\n"},{"text":"\\n"},{"color":"black","text":"But my gift... my gift was so much more. A lone scrap of paper, enscribed with coordinates, and a single word: \\"Peace\\"."},{"text":"\\n"},{"text":"\\n"},{"color":"black","text":"The world outside of the Arboretum was"}],"text":""}','{"extra":[{"text":"at war with itself, and by following the scrap to the location, I uncovered the Knowledge needed to end those wars."},{"text":"\\n"},{"text":"\\n"},{"color":"black","text":"But now, that gift has forsaken me. My empire has been reduced to folly, and I am a man without a country."}],"text":""}','{"extra":[{"text":"Ishnir is currently in chaos of its own. The abandonment of Al Malakut has left the government on high alert. Escaping to there will not be an option."},{"text":"\\n"},{"text":"\\n"},{"color":"black","text":"The government of the Chillwind wishes for my head on a stake, but if I can find my way to"}],"text":""}','{"extra":[{"text":"the Arboretum undetected, I will no longer need to worry. My Brothers, at least those who remember me, they will not allow me to perish."},{"text":"\\n"},{"text":"\\n"},{"color":"black","text":"There, I will be safe."}],"text":""}'],generation:0,Enchantments:[{lvl:1s,id:"minecraft:power"}],Monumenta:{MMName:"<!italic><!underlined><!strikethrough><!bold><!obfuscated><gold>Returning to Balance",MMLore:["<!italic><!underlined><!strikethrough><!bold><!obfuscated><light_purple>* Quest Item *","#Q110I08"]},HideFlags:1,title:"b",author:"Salazar",plain:{display:{Name:"Returning to Balance",Lore:["* Quest Item *","#Q110I08"]}},display:{Name:'{"bold":false,"italic":false,"underlined":false,"strikethrough":false,"obfuscated":false,"color":"gold","text":"Returning to Balance"}',Lore:['{"italic":false,"color":"dark_gray","extra":[{"bold":false,"italic":false,"underlined":false,"strikethrough":false,"obfuscated":false,"color":"light_purple","text":"* Quest Item *"}],"text":""}','{"italic":false,"color":"dark_gray","extra":["#Q110I08"],"text":""}']},resolved:1b}

mmlore: <!italic><!underlined><!strikethrough><!bold><!obfuscated><light_purple>* Quest Item *
Rotting Journal.nbt: {pages:['{"extra":[{"underlined":true,"text":"Day 1:"},{"text":"\\n"},{"text":"\\n"},{"color":"black","text":"I\'m not proud of the things that have transpired this day, but I did what I must to protect myself, and well as my apprentice. It hurt me to leave without saying goodbye, but it had to be done. Their eyes were observing "}],"text":""}','{"extra":[{"text":"me, all over Sierhaven. No matter where I went, I could feel their ever-present glare looming over me, as if my research had lead me down a dark path of information that was never meant to be stumbled upon. Damn the Blackbearer...  I dare not even write his name. "}],"text":""}','{"extra":[{"text":"name. Regardless, I must continue my research, even if it means doing so in hiding."},{"text":"\\n"},{"text":"\\n"},{"underlined":true,"color":"black","text":"Day 3:"},{"text":"\\n"},{"text":"\\n"},{"color":"black","text":"I have reached the area colloquially known as the \\"Anthill\\". While there aren\'t "},{"text":"\\n"},{"text":"\\n"},{"color":"black","text":" "}],"text":""}','{"extra":[{"text":"many ants in sight, there are certainly enough soulless zombies and Creepers to keep one busy. That is, unless zombies and Creepers do, in fact, have souls. Actually, that is an interesting prospect. I\'ll make a note to research that later."}],"text":""}','{"extra":[{"underlined":true,"text":"Day 9:"},{"text":"\\n"},{"text":"\\n"},{"color":"black","text":"Of all the horrid things to occur in this wretched dungeon, a tunnel collapse was the last thing I needed to happen. I don\'t believe I\'ve ever witnessed a Creeper act so focused before. Usually that species just "}],"text":""}','{"extra":[{"text":"mindlessly detonates at the sight of movement, in a bid to spread its spores onto the rotting flesh of whatever poor soul got caught in the blast. This Creeper, however, I felt something akin to intelligence, as if it were specifically "},{"text":"\\n"},{"color":"black","text":" "}],"text":""}','{"extra":[{"text":"targeting me. What is this place?"},{"text":"\\n"},{"text":"\\n"},{"underlined":true,"color":"black","text":"Day 15:"},{"text":"\\n"},{"text":"\\n"},{"color":"black","text":"The more I travel down these seemingly endless pathways, the more I notice the same phenomenon that I originally witnessed with that Creeper, an "}],"text":""}','{"extra":[{"text":"inherent self-realization, a tandem in which all the creatures in these tunnels move and react. It\'s as if every action they are taking were... guided. By what though? I also can\'t help but note the voices, always coming from a "}],"text":""}','{"extra":[{"text":"distance, yet they feel as if they are right behind me at all times."},{"text":"\\n"},{"text":"\\n"},{"underlined":true,"color":"black","text":"Day 23:"},{"text":"\\n"},{"text":"\\n"},{"color":"black","text":"I\'m not sure how much longer I can continue. The voices continue to grow louder, shouting at me from the very depths of my being. "},{"text":"\\n"},{"text":"\\n"},{"color":"black","text":" "}],"text":""}','{"extra":[{"text":"My pacing has slowed significantly, as I try to maintain my composure. Am I going going crazy?"},{"text":"\\n"},{"text":"\\n"},{"underlined":true,"color":"black","text":"Day 25:"},{"text":"\\n"},{"text":"\\n"},{"color":"black","text":"Today, something quite marvelous happened. I had given up and was making my way back through the tunnels, in "}],"text":""}','{"extra":[{"text":"an effort to find an exit. As I traveled through the darkness, the ground below me gave way, and I began plummeting into the earth. Surely, I thought, this was my death. Oh how wrong I was. I found myself on a platform, centered in a room "}],"text":""}','{"extra":[{"text":"that was almost certainly man-made. Across the room, there lied a structure made of pure Lapis. Most men would marvel at the riches that they had just stumbled upon, but I\'m far more curious as to how it got here. Who would go to such"}],"text":""}','{"extra":[{"text":"lengths as to build something this extravagant so far beneath the surface? Now, if only the voices would hush and let me think."},{"text":"\\n"},{"text":"\\n"},{"underlined":true,"color":"black","text":"Day 27:"},{"text":"\\n"},{"text":"\\n"},{"color":"black","text":"The more I study this room, the more I am  "},{"text":"\\n"},{"color":"black","text":" "}],"text":""}','{"extra":[{"text":"certain I do not belong here. Visions constantly flash through my mind; horrid sights of carnage, cities set ablaze. As such, I\'m ending this trip early. I can\'t keep myself here any longer, lest I actually let my mind slip into insanity. I long for the comfort "}],"text":""}','{"extra":[{"text":"of home, so I will return to my lab just outside of Nyr. At least there I know I will be safe. Perhaps, I can even reach out to Dimitri when I get back. Now just to find my way out of here."}],"text":""}'],generation:0,Enchantments:[{lvl:1s,id:"minecraft:power"}],Monumenta:{MMLore:["<!italic><!underlined><!strikethrough><!bold><!obfuscated><light_purple>* Quest Item *","#Q30I02"]},HideFlags:1,title:"Rotting Journal",author:"Ignos",plain:{display:{Lore:["* Quest Item *","#Q30I02"]}},display:{Lore:['{"italic":false,"color":"dark_gray","extra":[{"bold":false,"italic":false,"underlined":false,"strikethrough":false,"obfuscated":false,"color":"light_purple","text":"* Quest Item *"}],"text":""}','{"italic":false,"color":"dark_gray","extra":["#Q30I02"],"text":""}']},resolved:1b}

Sacred Duty.name: Sacred Duty
Sacred Duty.nbt: {pages:['{"text":"I am glad the affair with that vile demonspawn is over. One would think stabbing a cackling goblin and shoving its entire existence into the Prison we built explicitly for it wouldn\'t be that hard, but by the Architect do they fight and squirm. It had such an... attitude as well."}','{"text":"I was not expecting these creatures to have personalities. They are a living embodiment of the magic that flows through the firmament itself, yet they still have lives. I cannot begin to imagine the power flowing through them. This one claimed its name was \\"Magic\\" and that it was the"}','{"text":"source of all magic that has ever existed and ever will. Not that it stopped my team and I from casting a massive ritual to finally keep it from blinking all over the place and FINALLY contain it. I try at last to settle in and log my journey to this place. The containment box is in place, my fellow"}','{"text":"Knights have begun the process of travelling back to the Architect via Silvergates, and I can at last bask in the quiet and keep watch over the Prison. I have earned this rest."}','{"text":"I am uncertain how long it has been since I have last put pen to parchment. I have been startled from my rest by sounds. A commotion in the caverns outside this room. Are the protections not enough? Even as the darkness settles around me, I feel almost as if I am being"}','{"text":"watched this very moment, a gaze from somewhere beyond this material plane.\\n\\nI do not like this feeling. I will report my findings after I have dealt with whatever is happening outside here. This intruder will regret their interference with my sacred duty."}'],plain:{display:{Name:"Sacred Duty"}},Monumenta:{MMName:"<!italic><!underlined><!bold><white>Sacred Duty"},display:{Name:'{"bold":false,"italic":false,"underlined":false,"color":"white","text":"Sacred Duty"}'},title:"Sacred Duty",author:"Silver Knight Merdd"}

If you\\u0027re reading this, I am within."},{"text":"\\n"},{"text":"\\n"},{"color":"black","text":"I really hope a bad guy doesn\\u0027t find this book... I just want you to be able to find me Eowen."}],"text":""}'],generation:0,Enchantments:[{lvl:1s,id:"minecraft:power"}],Monumenta:{MMLore:["<!italic><!underlined><!strikethrough><!bold><!obfuscated><light_purple>* Quest Item *","#Q37I01"]},HideFlags:1,title:"Safe Room Key",author:"Kurtis",plain:{display:{Lore:["* Quest Item *","#Q37I01"]}},display:{Lore:['{"italic":false,"color":"dark_gray","extra":[{"bold":false,"italic":false,"underlined":false,"strikethrough":false,"obfuscated":false,"color":"light_purple","text":"* Quest Item *"}],"text":""}','{"italic":false,"color":"dark_gray","extra":["#Q37I01"],"text":""}']},resolved:1b}

mmlore: <light_purple>* Quest Item *
Scout's Log: Laura.name: Scout's Log: Laura
Scout's Log: Laura.nbt: {pages:['{"text":"First day on the job! I always hoped I\\u0027d be picked for the really important recon jobs, and I think I\\u0027ve landed a big one! Those horrible bandits plaguing Sierhaven have a massive stronghold, and who gets to scout it out? I do!"}','{"text":"I\\u0027m three days in, but finally I saw something interesting. A boat started travelling to the north, toward the walls of the Valley. I\\u0027ve not the foggiest why. There\\u0027s nothing there!"}','{"text":"I saw men come from out of the wall to unload the ship. What is going on over there? Where are they taking those supplies? If only I could get closer. There shouldn\\u0027t be anything there except a wall."}','{"text":"After a few days of nothing, I saw a boat return from the north. I\\u0027m growing suspicious, but this mission was given to me as observe and report only. I really hope they\\u0027ve not spotted me..."}','{"text":"The bandits must have somehow managed to build a warehouse into the Valley\\u0027s walls. It is the only thing that makes sense, but how would they get the resources to afford something like that."}','{"text":"There\\u0027s been a flurry of activity in the stronghold recently, and boats are§0\\n"}','{"text":"*The remaining pages are blank, as if the author forgot to continue writing, and never returned for the book.*"}'],generation:0,Enchantments:[{lvl:1s,id:"minecraft:power"}],Monumenta:{MMName:"<!italic><!underlined><!bold><#52aa00>Scout's Log: Laura",MMLore:["<light_purple>* Quest Item *","#Q49I01"]},HideFlags:1,title:"Scout's Log: Lau",author:"Laura",plain:{display:{Name:"Scout's Log: Laura",Lore:["* Quest Item *","#Q49I01"]}},display:{Name:'{"bold":false,"italic":false,"underlined":false,"color":"#52AA00","text":"Scout\'s Log: Laura"}',Lore:['{"italic":false,"color":"dark_gray","extra":[{"color":"light_purple","text":"* Quest Item *"}],"text":""}','{"italic":false,"color":"dark_gray","extra":["#Q49I01"],"text":""}']},resolved:1b}

Shade Hunter's Log - Doomed Encampment.name: Shade Hunter's Log - Doomed Encampment
Shade Hunter's Log - Doomed Encampment.nbt: {pages:['{"text":"The Shades are heavy around this place. We\'ve been calling it the Doomed Encampment because of how many Shade Hunters have died here. This seemed like a good place to set up an outpost in the early days following the vanishing, but it turned out there was a reason it was so"}','{"text":"pristine. Emperor Pelias had locked it up because the old Silver Knight training grounds inside was already full of Shades. Before the rest of the Keep had fallen. Something fishy happened here, but nobody has survived a trip deep inside to determine what. I think that if a Shade"}','{"text":"Hunter - like yours truly - could survive a trip to the bottom of that old tower, I - or any Shade Hunter really - could learn quite a lot about what caused this event. Maybe even a way to stop them!"}','{"text":"My request to attack the Doomed Encampment has been denied. I guess I\'ll have to find glory some other way."}','{"text":"Actually, never mind, I\'m going. The Praetor can\'t tell me what to do. None of them are brave enough to try after the twins died a few years ago. \\"This place is surely doomed\\", Marius keeps saying. \\"There is no value in disturbing the oldest ghosts\\". Obviously, I think that\'s absurd. If we"}','{"text":"want any hope of clearing the Shade infection once and for all, the Shades that have been roaming the longest are surely the best to investigate. Anyway, I\'m writing this from the south tower right outside the encampment. May the Architect build my path below my feet."}','{"text":"I\'m going in."}','{"text":"I\'m back out. Shouldn\'t have done that. I didn\'t even make it to the tower. Marius wasn\'t joking, these Shades are nasty. I get why everyone is certain they\'re older than the rest of the Shades. They seem more... aware? Most Shades just go about their paths and only really go for Ashkii"}','{"text":"when they get really hungry, but these things? As soon as they saw me, they came right for me. Broke right from their wanderings. Once they lost sight of me, it got creepier. They kept hunting. They didn\'t just break away and continue about their mechanical tasks. They NEEDED to find me. I"}','{"text":"had to travel across the rooftops to get away. I don\'t know what\'s down there, but I really don\'t like it."}'],Enchantments:[{lvl:1s,id:"minecraft:power"}],Monumenta:{MMName:"<!italic><!underlined><!bold><white>Shade Hunter's Log - Doomed Encampment",MMLore:["<light_purple>* Quest Item *","<dark_gray>#Q208I01"]},HideFlags:1,title:"Shade Hunter 1",author:"Cleofra",plain:{display:{Name:"Shade Hunter's Log - Doomed Encampment",Lore:["* Quest Item *","#Q208I01"]}},display:{Name:'{"bold":false,"italic":false,"underlined":false,"color":"white","text":"Shade Hunter\'s Log - Doomed Encampment"}',Lore:['{"italic":false,"color":"dark_gray","extra":[{"color":"light_purple","text":"* Quest Item *"}],"text":""}','{"italic":false,"color":"dark_gray","extra":[{"color":"dark_gray","text":"#Q208I01"}],"text":""}']}}

mmlore: <light_purple>* Quest Item *
<dark_gray>#Q208I02
Shade Hunter's Log - Silvic Quarry.name: Shade Hunter's Log - Silvic Quarry
Shade Hunter's Log - Silvic Quarry.nbt: {pages:['{"text":"I’ve followed the trail of a particularly infamous Shade today. We call him Braccus, on account of how strange his arms are. Misshapen, swollen, and discolored, even for a Shade. Ol’ Braccus takes the same route every few days. He exits the Quarry, acting as if he is moving a cart by"}','{"text":"hand, and pushes his invisible trolley to the Manor. Once there, he breaks loose from his script for a day or two and ravages on any poor souls who dare linger there. Then, as if a switch flips, he pushes his imaginary cart back to the Quarry, and vanishes for a few days. Today, I\'m"}','{"text":"choosing to make the mistake of following him into the Quarry. This place is immensely dangerous, packed to the brim with Shades of former miners, still trying to dig through the bowels of the earth to seek Pelias’ folly. Rather than cutting down the Shades that will surely rise once"}','{"text":"more, my only goal is to follow Braccus and see what he does. With how he seems to break free from his echoes at the Manor, I need to know if he does the same here."}','{"text":"I’m writing this entry deeper in the Quarry now, the violet crystalline glow illuminating the environment. This place didn’t used to be this large, by the Architect! These Shades aren’t just trying to dig still. Even in their endless, mindless fervor, they\'ve expanded the"}','{"text":"reaches of the Quarry far beyond what surviving records imply. Could the Shades actually be seeking something, deep below the Keep? Their humanity has been robbed from them, bodies left to function on the faintest traces of memory and the hunger they need to"}','{"text":"survive, but could they still feel the call? Could their humanity still be out there, beyond their reach? Perhaps I’m just waxing philosophical this time. I’ll update again when I’m safe and have eyes on Braccus."}','{"text":"He’s gone. I watched him getting to work in the depths of the quarry, only for him to vanish the moment I took my eyes off him. Did he spot me? Did the others spot me? Or is there a passageway I can’t see from my erch that he’s traveling down that would explain his long absences above?"}','{"text":"I’m not sure, nor do I feel I can safely follow any further. I’ll return to the Keep for now and see if the pattern resumes.\\n\\nGuint signing off - the rest of my report will be in person, to the Praetor."}'],Enchantments:[{lvl:1s,id:"minecraft:power"}],Monumenta:{MMName:"<!italic><!underlined><!bold><white>Shade Hunter's Log - Silvic Quarry",MMLore:["<light_purple>* Quest Item *","<dark_gray>#Q208I02"]},HideFlags:1,title:"Shade Log 2",author:"Guintorius",plain:{display:{Name:"Shade Hunter's Log - Silvic Quarry",Lore:["* Quest Item *","#Q208I02"]}},display:{Name:'{"bold":false,"italic":false,"underlined":false,"color":"white","text":"Shade Hunter\'s Log - Silvic Quarry"}',Lore:['{"italic":false,"color":"dark_gray","extra":[{"color":"light_purple","text":"* Quest Item *"}],"text":""}','{"italic":false,"color":"dark_gray","extra":[{"color":"dark_gray","text":"#Q208I02"}],"text":""}']}}

She Is Not Here.name: She Is Not Here
She Is Not Here.nbt: {pages:['{"text":"She is not here. For decades we have searched, but still, nothing. She cannot be dead - the Aphelions still hear the whispers of Andromeda - but she has yet to contact her most devout.\\n\\nFor now, I will watch and wait."}'],plain:{display:{Name:"She Is Not Here"}},Monumenta:{MMName:"<!italic><!underlined><!strikethrough><!bold><!obfuscated><white>She Is Not Here"},display:{Name:'{"bold":false,"italic":false,"underlined":false,"strikethrough":false,"obfuscated":false,"color":"white","text":"She Is Not Here"}'},title:"She Is Not Here",author:"Stargazer Rosharr"}

She Knows Best.name: She Knows Best
She Knows Best.nbt: {pages:['{"text":"Mistress Hedera knows best. She knows the ancient ways. She knows the plants by sight. She knows the brews to cheat death. She knows how to walk the Veil. There is no other witch queen we would dare follow.\\n\\nThe sea has become our new home following our..."}','{"text":"excommunication from the Coven. It seems those witches don\'t understand the value of power. They\'d rather spend their days battling the Dichen for control of trees. Here, we seek much greater ambition. The God Beyond... she knows what is best for us. Yes..."}'],Monumenta:{MMName:"<!italic><!underlined><!strikethrough><!bold><!obfuscated><white>She Knows Best"},title:"She Knows Best",author:"Alavere",plain:{display:{Name:"She Knows Best"}},display:{Name:'{"bold":false,"italic":false,"underlined":false,"strikethrough":false,"obfuscated":false,"color":"white","text":"She Knows Best"}'},resolved:1b}

mmlore: <light_purple>* Quest Item *
Singularity.name: Singularity
Singularity.nbt: {pages:['{"text":"It has been done. Reality has been brought to its rightful place, and has taken root at the core of the Veil. Soon, I will be unable to reach it, if I even wished to do so.\\n\\nThis is, in a sense, where I will take my final breath. It will not be soon, but there is"}','{"text":"no avoiding it. As soon as I entered this place, my fate was sealed. As soon as the Architect made His will known...\\n\\nIt is strange. Ever since our order was formed, we have always known this would be our end state."}','{"text":"Defending our work until time itself forces us to take our final breath.\\n\\nAnd yet.\\n\\nAnd yet..."}','{"text":"Is it strange to fear death, even when I have prepared for it my entire existence?\\n\\nI am already gone, in all ways that matter.\\n\\nAnd still, I remain."}','{"text":"\\n\\n"}','{"text":"Perhaps I simply hoped I would have had longer."}','{"text":"\\n\\n"}','{"text":"My connection to the Architect already begins to fade, mere minutes after my arrival.\\n\\nSoon, it will be gone entirely, and I will be left entirely alone."}','{"text":"I am already dead.\\n\\nAnd yet.\\n\\nAnd, yet...","color":"black"}'],Enchantments:[{lvl:1s,id:"minecraft:power"}],Monumenta:{MMName:"<!italic><!underlined><!bold><gold>Singularity",MMLore:["<light_purple>* Quest Item *","#Q156I10"]},HideFlags:1,title:"Book",author:"Silver Knight Irrus",plain:{display:{Name:"Singularity",Lore:["* Quest Item *","#Q156I10"]}},display:{Name:'{"bold":false,"italic":false,"underlined":false,"color":"gold","text":"Singularity"}',Lore:['{"italic":false,"color":"dark_gray","extra":[{"color":"light_purple","text":"* Quest Item *"}],"text":""}','{"italic":false,"color":"dark_gray","extra":["#Q156I10"],"text":""}']}}

Starvation.nbt: {author:"Calix",pages:['"Many, many moons ago, the Shrine of Sunken Faith was a home for the peoples who would become the Porphyry cult, the backbone of the Wolfswood Coven. Their magics and generous worship of the land called a being into shape, a Genius Loci, soon titled Ru\'Ten. Over time, Ru\'Ten grew in"','"strength and protected the people who offered him veneration and worship. Mighty temples were raised from the sunken land and kept afloat by Ru\'Ten\'s will alone. All was peaceful. The earth provided and Ru\'Ten was the earth. He hungered for nothing and his people"','"wanted nothing but to give him adoration.\\n\\nThen the eye of the Architect turned upon that sunken place. He was not seeking to interfere, only to find a place to keep safe a relic he had recently claimed, much to the anger of the Dryads of the mainland nearby."','"Knights clad in radiant Silver armor marched upon the Shrine and with them they carried the Wolf. They approached Ru\'Ten and offered him penance for what they would ask of him. Protect this relic from the Coven from far away. The ocean between will keep them safe. In return,"','"Ru\'Ten would receive power from this relic like nothing he had ever enjoyed before. Worship alone could not sate him, the Knights told him. The Wolf would grant him domain over Life. He would be full, at last. Forever. As long as he kept it safe.\\n\\nRu\'Ten agreed."','"The Wolf changed him. While the Porphyry still offered him penance, he no longer felt their radiant worship for the relic he held close gave him such power. The Knights had spoken true - he no longer felt a hunger. He was satiated. He dug deeper below the Sanctum and began to"','"disconnect from his people.\\n\\nTime passed, as moons waxed and waned. Then the Witches came. Centures spent raising the sea floor had finally allowed Hycenea\'s roots to take within the Sanctum and her Witchknights struck true, claiming the Wolf"','"from Ru\'Ten\'s grasp and taking the Porphyry with her. For the first time since his birth, Ru\'Ten was alone. And he was hungry."'],title:"Starvation"}

Struck Down.nbt: {pages:['{"text":"C\'Telsket picked a target - the colonizer settlement of Farr, built on the ruins of the once mighty Tlaxan fortress, Velara. He rallied his forces and somehow pulled the Beastmen tribe of the Serpensia to his aid. They assaulted the fortress. In their haste, they were"}','{"text":"thwarted. The colonizer\'s mage army fought back and somehow found both C\'Telsket and the god he spoke to. They both were killed. This was the end of the Sons of the Forest at that time. For so long the organization lay dormant, as the Tlaxan people remained subjugated"}','{"text":"by the colonizers. Then one day, Cazol arrived in the Valley."}'],Enchantments:[{lvl:1s,id:"minecraft:power"}],Monumenta:{MMName:"<!italic><!underlined><!strikethrough><!bold><!obfuscated><white>Struck Down"},HideFlags:1,title:"Struck Down",author:"Tkenar",plain:{display:{Name:"Struck Down"}},display:{Name:'{"bold":false,"italic":false,"underlined":false,"strikethrough":false,"obfuscated":false,"color":"white","text":"Struck Down"}'},resolved:1b}

The Case of the Unreadable Book.name: The Case of the Unreadable Book
The Case of the Unreadable Book.nbt: {pages:['{"text":"Has anyone else found books they just can\'t seem to read? I spent a solid week coming back to this little book because I found a book that I physically could not keep open. Seriously! I would open it, I would see words on the page, and I would recognize them as words I know. Then,"}','{"text":"I would find myself with a closed book in my hand, and I couldn\'t remember a single letter of what I\'d just read. I cannot make heads of tails of it! This is the sort of tome that belongs in the Conscriptorium, I think. It\'s making me go absolutely crazy!!"}'],plain:{display:{Name:"The Case of the Unreadable Book"}},Monumenta:{MMName:"<!italic><!underlined><!strikethrough><!bold><!obfuscated><white>The Case of the Unreadable Book"},display:{Name:'{"bold":false,"italic":false,"underlined":false,"strikethrough":false,"obfuscated":false,"color":"white","text":"The Case of the Unreadable Book"}'},title:"The Case of the",author:"Whynard Rofesse"}

The Conduit.name: The Conduit
The Conduit.nbt: {pages:['{"text":"I sense them. The Outsider Made Conduit. They bring ruin wherever they walk. They place the other gods into a stasis to hide their powers. This will not happen to us. They will not have the shard. They will not destroy what we have put so much work into. This is our design. Our life\'s blood. Our work"}','{"text":"eternal. It calls to me still, begging me to not let them hurt it. It shouldn\'t be afraid. I can destroy the Outsider. I can bring them low and then the fragment of the darkest god will channel through me, their conduit, and take the Outsider too. Then we shall grow. Forever."}'],plain:{display:{Name:"The Conduit"}},Monumenta:{MMName:"<!italic><!underlined><!strikethrough><!bold><!obfuscated><white>The Conduit"},display:{Name:'{"bold":false,"italic":false,"underlined":false,"strikethrough":false,"obfuscated":false,"color":"white","text":"The Conduit"}'},title:"The Conduit",author:"R'Kitxet"}

The Creature.nbt: {pages:['{"text":"The darkness swelled behind him, swallowing the light from his lamp. The damp stones beneath his feet squelched with every step and the soft sounds of flowing and dripping water contrasted with the echoes of his footsteps."}','{"text":"Armand was alone in his hunt for the Monster.§0\\n§0\\n§0No other in Nyr was brave enough to enter the sprawling sewers below the city to hunt for the creature that took Alyssi several days before. But Armand was brave!"}','{"text":"That\'s what he kept telling himself anyway. Yet he still found himself shivering every time he heard the slightest noise; rats skittering, water dripping. The sewers were sweltering, humidity causing sweat to blossom on Armand\'s face and drip down his"}','{"text":"nose, tickling the skin softly. He resisted the urge to wipe it away, instead clutching tighter to his covered lamp and sharp stone sword.§0\\n§0\\n§0He turned slowly around a corner and recoiled briefly. Before him was a "}','{"text":"quivering mass of goo. The monster?! He steeled himself and took in a breath. The goo did not react. After several frozen seconds, Armand realized this was not the slime he was searching for, but leftovers. He approached slowly,"}','{"text":"just in case the ooze was waiting to trap him. He inched closer, steadied his sword, and stabbed aggressively into the slime pile.§0\\n§0\\n§0It sat there as the sword plunged into the mass and did not move. Armand was right."}','{"text":"This was no monster. He pulled back the blade, wiping it on a nearby wall to remove the dripping ooze and began to move further down the wide passage.§0\\n§0\\n§0Behind him, an eye opened.§0\\n§0\\n"}','{"text":"Armand continued down the passage, emboldened a bit. His stab had been perfect! The sweet slick squelch as the blade entered the nasty ooze had been so satisfying! The real monster stood no chance! Armand was ready to vindicate"}','{"text":"all of Nyr. Maybe he could find and save Alyssi too!§0\\n§0\\n§0Behind him, the shadows stirred.§0\\n§0\\n§0Behind him the shadows loomed.§0\\n§0\\n§0Behind him, sounds began to slither."}','{"text":"Armand was blissfully unaware, climbing up a collapsed set of walls, approaching a doorway displaying a hazy glow. Before him was a room stuffed with pipes, water flowing heavily through them with a rushing sound. His ears perked up."}','{"text":"Was that a squishing sound? Was the ooze nearby?§0\\n§0\\n§0Behind him, two eyes reflected the hazy glow, peering at Armand\'s back.§0\\n§0\\n§0Armand spun. Armand screamed, and stabbed forth with his sword,"}','{"text":"hitting nothing but a wall of ooze. The ooze surged forward and Armand dropped the sword, leaving it quivering in the mass before him and began to run deeper into the room. The creature surged forward, pursuing him, the sound of rushing water nearby"}','{"text":"masking any noise it could be making. Armand continued to scream, swinging the lamp wildly before him to try and light the way. He ran blindly, rushing through hallways, and finding himself back in the room with pipes. There was no sign of the monster."}','{"text":"He heard nothing but the rushing water. He held nothing but a lamp.§0\\n§0\\n§0Then he heard it. Behind him. A squelching stepping noise. A groan.§0\\n§0\\n§0Armand didn\'t even turn to look. He dropped his lamp"}','{"text":"and ran.§0\\n§0\\n§0The monster is still down here. Waiting. Beware the Giant Ooze, for it will not be so forgiving again."}'],generation:0,title:"The Creature",author:"Pauline",resolved:1b}

The Dead.name: The Dead
The Dead.nbt: {pages:['{"text":"Descrated bodies, already fallen. Filled with those who still cling to life. Entrails speak to the beyond and demand an answer. The answer must then be contained."}'],plain:{display:{Name:"The Dead"}},Monumenta:{MMName:"<!italic><!underlined><!strikethrough><!bold><!obfuscated><white>The Dead"},display:{Name:'{"bold":false,"italic":false,"underlined":false,"strikethrough":false,"obfuscated":false,"color":"white","text":"The Dead"}'},title:"The Dead",author:"???"}

The Disc Shrine.nbt: {pages:['{"text":"Just after the halls shifted, I decided to step out of my outpost due to my dwindling supplies. The overgrown section provided me some food which should last me a couple more days, but what was interesting was the room right across my front door."}','{"text":"It seems to be some kind of shrine holding a disc. I decided to give it a listen to, figuring I haven\\u0027t exactly heard any music for a few months at this point. A beautiful track, I must say, but as I was listening to it, the halls shifted yet again."}','{"text":"I guess this will be my temporary outpost, at least until I find my real one. It took me a week to find it the last time I lost it, so let\\u0027s hope we get lucky."}'],generation:0,title:"The Disc Shrine",author:"Kent",resolved:1b}

The Experience of Time.nbt: {pages:['{"text":"We see colors, hear sounds, and feel texture. Some aspects of the world are percieved through particular senses. Others, like shape, are perceived through multiple senses. But what sense do we use to perceive time?"}','{"text":"It is not associated with one particular sense. In fact, it is odd to say that we see, hear, or touch time passing. Yet if all of these senses were unable to function for some while, we could still take notice of the passing of time. "}','{"text":"Time perception raises a number of intriguing puzzles, including what it means to say we perceive time."}','{"text":"The very expression \'the perception of time\' invites objection. Insofar as time is something different from events, we do not perceive time as such, but changes or events in time. But, arguably, we do not perceive events only, but also their temporal relations."}','{"text":"So, just as it is natural to say that we perceive spatial distances and other relations between objects, it seems natural to talk of perceiving one event following another, though even here there is a difficulty."}','{"text":"For what we perceive, we perceive as present—as going on right now. Can we perceive a relation between two events without also perceiving the events themselves? "}','{"text":"If not, then it seems we perceive both events as present, in which case we must perceive them as simultaneous, and so not as successive after all."}','{"text":"There is then a paradox in the notion of perceiving an event as occurring after another, though one that perhaps admits of a straightforward solution."}'],title:"The Experience of Time",author:"Luos Latrommi",resolved:1b}

The Fall.name: The Fall
The Fall.nbt: {pages:['{"text":"We pressed on, seeking the horizon in the hopes we could find another exit, with our pathway gone. Soon enough though, Aternam let out a cry. I turned and found him losing his balance as the earth yawned below him. The red glow lit his horrified face as I dove toward his falling form..."}'],Monumenta:{MMName:"<!italic><!underlined><!strikethrough><!bold><!obfuscated><white>The Fall"},title:"The Fall",author:"Baetholomew",plain:{display:{Name:"The Fall"}},display:{Name:'{"bold":false,"italic":false,"underlined":false,"strikethrough":false,"obfuscated":false,"color":"white","text":"The Fall"}'},resolved:1b}

The Field.name: The Field
The Field.nbt: {pages:['{"text":"These passages change. Sometimes they are not passages at all. The doorways open into baffling rooms, ruins of citadels, and, only once, an open field. That was where I lost Aternam, you see. That damned field in the middle of the darkest depths of the deepest oceans..."}'],plain:{display:{Name:"The Field"}},Monumenta:{MMName:"<!italic><!underlined><!strikethrough><!bold><!obfuscated><white>The Field"},display:{Name:'{"bold":false,"italic":false,"underlined":false,"strikethrough":false,"obfuscated":false,"color":"white","text":"The Field"}'},title:"The Field",author:"Baetholomew"}

The Final Disc.nbt: {pages:['{"text":"Gah, I swear, swimming through miles of water just to get nowhere sucks. I was really dreading the trek, and despite waiting for the next shift, I was still cursed with small cities and no outpost in sight. It\\u0027s been nothing but a lack of air for weeks."}','{"text":"I believe I\\u0027ve found another disc shrine though, but this one is somehow the most rewarding one yet. Finally, a place I can truly breathe in. I can\\u0027t stay for long though - I fear a shift is happening soon and I\\u0027d rather be back in the wilds for it."}'],generation:0,title:"The Final Disc",author:"Kent",resolved:1b}

Then, above, in the swirling sky, an eye opened. Another soon followed, then another and another, until I was being witnessed by dozens of gazes at once..."}'],Monumenta:{MMName:"<!italic><!underlined><!strikethrough><!bold><!obfuscated><white>The Gaze"},title:"The Gaze",author:"Baetholomew",plain:{display:{Name:"The Gaze"}},display:{Name:'{"bold":false,"italic":false,"underlined":false,"strikethrough":false,"obfuscated":false,"color":"white","text":"The Gaze"}'},resolved:1b}

The Generals.nbt: {pages:['{"text":"The four generals of C\\u0027Zanil, Siershen, Selxem, Arvaya, and Cyrar, appear to have been high ranking Tlaxans (in most cases) working directly under C\\u0027Zanil during the Blackroot War. They were important enough, clearly, that he wanted them buried in his"}','{"text":"own tomb, as guardians of his knowledge.§0\\n§0\\n§0But who were these Generals? Why were they selected? What knowledge can we gleam from their resting places that can reveal more about these enigmatic figures?"}','{"text":"Luckily, I, Antigone Rellsource, along with my crack team, have uncovered some fascinating knowledge about these important figures. Read on for a complete set of translated writings and my personal commentary on them."}','{"text":"Cyrar:§0\\n§0\\n§0Written on the wall:§0\\n§0\\u0027Eyes (of a) hawk, aim (of) Ixume.\\u0027 Ixume being a Tlaxan god in their scripture, this says that Cyrar was an eagle-eyed sharpshooter.§0\\n§0\\n§0\\u0027Let the rain of arrows fall, called"}','{"text":"the attack, trusted by all.\\u0027 This points to Cyrar being the leader of the Tlaxan archery forces, raining down deadly artillery onto the battlefield.§0\\n§0\\n§0An additional find, by the intrepid Keller, points to Cyrar having been a simple Tlaxan"}','{"text":"villager who swiftly rose to fame for his sharpshooting talents. C\\u0027Zanil elevated him to General status as the war started, and the young Tlaxan felled hundreds himself."}','{"text":"Selxem:§0\\n§0\\n§0\\u0027Plagueroot\\u0027s Master.\\u0027 This was inscribed on one of the poison-filled brewing stations. I am unsure what Plagueroot is, but I initially assumed it was how the poison was made. However, the next finding made us reconsider."}','{"text":"\\u0027Only survivor (of the) Plagueroot Temple. Lord of poison. Myrahg\\u0027s chosen.\\u0027 It seems then to me that the Plagueroot Temple may have been a space where Myrahg - which we assume is the Magenta Wool - was contained. Could the wool be sealed away in this "}','{"text":"\\u0027Plagueroot Temple\\u0027 somewhere, leaking dangerous poisons? This seems to imply only Selxem survived being near it.§0\\n§0\\n§0We found nothing more on Selxem beyond those inscriptions."}','{"text":"Arvaya:§0\\n§0\\n§0\\u0027C\\u0027Zanil\\u0027s (chosen/favored) warlord. His speed, unrivaled by all.\\u0027 Arvaya was a leader of ground troops that were not associated with C\\u0027Shura, from what I can gather. If the statue Brayllur and the adventurer"}','{"text":"fought was meant to be a representation of Arvaya, the man must have been incredibly fast. The charge attack nearly killed me when I went in to research. I had to rely on Brayllur to transcribe things for me.§0\\n§0\\n§0\\u0027Left alone on the"}','{"text":"(summit/peak) as a(n offering/sacrifice). Soulcrusher offered choice.\\u0027 This seems to imply that C\\u0027Zanil saved Arvaya from a ritual sacrifice. I am unsure why and there is no more I can find on the topic."}','{"text":"Siershen:§0\\n§0\\n§0This is the most interesting of the bunch. I do not think Siershen was a Tlaxan. Look.§0\\n§0\\n§0\\u0027From where magic (is) sealed, he came, bearing gifts.\\u0027 I think Siershen came from a group of wizards"}','{"text":"who lived somewhere nearby. I believe there\\u0027s remnants of a magical tower near the Axtan Monastery, but I\\u0027ve not been allowed time to explore it. Could this be a sign of life that the Narsens never encountered?§0\\n§0\\n§0\\u0027He spoke words of wisdom (to the)"}','{"text":"Soulcrusher. Trust was formed.\\u0027 It seems whatever Siershen offered, C\\u0027Zanil was happy to take, and trusted the mage into his inner circle.§0\\n§0\\n§0I must know more. I hope I get to work on this project soon!"}'],generation:0,title:"The Generals",author:"Antigone",resolved:1b}

The Home.name: The Home
The Home.nbt: {pages:['{"text":"The Home. Broken. Shattered. Beat them with the very stones they lived upon, then take their hearts and devour them."}'],plain:{display:{Name:"The Home"}},Monumenta:{MMName:"<!italic><!underlined><!strikethrough><!bold><!obfuscated><white>The Home"},display:{Name:'{"bold":false,"italic":false,"underlined":false,"strikethrough":false,"obfuscated":false,"color":"white","text":"The Home"}'},title:"The Home",author:"???"}

The Horizon.name: The Horizon
The Horizon.nbt: {pages:['{"text":"The sky shone down that sickening purple radiance down onto the tall grass, interrupted by the red maws below. For awhile, our plan worked. Aternam and I traversed carefully into the field, avoiding the endless eternity within each of the maws. Our destination? Only the horizon..."}'],Monumenta:{MMName:"<!italic><!underlined><!strikethrough><!bold><!obfuscated><white>The Horizon"},title:"The Horizon",author:"Baetholomew",plain:{display:{Name:"The Horizon"}},display:{Name:'{"bold":false,"italic":false,"underlined":false,"strikethrough":false,"obfuscated":false,"color":"white","text":"The Horizon"}'},resolved:1b}

The Hunter's Prayer.name: The Hunter's Prayer
The Hunter's Prayer.nbt: {pages:['{"text":"Thank you majestic\\none for this hunt most\\nhonorable.\\nWe shall honor your\\nsacrifice by using\\nevery piece of you.\\nThe memory of your\\nfinal moments will\\nforever be a part of\\nus.\\nMay your spirit be\\nembraced by the\\ngoddess, knowing that\\nyou have served your"}','{"text":"purpose.\\n\\nThank you Diamene for\\nsharing with us your\\nbeasts to hunt.\\nGrant us wisdom and\\nrespect in the pursuit\\nand keep us humble in\\nthe harvest.\\nEven while you are\\ngone, we pray your\\nspirit will protect us.\\nUnspoiled, unbanished,\\nunharmed in victory,"}','{"text":"the lodge stands\\nstrong.\\n\\nYour time on this\\nearth will not be in\\nvain.\\nWe will hunt so you\\nmay soon be reborn.\\nWhat was once silver\\nwill tarnish,\\nBut the hunt will be\\never more."}'],Enchantments:[{lvl:1s,id:"minecraft:power"}],Monumenta:{MMName:"<!italic><!underlined><!bold><white>The Hunter's Prayer"},HideFlags:1,title:"The Hunter's Pr",author:"Siberathi",plain:{display:{Name:"The Hunter's Prayer"}},display:{Name:'{"bold":false,"italic":false,"underlined":false,"color":"white","text":"The Hunter\'s Prayer"}'}}

The Legend of Eldrask.name: The Legend of Eldrask
The Legend of Eldrask.nbt: {pages:['{"text":"There are legends told of a song that never ends.\\n\\nThe deep notes, rumbling through the firmament tell a tale of the creation of these isles. In time long before memory, before Chillwind was even a glimmer in the empire\'s eye, there were the Giants."}','{"text":"Incredible beings, massive beyond imagining, they moved the ground to their will, repairing the scars of some ancient cataclysm. With their powers, they reshaped this destroyed landmass to be their resting place. Master craftsmen, they shaped hills, pressed"}','{"text":"valleys, and raised mountains. It was then these beings rested. For centuries, their lands laid untouched, their slumbers undisturbed."}','{"text":"But soon, the song intones, came humanity.\\n\\nBeings small in stature, but large in power, they began to populate the lands the Giants had made. Led by a man called Alric, they created a life for themselves here. The song took notice. The Giants took notice."}','{"text":"Soon, some of the Sleepers began to wake, angered by these morsels crawling across their resting grounds."}','{"text":"The song picked up, a deep bass rumble, growing in intensity as the world grew tense.\\n\\nA battle drew close. Alric approached those who still slept and made a deal with one called Hrimnir, who granted him a gift, known only as Alei. Meanwhile, deep within a rift, a scar left on"}','{"text":"the landscape from anger forgotten by time, the Wakers came together, cleaving through ice to gather and plot. Humanity caught word, and Alric himself now stepped forth, ready to challenge these massive beings. With his Spear in one hand, and Alei in the other, Alric entered the rift."}','{"text":"The song grows.\\nThe rumbles swell.\\n\\nThen they ended, leaving behind only a quiet hum. Alric emerged from the rift, battered, bloody, but victorious. Behind him, the lifeblood of the Wakers flowed freely, becoming the rivers that now cross the continents."}','{"text":"The song did not end here though. It continued, softer. The Sleepers in time have begun to end, their time coming to a close. Empires have risen. The land has changed. The Giants are gone. Legends say that today they have all died, but the song still continues... Somewhere below these Isles,"}','{"text":"somewhere below those mountains still dwarfing the tundras, a Sleeper still rests, undisturbed and singing still.\\n\\nEldrask slumbers on."}'],Monumenta:{MMName:"<!italic><!underlined><!strikethrough><!bold><!obfuscated><white>The Legend of Eldrask"},title:"The Legend of E",author:"Listener",plain:{display:{Name:"The Legend of Eldrask"}},display:{Name:'{"bold":false,"italic":false,"underlined":false,"strikethrough":false,"obfuscated":false,"color":"white","text":"The Legend of Eldrask"}'},resolved:1b}

The Lunatic's Tale: Creation.nbt: {pages:['{"extra":[{"text":"In the beginning there was nothing but the Three."},{"text":"\\n"},{"color":"black","text":"Fair white was Strong Quetzal, power over souls."},{"text":"\\n"},{"color":"black","text":"Dark orange was Ixume, lord of the beasts."},{"text":"\\n"},{"color":"black","text":"Pale Magenta was Poison Myrahg; health and sickness were his domain."}],"text":""}','{"extra":[{"text":"\\n"},{"text":"\\n"},{"text":"\\n"},{"text":"\\n"},{"color":"black","text":"Together they created the pale magic."},{"text":"\\n"},{"color":"black","text":"Together they created the jungle."},{"text":"\\n"},{"color":"black","text":"Together they created the Tlaxani."}],"text":""}'],generation:0,title:"The Lunatic's Tale: Creation",author:"The Lunatic",resolved:1b}

The Lunatic's Tale: Ixume's Men.nbt: {pages:['{"extra":[{"text":"Among those were the Lunatics, men of Ixume."},{"text":"\\n"},{"color":"black","text":"Marked by his gifts, close to the beasts."},{"text":"\\n"},{"color":"black","text":"Jaguar, Hawk, and Snake, united under the Three."},{"text":"\\n"},{"color":"black","text":"Soon Tlaxan built temples for two"},{"text":"\\n"},{"color":"black","text":"But Ixume preferred the open sky."},{"text":"\\n"},{"color":"black","text":"And at night, when the full moon rose,"}],"text":""}','{"extra":[{"text":"\\n"},{"text":"\\n"},{"text":"\\n"},{"text":"\\n"},{"text":"\\n"},{"color":"black","text":"The Lunatics would dance in moonbeams for their god."}],"text":""}','{"extra":[{"text":"Soon yellow Kaul of the Blackroot would dance with the beasts."},{"text":"\\n"},{"color":"black","text":"Ixume looked down at this spirit and smiled."},{"text":"\\n"},{"color":"black","text":"But the wars soon to come would change much."},{"text":"\\n"},{"color":"black","text":"Soon enough Myrahg would sleep."},{"text":"\\n"},{"color":"black","text":"And be locked away as his sickness spread."}],"text":""}','{"extra":[{"text":"\\n"},{"text":"\\n"},{"text":"\\n"},{"text":"\\n"},{"text":"\\n"},{"color":"black","text":"Then the Soulcrusher would take Ixume when his bearer left"},{"text":"\\n"},{"color":"black","text":"And the Soulcrusher created the Beastmen."}],"text":""}'],generation:0,title:"The Lunatic's Tale: Ixume's Men",author:"The Lunatic",resolved:1b}

The Lunatic's Tale: Souls Crushed.name: The Lunatic's Tale: Souls Crushed
The Lunatic's Tale: Souls Crushed.nbt: {pages:['{"extra":[{"text":"No more would the Lunatics be free - "},{"text":"\\n"},{"color":"black","text":"Only men made from beasts as the blackroot raged."},{"text":"\\n"},{"color":"black","text":"Hawks grew wings, Jaguar found claws"},{"text":"\\n"},{"color":"black","text":"The Serpents retreated, blood running cold."},{"text":"\\n"},{"color":"black","text":"In the menagerie made and within they died."}],"text":""}','{"extra":[{"text":"\\n"},{"text":"\\n"},{"text":"\\n"},{"text":"\\n"},{"text":"\\n"},{"color":"black","text":"No help from Ixume as beasts howled for freedom."},{"text":"\\n"},{"color":"black","text":"Just silence and souls. Crushed and broken."}],"text":""}','{"extra":[{"text":"Experiments were done, creating beasts of men."},{"text":"\\n"},{"color":"black","text":"The tribes became feral, vicious, angry."},{"text":"\\n"},{"color":"black","text":"Locked within their cages as the Crusher made them skins."},{"text":"\\n"},{"color":"black","text":"Ixume was silent as his icon made monsters."},{"text":"\\n"},{"color":"black","text":"That pale orange glow as the flesh made anew."}],"text":""}','{"extra":[{"text":"\\n"},{"text":"\\n"},{"text":"\\n"},{"text":"\\n"},{"text":"\\n"},{"color":"black","text":"And the tribes transformed."},{"text":"\\n"},{"color":"black","text":"And the war lost."}],"text":""}','{"extra":[{"text":"\\n"},{"text":"\\n"},{"text":"\\n"},{"text":"\\n"},{"text":"\\n"},{"text":"\\n"},{"color":"black","text":"Ixume, we are sorry."}],"text":""}'],generation:0,Monumenta:{MMName:"<!italic><!underlined><!strikethrough><!bold><!obfuscated>The Lunatic's Tale: Souls Crushed"},title:"The Lunatic",author:"The Lunatic",plain:{display:{Name:"The Lunatic's Tale: Souls Crushed"}},display:{Name:'{"bold":false,"italic":false,"underlined":false,"strikethrough":false,"obfuscated":false,"text":"The Lunatic\'s Tale: Souls Crushed"}'},resolved:1b}

The Man in the Night.name: The Man in the Night
The Man in the Night.nbt: {pages:['{"text":"Growing up, I remember my father telling me the story of our ancestors before bed. He would tell me about the guilt our family would always be forced to bear.\\n\\nThe agonizing truth that the public does not understand, that we hide from a dark"}','{"text":"past, long sealed away and forgotten.\\n\\nI recall the meetings where Tyro\'s mother would accost my family\'s name, causing me to weep in my small corner where I would listen in without their knowing."}','{"text":"I always believed this burden would be mine to inherit, until the time wherein I return to the sand and pass it to my children.\\n\\nBut then... I met that man, and he showed me a new path. He came to me in a time of weakness, illustrating before me possibilities "}','{"text":"that I could have never even imagined.\\n\\nI knew this was the path I must take, for the sake of my family. I would finally turn this generations-long guilt into action, and ensure the mistakes of our past would never be repeated by anyone."}','{"text":"He asked from me a simple favor, gather my workforce in the north in order to collect a rare material within the earth.\\n\\nThis material, Cursestone, stores latent energy from the ground.\\n\\n"}','{"text":"As such, it is a vital need if he is to gather the amount of power needed to accomplish his goal.\\n\\nI eagerly await the day when I can sleep calmly at night, knowing I have allowed my ancestors to finally be at peace."}'],Enchantments:[{lvl:1s,id:"minecraft:power"}],Monumenta:{MMName:"<!italic><!underlined><!strikethrough><!bold><!obfuscated><gold>The Man in the Night",MMLore:["<!italic><!underlined><!strikethrough><!bold><!obfuscated><dark_gray>It seems to be a personal journal.","<!italic><!underlined><!strikethrough><!bold><!obfuscated><light_purple>* Quest Item *","#Q132I07"]},HideFlags:1,title:"b",author:"Pharaoh Nasha Ka",plain:{display:{Name:"The Man in the Night",Lore:["It seems to be a personal journal.","* Quest Item *","#Q132I07"]}},display:{Name:'{"bold":false,"italic":false,"underlined":false,"strikethrough":false,"obfuscated":false,"color":"gold","text":"The Man in the Night"}',Lore:['{"italic":false,"color":"dark_gray","extra":[{"bold":false,"italic":false,"underlined":false,"strikethrough":false,"obfuscated":false,"color":"dark_gray","text":"It seems to be a personal journal."}],"text":""}','{"italic":false,"color":"dark_gray","extra":[{"bold":false,"italic":false,"underlined":false,"strikethrough":false,"obfuscated":false,"color":"light_purple","text":"* Quest Item *"}],"text":""}','{"italic":false,"color":"dark_gray","extra":["#Q132I07"],"text":""}']},resolved:1b}

The Mimicylopedia.name: The Mimicylopedia
The Mimicylopedia.nbt: {pages:['{"text":"Mimics are a relatively mysterious creature. Some may beg to differ, though - any adventurer, explorer, or plunderer alike worth their salt knows to be wary around suspicious containers, but Mimics have many more overlooked characteristics beyond the ability to disguise as a chest!"}','{"text":"For example, did you know Mimics are very sensitive to climate and temperature? It\'s lead to an interesting conundrum for Mimics in the Isles - they can\'t handle the cold of the Chillwind, which essentially forces them into a hibernation in which they\'re near indistinguishable from a normal container."}','{"text":"At least once I\'ve heard of ship crew unknowningly transferring a Mimic out of the Chillwind, only for it to wake up mid-travel and attack the crew out of panic. It\'s worth mentioning that Mimics cannot swim either. On the side of the Isles, Mimics cannot survive the heat of Ishnir either."}','{"text":"The body of a Mimic is hyper-optimized towards staying in one position and conserving energy until its prey stumbles upon it. It has no way of cooling itself off on its own, leading to a quick death in intense heat. But what about the Viridian Islands? While the temperate climate"}','{"text":"seems like it would be perfect for a Mimic, they\'ve been near hunted to extinction by the excess of pirates and treasure hunters that frequent the region. Outside of the Isles, Mimics tend to find more success- the King\'s Valley has a sparse but thriving Mimic population. The Narsens have had "}','{"text":"greater issues to handle, and the native peoples, the Tlaxani, have little writings of Mimics at all, and appear to have rarely encountered them if ever. My own theory is that Mimics were brought to the Valley back when the Narsens first settled down in the area, having brought them"}','{"text":"with, without realizing. Mimics seem to thrive well enough upon the lone and greedy explorers attempting to pillage ruins and temples, and aren\'t known to be much of a threat in the Valley\\nbeyond that.\\n\\nSocially, Mimics appear to be solitary creatures on the "}','{"text":"surface. They take their (often small) hoards with them at all times, and are rarely seen to leave a location once they\'ve established themselves. However, stories I\'ve heard passed down by Viridian pirates across the ages tell of a Queen Mimic that was a right terror!"}','{"text":"Its (Her? We have no clue how Mimics reproduce even after all of this time!) spawn were said to be able to take more advanced disguises, atypical from the simple chest disguise. Additionally, the spawn acted in the interest of the Queen rather than their own, having been reported to"}','{"text":"bring the treasures they gather back to the Queen rather than keep it for themselves. The Mimic Queen was said to have built up a massive hoard, but eventually entirely disappeared, hoard and all, after the constant attacks from those trying to claim the hoard for"}','{"text":"themselves, reclaim the treasures they lost, or both! It\'s unknown if the pirates actually succeeded in taking down the Queen, or if the Queen hid itself and its hoard away where the pirates couldn\'t find it.\\n\\nThe obvious comparison here is that under a Queen,"}','{"text":"Mimics act similar to bees, living in their hoard rather than a hive, gathering treasure rather than pollen. It\'s likely the unique Mimics seen were more specialized types that served to better defend the hoard and the Queen, which would explain why they\'ve never been seen elsewhere."}','{"text":"Mimics are simply just fascinating creatures, and I wish my colleagues here at the Congress would at least pretend to care... They\'re all too focused on th%&*%**&\\n...   .   .. ..          .\\n*The pages are unreadable from this point onwards- the rest of the pages almost look dissolved*"}'],Monumenta:{MMName:"<!italic><!underlined><!bold><white>The Mimicylopedia"},title:"Mimicylopedia",author:"Researcher Chesterfield Sr.",plain:{display:{Name:"The Mimicylopedia"}},display:{Name:'{"bold":false,"italic":false,"underlined":false,"color":"white","text":"The Mimicylopedia"}'},resolved:1b}

The Mouths.name: The Mouths
The Mouths.nbt: {pages:['{"text":"The ground recognized our presence. The shivering was a sign. It was hungry. Between the blades of grass before us, mouths slowly opened and closed, masticating on nothing but the air, a deep red glow issuing forth from the throats below."}'],plain:{display:{Name:"The Mouths"}},Monumenta:{MMName:"<!italic><!underlined><!strikethrough><!bold><!obfuscated><white>The Mouths"},display:{Name:'{"bold":false,"italic":false,"underlined":false,"strikethrough":false,"obfuscated":false,"color":"white","text":"The Mouths"}'},title:"The Mouths",author:"Baetholomew"}

The Name.name: The Name
The Name.nbt: {pages:['{"text":"My name was no longer my own. A new name echoed in my mind. Rhygfar, Voice of the Deep God. She spared me in her mercy. She whispers to me still. The depths still call, and I will be the guide. She reaches from below, and soon this world will reach back."}'],plain:{display:{Name:"The Name"}},Monumenta:{MMName:"<!italic><!underlined><!strikethrough><!bold><!obfuscated><white>The Name"},display:{Name:'{"bold":false,"italic":false,"underlined":false,"strikethrough":false,"obfuscated":false,"color":"white","text":"The Name"}'},title:"The Name",author:"Baetholomew"}

The Natural.name: The Natural
The Natural.nbt: {pages:['{"text":"In the natural world there are many poisons. Feast upon the flesh of those connected to decay and then only will your eyes be opened."}'],plain:{display:{Name:"The Natural"}},Monumenta:{MMName:"<!italic><!underlined><!strikethrough><!bold><!obfuscated><white>The Natural"},display:{Name:'{"bold":false,"italic":false,"underlined":false,"strikethrough":false,"obfuscated":false,"color":"white","text":"The Natural"}'},title:"The Natural",author:"???"}

mmlore: <!italic><!underlined><!strikethrough><!bold><!obfuscated><dark_gray>A well documented account of
<!italic><!underlined><!strikethrough><!bold><!obfuscated><dark_gray>the rise of the tribunal pharaoh.
The Origin of the Pharaohs.name: The Origin of the Pharaohs
The Origin of the Pharaohs.nbt: {pages:['{"text":"My family, and all those who carry the blood of Kelika Ka, were the original rulers of Ishnir. \\n\\nAt this country\'s inception, they guided our people from lands to the south, to the desert wherein they would plant the foundations of Ishnir."}','{"text":"Those people, the early Ishnirans, claimed the feat to be a miracle, and foretold that Kelika and his kin carried the blood of the gods of homeland. For only through the will of the divine could such an establishment thrive."}','{"text":"The admiration towards the Ka family would persist for a couple hundred years, until the rule of Tehkma Ka, the Destroyer of Al Malakat.\\n\\nThrough the misuse of Cironds\' Gaze, the city was overrun by the undead. In his final"}','{"text":"act as pharaoh, Tehkma sealed the city away, and took the key to his grave.\\n\\nThe son of Tehkma, Denma Ka, would take the position of pharaoh, and would lead his people to find a new home."}','{"text":"In the southern reaches of the desert, they came to the mouth of a mighty river. \\n\\nIt was here that Denma decided to settle, and founded the new capital of Ishnir, Al Nahr.\\n"}','{"text":"However, the public anger was long from subsiding, and Denma was forced to bring about the end of the Ka dynasty. \\n\\nHe tasked his viziers with finding a suitable replacement family, one who also carried the blood of the gods."}','{"text":"The family chosen was the Den family, a branch family of the Ka\'s from some generations back.\\n\\nThus began the era of the Den dynasty, with the first pharaoh in the line, Komal Den."}','{"text":"Some 150 years passed, and the current pharaoh, Sela Den, began to grow worried of some underground rebellion factions, who advocated the return of the Ka\'s. \\n\\nOne day, at the shores of the "}','{"text":"river, he discovered an artifact drifting along the waters in a small chest.\\n\\nThe item, deemed \\"Saia\'s Grace\\", held an immense and awful power, the ability to control the minds of others."}','{"text":"Using this power, Sela warped the memories of the citizens of Ishnir. \\n\\nAnyone who did not bear the blood of Den, and by extension the blood of Ka, would forget all knowledge of the end of the Ka dynasty."}','{"text":"Sela then used all of his available resources to destroy documents pertaining to the existence of Al Malakut, and the pharaohs that brought about its end.\\n\\nAfraid of repeating the mistakes of the Ka family however,"}','{"text":"Sela would then hide away the artifact somewhere in the far northern reaches of the desert.\\n\\nThese measures produced the Sela\'s desired effect, and citizens no longer threatened Sela with an upheaval,"}','{"text":"as the memory and knowledge of the Ka\'s was long gone. \\n\\nEven today, this time period is known as a \\"blank\\" in history. However, Sela was arrogant to believe he understood his entire family history, and this flaw would be his undoing.\\n"}','{"text":"Unbeknownst to him, one other branch family from the Ka\'s existed, the Syl family, and because they bore the blood of the Ka\'s, they were unaffected by Sela\'s curse. It was with this fact that the head of the Syl family, Rommik Syl, began to blackmail Sela."}','{"text":"And with his final decree, Sela handed the throne of pharaoh over to the Syl family. Rommik was now the first pharaoh of the Syl Dynasty.\\n\\nThe Syl family would rule undisturbed for hundreds of years, until the year 721 CCE."}','{"text":"Facing extraordinary political pressure due to the active war with the Chillwind, the ruling pharaoh Tyrea Syl devised a plan. Not being one much for running an army, nor caring for power, she ensured a way to water down the position of pharaoh."}','{"text":"Through her guard, she tracked down the most recent descendants of the Ka and Den lineage.\\n\\nWith these in tow, she would break the throne of pharaoh into 3 seats, a tribunal monarchy. "}','{"text":"While controversial at the time, it would prove to be the most lasting and important decisions Tyrea would make as pharaoh, and it is a system that would persist to this day."}'],Enchantments:[{lvl:1s,id:"minecraft:power"}],Monumenta:{MMName:"<!italic><!underlined><!strikethrough><!bold><!obfuscated><gold>The Origin of the Pharaohs",MMLore:["<!italic><!underlined><!strikethrough><!bold><!obfuscated><dark_gray>A well documented account of","<!italic><!underlined><!strikethrough><!bold><!obfuscated><dark_gray>the rise of the tribunal pharaoh."]},HideFlags:1,title:"b",author:"Pharaoh Nasha Ka",plain:{display:{Name:"The Origin of the Pharaohs",Lore:["A well documented account of","the rise of the tribunal pharaoh."]}},display:{Name:'{"bold":false,"italic":false,"underlined":false,"strikethrough":false,"obfuscated":false,"color":"gold","text":"The Origin of the Pharaohs"}',Lore:['{"italic":false,"color":"dark_gray","extra":[{"bold":false,"italic":false,"underlined":false,"strikethrough":false,"obfuscated":false,"color":"dark_gray","text":"A well documented account of"}],"text":""}','{"italic":false,"color":"dark_gray","extra":[{"bold":false,"italic":false,"underlined":false,"strikethrough":false,"obfuscated":false,"color":"dark_gray","text":"the rise of the tribunal pharaoh."}],"text":""}']},resolved:1b}
