The Reverie.name: The Reverie
The Reverie.nbt: {pages:['{"text":"My plans have... changed. Through all\\nmy experiments with the Black Wool, honing my skills and testing its limits, none have had results such as these.\\n\\nTime was limited, and my investigations into\\nthe Farr attack had born no fruit. I had to refocus my efforts."}','{"text":"Perhaps the answers were to be found beneath Farr, in the ruins of Velara.\\n\\nIt didn\'t take long to realize I was not alone down there. These ruins were still\\nhome to Genius Loci- spirits. They quickly proved to be... uncooperative."}','{"text":"If they would not speak, then I would make them.\\n\\nIt was then the world started warping around me. The dampness of the ruin turned into a dry heat as I found myself in a Sierhaven far from the one I knew."}','{"text":"\\"Dreamwalker...\\" a voice called to me from across the ruined square. \\n\\nMy search had led me to C\'Axtal, a Tlaxan Shaman, and after decades of his suffering here, he was more than happy to tell me all of his secrets. "}','{"text":"Most importantly, he told me about the wools. How the great jungle spirit Kaul holds a wool himself, and how his gods cannot harm each other. When I asked if they could be harmed at all, he told me the story of a Shaman who injured his god\'s vessel at great cost to his own life. "}','{"text":"It appears their gods are not quite as invulnerable as I once thought. \\n\\n...it was a delightful conversation, and I daresay I was enlightened. Alas, I cannot risk remaining\\nin the Valley any longer; the Celsian Isles are sure to hold the knowledge I seek."}','{"text":"Still, operations in the Valley will continue.\\n\\nI\'ve tasked Cazol with\\nlocating Kaul. The wool Kaul holds may be of use, and the threat he poses is great. It would be of benefit to have him under our control.\\n\\n"}','{"text":"I\'ve also tasked Virius with continuing my\\nresearch into the Farr attack. I regret being unable to finish it myself, but I trust him to do what needs to be done to find the truth.\\n\\nI eagerly await their results upon my return."}'],Enchantments:[{lvl:1s,id:"minecraft:power"}],Monumenta:{MMName:"<!italic><!underlined><!bold><white>The Reverie"},HideFlags:1,title:"The Reverie",author:"Calder",plain:{display:{Name:"The Reverie"}},filtered_title:"The Reverie",display:{Name:'{"bold":false,"italic":false,"underlined":false,"color":"white","text":"The Reverie"}'}}

The Roar.name: The Roar
The Roar.nbt: {pages:['{"text":"My arms stretched out toward Aternam, desperately grasping for his leg, his shirt, his hand, anything. Instead, nothing. I could only watch as he fell into the endlessness below, his cries drowned out by a roaring building steadily in my ears."}'],Monumenta:{MMName:"<!italic><!underlined><!strikethrough><!bold><!obfuscated><white>The Roar"},title:"The Roar",author:"Baetholomew",plain:{display:{Name:"The Roar"}},display:{Name:'{"bold":false,"italic":false,"underlined":false,"strikethrough":false,"obfuscated":false,"color":"white","text":"The Roar"}'},resolved:1b}

The Seven Sisters Vol. 1.name: The Seven Sisters Vol. 1
The Seven Sisters Vol. 1.nbt: {pages:['["There were once\\nseven sisters who\\nlived together in the\\nsky. One was quiet,\\none was loud, one was\\ncruel, one was kind,\\none was sated, one\\nwas starving, and one\\nwas empty. Together\\nthey formed a false\\ntapestry as they\\nsoared across the\\nuniverse, seeking only\\nwhat was left behind"]','["by other wanderers.\\n\\nThey were satisfied.\\n\\nThe further they\\ntraveled, the less\\nthey found left behind\\nfor them to eat. Soon\\nthey found they had\\nbeen following the\\npath of another who\\nfelt a much greater\\nhunger and cared far\\nless for the needs of"]','["others behind her.\\nWhole feasts were left\\nhusks with nothing to\\nconsume but the dust\\nand the shadows of\\nthose devoured."]'],Enchantments:[{lvl:1s,id:"minecraft:power"}],Monumenta:{MMName:"<!italic><!underlined><bold><#6f00ff>The Seven Sisters Vol. 1"},HideFlags:1,title:"The Seven Siste",author:"Ophia",plain:{display:{Name:"The Seven Sisters Vol. 1"}},display:{Name:'{"bold":true,"italic":false,"underlined":false,"color":"#6F00FF","text":"The Seven Sisters Vol. 1"}'}}

The Seven Sisters Vol. 2.name: The Seven Sisters Vol. 2
The Seven Sisters Vol. 2.nbt: {pages:['["The sisters began to\\nhunger far more than\\nbefore. The quiet one\\nasked her sisters if\\nthey should begin\\nsearching for their\\nown meals rather than\\neating the leftovers\\nof another. The other\\nsisters told her to\\nreturn to silence.\\nThey would find food.\\nThey continued to\\nscrounge but found"]','["little.\\nThe starving one\\nspoke next. She had\\nbegun to shrivel up.\\nShe could not last\\nthese pangs. They\\nneeded to find better\\nfood. The kind one\\nagreed, but the cruel\\none laughed at them,\\nbeing unwilling to\\nsuffer for a great\\npayoff. The beast\\nbefore them would fail"]','["one day, she said.\\nThen they would\\ndevour.\\n\\nThe sisters\' travels\\ncontinued with no sign\\nof any change. Soon,\\nthe starving one\\nspoke out again, her\\nwords mere pained\\ngasps as her stomach\\ngrowled for\\nsustenance. If she\\nwas not fed properly"]','["soon, she would\\ndevour her very\\nsisters. The loud one\\nlaughed at her. Six\\nagainst one? There\\nwas no chance. Quiet\\ndown and continue on.\\n\\nBut soon the one who\\nnever spoke, never\\nwas satisfied, never\\nangered, never\\nsoftened, never\\nsilenced, never"]','["starved opened her\\nmouth. The empty one\\nmade a noise, keening\\nwith an echo that\\nshook her sisters into\\nsubmission. Then, she\\npointed into the\\ndistant darkness.\\nThere was food,\\nuntouched. The great\\nbeast they followed\\nhad failed to consume\\nit. They would not.\\nSeven against one? It"]','["would be simple."]'],Enchantments:[{lvl:1s,id:"minecraft:power"}],Monumenta:{MMName:"<!italic><!underlined><bold><#6f00ff>The Seven Sisters Vol. 2"},HideFlags:1,title:"The Seven Siste",author:"Caelona",plain:{display:{Name:"The Seven Sisters Vol. 2"}},display:{Name:'{"bold":true,"italic":false,"underlined":false,"color":"#6F00FF","text":"The Seven Sisters Vol. 2"}'}}

The Seven Sisters Vol. 3.name: The Seven Sisters Vol. 3
The Seven Sisters Vol. 3.nbt: {pages:['["With great force, the\\nsisters succeeded\\nwhere the beast had\\nnot and the quiet one,\\nthe kind one, the\\nstarving one and the\\nempty one entered the\\nshell that protected\\nthe nut they sought to\\neat. To their surprise,\\nhowever, the meat\\nwithin was not so\\nready to lay down and\\nbecome sustenance."]','["Their prey fought\\nback with a ferocity\\nthe sisters had never\\nseen before and,\\nseparated as they\\nwere, the kind one was\\nslaughtered by what\\nhad seemed like mere\\nants crawling across\\nthe surface.\\n\\nThe remaining sisters\\ntook what they could\\nand tried to flee, but"]','["soon the sated one\\nhad perished as well,\\nwasting away, somehow\\nhunger claiming her\\nwhen it never had\\nbefore. The quiet one\\ndied screaming as the\\ndefenders poured\\ngreat power into her\\nform, leaving only the\\nempty one within. The\\nthree dead sisters\\nscattered on the\\nwinds, their three"]','["remains marking their\\ngraves on the world\\nat three points, never\\nto rise again."]'],Enchantments:[{lvl:1s,id:"minecraft:power"}],Monumenta:{MMName:"<!italic><!underlined><bold><#6f00ff>The Seven Sisters Vol. 3"},HideFlags:1,title:"The Seven Siste",author:"Myropy",plain:{display:{Name:"The Seven Sisters Vol. 3"}},display:{Name:'{"bold":true,"italic":false,"underlined":false,"color":"#6F00FF","text":"The Seven Sisters Vol. 3"}'}}

The Seven Sisters Vol. 4.name: The Seven Sisters Vol. 4
The Seven Sisters Vol. 4.nbt: {pages:['["The empty one\\nwithstood the\\nonslaught before her.\\nShe feasted on their\\npower and armies\\nalike, growing in\\nstrength and tearing\\na greater hole into\\nthe shell above,\\ninviting her desperate\\nsisters in as well.\\nBefore they could\\nfollow, the protectors\\nfound another way,"]','["containing the empty\\none within a strange\\ncage on an island that\\nreviled her presence.\\nThe shell was soon\\nstitched back\\ntogether as if it had\\nnever been broken.\\n\\nThe starving one\\ncried out, her meal\\ntaken from her. The\\ncruel one raged,\\ncursing the loss of"]','["her sisters and her\\nsup and demanding\\nretaliation. The loud\\none screamed fury\\ninto the emptiness\\naround them, her\\nanger drawing the\\nattention of something\\nthey had not known\\nstill lurked nearby.\\nThe great beast\\napproached. The\\nthree sisters slunk\\naway from the tasty"]','["shell. Perhaps the\\nbeast could succeed\\nthis time, and the\\nsisters could follow it\\ninside, eating their fill\\nand, they hoped,\\nrescuing their sister\\nwho still survived\\nwithin. This time, they\\ncould wait. Their orbit\\nwould begin here,\\nilluminating the shell\\nbelow."]','["The Stars shone\\nbright tonight and\\nevery night, their\\nvoices calling to those\\nbelow to let them in\\nand return to them\\nwhat was lost. To feed\\nthe hungry. To get\\nrevenge on those\\nbelow. To echo their\\nnames forever into\\nthe air.\\n\\nStars above, they"]','["would wait."]'],Enchantments:[{lvl:1s,id:"minecraft:power"}],Monumenta:{MMName:"<!italic><!underlined><bold><#6f00ff>The Seven Sisters Vol. 4"},HideFlags:1,title:"The Seven Siste",author:"Delfia",plain:{display:{Name:"The Seven Sisters Vol. 4"}},display:{Name:'{"bold":true,"italic":false,"underlined":false,"color":"#6F00FF","text":"The Seven Sisters Vol. 4"}'}}

The Ship.name: The Ship
The Ship.nbt: {pages:['{"text":"And I was no longer in the field, reaching into the maw of oblivion. Instead, I saw only darkness, and heard only the sound of ocean waves. A bolt of lightning streaked through the sky, revealing the waterlogged timber of a massive sea vessel. A chime rang out..."}'],plain:{display:{Name:"The Ship"}},Monumenta:{MMName:"<!italic><!underlined><!strikethrough><!bold><!obfuscated><white>The Ship"},display:{Name:'{"bold":false,"italic":false,"underlined":false,"strikethrough":false,"obfuscated":false,"color":"white","text":"The Ship"}'},title:"The Ship",author:"Baetholomew"}

The Sky.name: The Sky
The Sky.nbt: {pages:['{"text":"We stepped through a tiny doorway and it opened into a meadow. Not a normal meadow either. The sky boiled purple, clouds swirling to a wind we could not feel on the earth below. The ground itself seemed to shiver as we exited the stony portal. It would take us several minutes to grasp why."}'],plain:{display:{Name:"The Sky"}},Monumenta:{MMName:"<!italic><!underlined><!strikethrough><!bold><!obfuscated><white>The Sky"},display:{Name:'{"bold":false,"italic":false,"underlined":false,"strikethrough":false,"obfuscated":false,"color":"white","text":"The Sky"}'},title:"The Sky",author:"Baetholomew"}

The Third Vault.name: The Third Vault
The Third Vault.nbt: {pages:['{"text":"Recent discoveries made in the shifting city have lead me back to researching the structure colloquially known as the \\"crystalline vault\\".\\n\\nFor many years now, we have speculated that it was much the same as Steelmeld - a Seamount long since"}','{"text":"abandoned on the ocean floor.\\n\\nIt was not until teams of researchers led by Fred delved into the shifting city that things have become a bit more clear.\\n\\nDown in those depths, two areas of interest were discovered."}','{"text":"Vault Zeta and Vault Iota, as the teams have come to learn their names.\\n\\nIt was upon this discovery that I knew something further was afoot in the crystalline vault, something that would explain its stark differences in"}','{"text":"the other Seamounts that have been discovered across the Isles.\\n\\nMuch time was spent digging through the ruins of that place, alone by myself with nothing but the crushing weight of the ocean above me."}','{"text":"I had nearly given up until I found a single scroll amongst the dirt and rubble, the language upon which required transcription.\\n\\nHad this parchment been found merely a few years earlier, it likely would have been disregarded as"}','{"text":"insignificant. But now, with the context of the shifting city in mind, I was able to understand its full meaning.\\n\\nIt was the true name of the crystalline vault.\\n\\nVault Omega!"}','{"text":"Now a further question remains... \\n\\nWhat is the purpose of these vaults? Why were hidden far beneath the waves?\\n\\nSurely one day, with enough study, we will be able to answer this question."}'],Enchantments:[{lvl:1s,id:"minecraft:power"}],Monumenta:{MMName:"<!italic><!underlined><!bold><gold>The Third Vault",MMLore:["Some research notes on","an underwater vault."]},HideFlags:1,title:"b",author:"Researcher Hyla",plain:{display:{Name:"The Third Vault",Lore:["Some research notes on","an underwater vault."]}},display:{Name:'{"bold":false,"italic":false,"underlined":false,"color":"gold","text":"The Third Vault"}',Lore:['{"italic":false,"color":"dark_gray","extra":["Some research notes on"],"text":""}','{"italic":false,"color":"dark_gray","extra":["an underwater vault."],"text":""}']}}

Through that darkness came figures. Humans, their origins unknown to me.§0\\n§0\\n§0They dug through the earth, tunneling until they found the halls, wherein lied their prize. For the first time, it was something I recognized. It was§0\\n"}','{"text":"The Memory. The dream then shifted, and I was atop a large stone structure. Waterlogged Scraps.name: Waterlogged Scraps
Waterlogged Scraps.nbt: {pages:['{"extra":[{"text":"Something is wrong. The whole village seems to be humming with a tense energy, like a string on a skendi about to snap. But I am ready. This tension fuels me. My gathering is today. A gathering of friends, of like-minded Tlaxani. We meet soon, and I have"}],"text":""}','{"extra":[{"text":"the whole home prepared. A fine dinner has been set up outside. I\\u0027ve fitted a new front door on my home and hung fine curtains of the brightest green."},{"text":"\\n"},{"text":"\\n"},{"color":"black","text":"My guests arrive as the sun moves past the midpoint of the sky."}],"text":""}','{"extra":[{"text":"I welcome each by name with a polite smile and a pleasant atmosphere. The tension from earlier is still palpable, but none of my guests seem to be affected by it. Could it just be me? The humming, like a whisper, echoes endlessly in the back of my mind."}],"text":""}','{"extra":[{"text":"We discuss the war. This endless loss of life as Tlaxan soldiers are thrown one by one against the invader\\u0027s forces. Not content to destroy us on the ground, they have taken to flying orbs, raining down virulent potions from above, blighting the very land"}],"text":""}','{"extra":[{"text":"we walk on, and leaving corpses in their wake. I hate this. Not just the invaders, but our leaders too. C\\u0027Shura started this. C\\u0027Axtal continues this. C\\u0027Zanil murders for this. It is tkenn on earth. We will not stand for it any longer. That is why we meet."}],"text":""}','{"extra":[{"text":"But as we speak, the rumbles grow louder. Discontent grows among the gathered as the tension erupts in my head."},{"text":"\\n"},{"text":"\\n"},{"color":"black","text":"Then came the roar. The sound, like thousands of voices shouting at once. A rage so pure that even the plants"}],"text":""}','{"extra":[{"text":"around us seemed to cower."},{"text":"\\n"},{"text":"\\n"},{"color":"black","text":"The spirit of this place was awake."},{"text":"\\n"},{"text":"\\n"},{"color":"black","text":"Fear filled my body with a cold chill, but I seemed to move automatically, herding my guests into my home. I told them to go into the basement"}],"text":""}','{"extra":[{"text":"to seek shelter. The earth itself was quivering and a strange shape began to coalesce above us. I saw a small figure floating above the center of Ta\\u0027Ferna, and that shape began to close in around it. The Soulspeaker. And something else."}],"text":""}','{"extra":[{"text":"I ran for my home, but by the time I looked back, the shape and the Soulspeaker were both gone. The rage had not subsided though. The ground continued to rumble. Then, as if lifted by invisible hands, the water from Lake Tenki lifted from the banks and a "}],"text":""}','{"extra":[{"text":"landmass began to rise from the waters. The sun seemed to freeze in the sky. I saw nothing else, as the cold grasp of fear took over my body again, and I rushed into the basement to join my guests."},{"text":"\\n"},{"text":"\\n"},{"color":"black","text":"With the door sealed,"}],"text":""}','{"extra":[{"text":"things seemed quieter. The tension was still present, but the sounds of rage from above had lessened. Soon, all we could hear was the water rushing over the hallowed grounds of the Sanctum."},{"text":"\\n"},{"text":"\\n"},{"color":"black","text":"Then the dripping began."}],"text":""}','{"extra":[{"text":"Within minutes, the floor was covered in ankle deep water. The door refused to open, sealed by water or debris from unseen destruction. I know not which, but there seemed no way out. With nothing left to do, I began to write frantically, chronicling these"}],"text":""}','{"extra":[{"text":"events on page, hoping to preserve them on reed-paper so that whoever finds it will know what happened here. The rage of the jungle surrounded us."},{"text":"\\n"},{"text":"\\n"},{"color":"black","text":"Then with a rush, the jungle left us to die."}],"text":""}'],generation:0,Monumenta:{MMName:"<!italic><!underlined><!strikethrough><!bold><!obfuscated>Waterlogged Scraps"},title:"Waterlogged Scra",author:"Akgretka",plain:{display:{Name:"Waterlogged Scraps"}},display:{Name:'{"bold":false,"italic":false,"underlined":false,"strikethrough":false,"obfuscated":false,"text":"Waterlogged Scraps"}'},resolved:1b}

Yes, stop it. I must. The power of the darkest god has stained the Verdant Fortress. I must reach it and find what"}','{"text":"is left before the... thing... following me reaches me. I have little time. What I Cannot Unsee.name: What I Cannot Unsee
What I Cannot Unsee.nbt: {pages:['{"text":"Sometimes I wish I could just forget. Go back to my life selling magic supplies and materials. Live my life dreaming of heroes and quests. Instead, I\\u0027ve been drawn into something far darker than I ever imagined. The screams will haunt my nightmares."}','{"text":"He is simply too strong for anyone to stop. If he finds out that I know I could very well be the next to go. I\\u0027m scared to even put these words on paper. But I must. Others need to know."}','{"text":"While heading downstairs, after the end of the Arena events for the day, I heard a strange noise from behind an oaken door towards the end of the hallway. I hesitated, then approached the door, intending to check what was behind."}','{"text":"I was worried perhaps someone had been injured. Perhaps the ritual had failed? With shaking hands, I opened the door just a small bit, and the sound issued forth, louder than before. "}','{"text":"It was a sound so torturous, so full of suffering that chills didn\\u0027t just go down my spine, but consumed it. While I wanted nothing more than to run away, flee this horrific noise, I had to know. I pressed to the door and peered through the crack."}','{"text":"In the room there were two figures. One was the Owner. The other was a challenger from earlier in the day, making it further than any other had. He was lying in a heap on the floor. The Owner was mid-sentence, speaking to the quivering mass on the ground."}','{"text":"\\"...you\\u0027ve done so well too, Chesapeake. You\\u0027ve come so far, but I can\\u0027t let you continue. The Arena was not meant for you. You\\u0027ll be staying with me for the time being.\\" The man on the floor shook. \\"Yeigar... please...\\" The owner - Yeigar? Is that his name?"}','{"text":"Yeigar made a beckoning motion with his hand, and a creature lurched from the shadows, gripping Chesapeake by the neck, and dragging the challenger away."}','{"text":"I ran. The darkness was here too. The Owner was up to something, and I needed to find out what. I\\u0027m just not sure how. If you find this journal, find me. We\\u0027ll talk."}'],generation:0,Enchantments:[{lvl:1s,id:"minecraft:power"}],Monumenta:{MMName:"<!italic><!underlined><!strikethrough><!bold><!obfuscated><white>What I Cannot Unsee",MMLore:["<!italic><light_purple>* Quest Item *","#Q34I01"]},HideFlags:1,title:"What I",author:"Jeremiah",plain:{display:{Name:"What I Cannot Unsee",Lore:["* Quest Item *","#Q34I01"]}},display:{Name:'{"bold":false,"italic":false,"underlined":false,"strikethrough":false,"obfuscated":false,"color":"white","text":"What I Cannot Unsee"}',Lore:['{"italic":false,"color":"dark_gray","extra":[{"italic":false,"color":"light_purple","text":"* Quest Item *"}],"text":""}','{"italic":false,"color":"dark_gray","extra":["#Q34I01"],"text":""}']},resolved:1b}

Worn Journal of a Mage.nbt: {pages:['{"text":"At first I didn\'t believe a place like this truly existed, but after Camille brought me here, it\'s everything I\'ve ever dreamed of and more. Most of the people here are understanding and respectful, but there are certainly some who could take a stick out of their- "}','{"text":"After being here for a few weeks, I think that I can confidently say that we are safe here. Camille has already gone off and started to mingle with people who are like us. I hope my sister will be able to discern who is trustworthy and who is not..."}','{"text":"It\'s been almost two months and I\'ve been so busy with settling in and studying that I haven\'t really had a chance to sit down and breathe. Here, the weather never changes and days seem to go by like nothing. It almost feels like time doesn\'t pass here..."}','{"text":"My sister came to me today and told me she met \\"the one\\" today. Apparently he is one of the knights who train in the western buildings. Who knows when Camille had time to go visit that part of the city. When I expressed my disapproval, she left our home.  "}','{"text":"Camille returned a week later, apologizing but remaining stubborn about her new relationship. I didn\'t want to argue further either so I just left it alone. I want her to be happy, but I just can\'t bring myself to trust the people here completely yet..."}','{"text":"It\'s an absolute disaster. Just horrible. My stupid sister told me that she wanted to marry the guy! I told her how ridiculous that was and she said that maybe it was time that we lived separately! It\'s only been about four months and it seems like she\'s a completely different person!"}','{"text":"A week after we argued, I was invited to live in the central island as a researcher for new magic. The timing couldn\'t be any more perfect. My sister no longer even acknowledges that I exist in the house. I think it\'s time for me to leave..."}','{"text":"After moving into the central island\'s research building, I was given my own room. Honestly it\'s nicer than our old home. I met the person who lived across from me, she said she researches gravity magic."}','{"text":"It\'s been a good while since I\'ve had time to myself once again. Everything here is so fast paced, it\'s almost like people are racing against time for something. I don\'t know why I write in this journal still... Maybe because it keeps me rooted to my old reality."}','{"text":"I\'ve been given a team of my own to help me with my research. I never thought I\'d get an opportunity like this... It feels so surreal, but I know to not expect more. For now I just want to keep my head down and do my work..."}','{"text":"Today my sister visited me. She shoved an invitation into my hand and told me that the least I could do as her brother was to attend her wedding. I wasn\'t expecting her to invite me after the last argument we had, but I suppose this world is full of surprises. "}','{"text":"I spent today trying to pick out a wedding gift for my sister and her to-be husband. I still don\'t really like him. I\'m a little worried about my sister though... The wedding is in a few months but she seems to be gaining weight. Maybe she\'s stress eating?"}','{"text":"The baby was born earlier than expected... I was too busy with work that morning that by the time I got the message and arrived at the house, she was... \\n "}','{"text":"Camille named her child Rose because the small tuft of hair she had was a soft but brilliant red color. She\'s so small, yet she\'s the reason my sister is dead... I wanted to hate her so badly, so that I could leave her with her father. But when I looked at her and she smiled... I couldn\'t."}','{"text":"Rose is a lively girl with bright eyes. While she looks much like her father, her personality and talents seem to be more like her mother\'s. When I see her playing with other children and smiling, I feel both happiness and deep anger that Camille can\'t see her child grow up."}','{"text":"I was playing with Rose in the central island research center\'s garden when the King passed by us. He stopped to greet us and mentioned that Rose\'s hair looked similar to a friend of his. He had a strange look in his eyes, but I won\'t think about it."}','{"text":"Leo suddenly passed. They won\'t disclose any information regarding his death but they insist that the Imperial Court should take Rose in since her father was a knight. I will make sure that doesn\'t happen. Rose should be with family."}','{"text":"Rose has started to live with me. While it is hard to take care of a child while keeping up with my research, my co-workers have been understanding. Sometimes, I have been approached by people from the Imperial Court, but I try to avoid them."}','{"text":"I was sent a letter demanding that Rose is handed over to the Imperial Court. I promptly sent a letter back stating that she is not an object to be passed around. Afterwards I\'ve noticed shadows following me. I fear for my life, but also Rose\'s."}','{"text":"Rose has been nervous recently. I believe she senses the danger as well. I believe we should leave. This place has proven itself to be dangerous."}','{"text":"Tonight we leave this place that has brought nothing but heartbreak. I don\'t know where we will go, but I must find a place where Rose will be safe. She is my only family now. "}'],title:"Worn Journal of a Mage",author:"Marvin Lace",resolved:1b}
